examples.chinese: 無比的專注

items.englishDefinition: an amount that is more than acceptable, expected, or reasonable

examples.english: An excess of enthusiasm is not always a good thing.
examples.chinese: 過分熱情不見得總是件好事。

examples.english: They both eat to excess (= too much).
examples.chinese: 他們兩個都吃得太多了。

items.englishDefinition: too much

examples.english: Excessive exercise can sometimes cause health problems.
examples.chinese: 過度的運動有時也會導致健康問題。

examples.english: Any more pudding would simply be excessive.
examples.chinese: 不能再吃布丁了，再吃就太多了。

items.cue: Replacing a purchase with another item

examples.english: Can I exchange this shirt for a larger size?
examples.chinese: 我可以把這件襯衫換成大一號的嗎？

items.englishDefinition: the act of not allowing someone or something to take part in an activity or to enter a place

examples.english: her exclusion from the list of Oscar nominees
examples.chinese: 她被排除在奧斯卡獎提名名單之外

examples.english: the exclusion of disruptive students from school
examples.chinese: 將搗亂的學生從學校開除

items.meaning: 專用的，專有的；獨有的，獨佔的
items.englishDefinition: limited to only one person or group of people

examples.english: This room is for the exclusive use of guests.
examples.chinese: 這間房是專供客人使用的。

examples.english: an exclusive interview
examples.chinese: 獨家採訪

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: not including something

examples.english: Is the total exclusive of service charges?
examples.chinese: 總金額是不是不包括服務費？

items.englishDefinition: only

examples.english: This offer is available exclusively to our established customers.
examples.chinese: 只有本店的老客戶才能享受這個優惠價。

examples.english: an exclusively female audience
examples.chinese: 只限女性觀眾

items.meaning: 決策的，管理的;給重要人物使用的
items.englishDefinition: relating to making decisions and managing businesses, or suitable for people with important jobs in business

examples.english: His executive skills will be very useful to the company.
examples.chinese: 他的管理能力對公司將會非常有用。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: the part of a government that is responsible for making certain that laws and decisions are put into action

examples.english: The executive is responsible for implementing the laws passed by parliament.
examples.chinese: 行政部門負責執行國會通過的法律。

items.meaning: 被免除（義務或付款）的;被豁免的
items.englishDefinition: with special permission not to do or pay something

examples.english: Goods exempt from this tax include books and children's clothes.
examples.chinese: 免徵這項稅收的商品包括書籍和童裝。

examples.english: Pregnant women are exempt from dental charges under the current health system.
examples.chinese: 在現行的醫療制度下，孕婦看牙醫是免費的。

items.englishDefinition: An event or occasion where objects are shown to the public.

examples.english: The photographs will be on exhibition until the end of the month.
examples.chinese: 這些照片將一直展出到月底。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: A public display of a skill or quality.

examples.english: The athlete's third, and winning, jump was an exhibition of skill and strength.
examples.chinese: 這個運動員的第三次試跳，也是獲勝的那一跳，充分展示了他的技巧和體能。

examples.english: Keep the emergency exit clear at all times.
examples.chinese: 請隨時保持緊急出口暢通。

items.meaning: 異國風情的，外國情調的；奇異的
items.englishDefinition: unusual and exciting because of coming (or seeming to come) from far away, especially a tropical country

examples.english: exotic flowers/food/designs
examples.chinese: 奇花異草／外國風味的食物／奇異的設計

items.englishDefinition: the feeling of expecting something to happen
items.notes: expect 動詞

examples.english: Considering the injuries he's had there can be little expectation of him winning the race.
examples.chinese: 考慮到他的傷勢，他贏這場比賽的希望不大。

examples.english: Our expectations are that the UK will cut its interest rate.
examples.chinese: 我們預計英國會調降利率。

items.meaning: （政府或個人的）全部開支，花費
items.englishDefinition: the total amount of money that a government or person spends

examples.english: It's part of a drive to cut government expenditure.
examples.chinese: 這是削減政府開支的一個方法。

examples.english: The government's annual expenditure on arms has been reduced.
examples.chinese: 政府已經縮減了年度軍備開支。

examples.english: Please submit your travel expenses by the end of the month.
examples.chinese: 請在月底前提交差旅費用明細。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: the use of money, time, or effort

examples.english: Buying a bigger car has proved to be well worth the expense.
examples.chinese: 事實證明，買輛大一點的車還是值得的。

examples.english: We've just had a new garage built at great expense.
examples.chinese: 我們剛用了很多錢蓋一座新車庫。

examples.english: She has five years of experience in customer service.
examples.chinese: 她有五年的客戶服務工作經驗。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: (the process of getting) knowledge or skill from doing, seeing, or feeling things

examples.english: In my experience, people generally smile back if you smile at them.
examples.chinese: 據我的經驗，如果你對別人微笑，他們通常也會對你微笑的。

examples.english: I know from experience that Tony never keeps his promises.
examples.chinese: 經驗告訴我，湯尼從不會信守諾言。

items.englishDefinition: a person with a high level of knowledge or skill relating to a particular subject or activity

examples.english: My mother is an expert at dress-making (= she does it very well).
examples.chinese: 我媽媽是做裁縫的高手。

items.englishDefinition: a high level of knowledge or skill
items.notes:
expert：專家。
expertise：專業知識、技能。
specialization：專攻、專業化。

examples.english: We admired the expertise with which he prepared the meal.
examples.chinese: 我們很羡慕他那一手烹調絕技。

examples.english: She has considerable expertise in French history.
examples.chinese: 她研究法國歷史有很深的造詣。

items.englishDefinition: the situation in which something that lasts for a fixed length of time comes to an end or stops being in use

examples.english: the expiration of a lease/visa
examples.chinese: 租約期滿／簽證到期

examples.english: What is the expiration date of your credit card? (= What is the last date on which it can be used?)
examples.chinese: 你的信用卡甚麼時候到期？

items.englishDefinition: If something that lasts for a fixed length of time expires, it comes to an end or stops being in use.

examples.english: My passport expires next month.
examples.chinese: 我的護照下個月過期。

examples.english: The contract between the two companies will expire at the end of the year.
examples.chinese: 兩間公司之間的合約將在年底到期。

items.meaning: 為自己的行為作出說明（或解釋）
items.englishDefinition: to give reasons for your behaviour

examples.english: He hadn't been home for three days so I asked him to explain himself.
examples.chinese: 他一連三天沒有回家，所以我要他解釋一下原因。

examples.english: If they catch us in here, we're going to have a hard time explaining ourselves.
examples.chinese: 如果他們在這裡抓到我們，我們將很難解釋自己。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: to make something clear or easy to understand by describing or giving information about it

examples.english: If there's anything you don't understand, I'll be happy to explain.
examples.chinese: 如果你有甚麼不明白的地方，我很樂意為你講解。

examples.english: Our guide explained where the cathedral was.
examples.chinese: 導遊向我們講解了大教堂的位置。

items.englishDefinition: to use something in a way that helps you

examples.english: We need to make sure that we exploit our resources as fully as possible.
examples.chinese: 我們要確保盡可能充分利用資源。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: to use someone or something unfairly for your own advantage

examples.english: Laws exist to stop companies exploiting their employees.
examples.chinese: 法律規定禁止公司剝削其員工。

items.englishDefinition: The fact of wrongdoing being made public.

examples.english: The exposure of the politician's love affair forced him to resign.
examples.chinese: 這位政治人物的婚外情遭到揭露後，他被迫辭職。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: the fact of experiencing something or being affected by it because of being in a particular situation or place

examples.english: You should always limit your exposure to the sun.
examples.chinese: 無論甚麼時候，都不要長時間曬太陽。

examples.english: Even a brief exposure to radiation is very dangerous.
examples.chinese: 即使只是短期接受輻射也是非常危險的。

items.meaning: 富於表情的;有表現力的
items.englishDefinition: showing what someone thinks or feels

examples.english: an expressive face
examples.chinese: 富於表情的臉

examples.english: expressive hands
examples.chinese: 豐富生動的手勢語言

items.englishDefinition: the fact of reaching, stretching, or continuing; the act of adding to something in order to make it bigger or longer

examples.english: They are hoping to get an extension of their loan (= to be given a longer period of time in which to pay it back).
examples.chinese: 他們希望能夠將貸款期限延長。

examples.english: His report contained serious criticisms of the finance director, and, by extension (= therefore), of the entire board of management.
examples.chinese: 他的報告對財務總監進行了嚴厲批評，進而又擴及到整個管理委員會。

additionalSenses.meaning: （共用一個號碼的）電話分機；（號碼不同的）電話分機
additionalSenses.englishDefinition: any of two or more phones in the same house that share the same number, or any of a number of phones connected to a switchboard in a large building such as an office

examples.english: When you call, ask for extension 3276.
examples.chinese: 當你打電話時，請總機轉入分機3276。

items.englishDefinition: very

examples.english: They played extremely well.
examples.chinese: 他們演奏得非常精彩。

examples.english: She's extremely beautiful.
examples.chinese: 她非常美麗。

items.englishDefinition: cloth or material for making clothes, covering furniture, etc.

examples.english: dress fabric
examples.chinese: 裙裝衣料

examples.english: seats upholstered in red fabric
examples.chinese: 罩有紅色布料的座椅

examples.english: cotton fabrics
examples.chinese: 棉織物

items.meaning: 設施；供特定用途的場所
items.cue: A place provided for an activity

examples.english: The new training facility has six classrooms.
examples.chinese: 新的訓練場所設有六間教室。

additionalSenses.meaning: （尤指包含多個建築物，有特定用途的）場所
additionalSenses.englishDefinition: a place, especially including buildings, where a particular activity happens

examples.english: a new sports facility
examples.chinese: 新的運動場所

examples.english: a military facility
examples.chinese: 軍事機構

examples.english: a nuclear research facility
examples.chinese: 核研究中心

items.englishDefinition: more than average, but less than very

examples.english: I'm fairly sure that this is the right address.
examples.chinese: 我相當肯定這個地址沒錯。

examples.english: We get on fairly well.
examples.chinese: 我們相處得不錯。

items.englishDefinition: to come down onto the ground or from a high position to a lower position

examples.english: The snow had been falling steadily all day.
examples.chinese: 雪持續下了一整天。

examples.english: It was October and the leaves had started to fall.
examples.chinese: 十月了，樹葉開始掉落。

examples.english: The bus fare is lower if you use a travel card.
examples.chinese: 使用交通卡可享有較低的公車票價。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: the money that you pay for a journey in a vehicle such as a bus or train

examples.english: Train fares are going up again.
examples.chinese: 火車票又漲價了。

items.englishDefinition: extremely interesting

examples.english: The book offers a fascinating glimpse of the lives of the rich and famous.
examples.chinese: 這本書使我們得以一窺富豪名流的生活，十分有趣。

examples.english: I found the whole movie fascinating.
examples.chinese: 我覺得整部電影都很吸引人。

items.englishDefinition: extreme tiredness

examples.english: She was suffering from fatigue.
examples.chinese: 她勞累不堪。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: to make someone extremely tired

examples.english: The journey had fatigued him.
examples.chinese: 旅途令他勞累不堪。

items.englishDefinition: in a way that shows someone or something is liked or approved of

examples.english: New recruits are usually desperate to be judged favourably by their superiors.
examples.chinese: 新入職的人通常急於想得到上級的好評。

examples.english: Patients comment more favourably about hospitals when they have recently undergone treatment.
examples.chinese: 最近接受過治療的病人對醫院更是褒揚有加。

examples.english: One useful feature of the app is automatic backup.
examples.chinese: 這個應用程式的一項實用功能是自動備份。

examples.english: The registration fee includes lunch and course materials.
examples.chinese: 報名費包含午餐與課程教材。

items.cue: What customers say about an experience

examples.english: We use customer feedback to improve our services.
examples.chinese: 我們利用客戶的回饋意見改善服務。

items.englishDefinition: to understand something by thinking about it
items.cue: 職場與人事情境：figure out a problem
items.notes: 可分：figure it out；也常接 how、why、what 等疑問詞子句。

examples.english: Can you figure out why the printer keeps stopping?
examples.chinese: 你能弄清楚印表機為何一直停止運作嗎？

examples.english: The instructions are unclear, but our technician can figure them out.
examples.chinese: 說明不清楚，但我們的技術人員能弄懂。

examples.english: Save the file in the shared folder before leaving.
examples.chinese: 離開前，請將檔案儲存在共用資料夾。

examples.english: Could you fill in for me while I am on leave?
examples.chinese: 我休假時，你可以替我代班嗎？

additionalSenses.meaning: 填寫空白欄位；填妥表格
additionalSenses.englishDefinition: to add the required information to blank spaces in a document
additionalSenses.cue: 職場與人事情境：fill in a form
additionalSenses.notes: 可分：fill the form in；代名詞用 fill it in。與既有 fill in 的代班詞義分開。

examples.english: Please fill in your contact details before submitting the application.
examples.chinese: 提交申請前，請填妥你的聯絡資料。

examples.english: The form has several blank fields; fill them in before the interview.
examples.chinese: 表格有幾個空白欄位，請在面試前填妥。

examples.english: Please fill out the visitor form at reception.
examples.chinese: 請在接待處填寫訪客表格。

items.meaning: 把（計劃、日期等）最後定下
items.englishDefinition: to make a final and certain decision about a plan, date, etc.

examples.english: We'll finalize the details later.
examples.chinese: 細節我們稍後再定。

items.englishDefinition: relating to money or how money is managed

examples.english: financial difficulties/success
examples.chinese: 財政困難／經濟上的成功

examples.english: financial affairs
examples.chinese: 金融事務

items.englishDefinition: to learn information that was not previously known
items.cue: 會議與溝通情境：find out the reason
collocations: find out whether a room is available
items.notes: 常接 what、why、whether 等疑問詞子句；find out about 後接想了解的事。

examples.english: Please find out whether the conference room is available on Monday.
examples.chinese: 請查明會議室星期一是否可用。

examples.english: We found out that the supplier had changed its delivery schedule.
examples.chinese: 我們得知供應商已更改配送時程。

items.englishDefinition: an amount of money that has to be paid as a punishment for not obeying a rule or law

examples.english: The maximum penalty for the offence is a $1,000 fine.
examples.chinese: 違者最高可遭判罰1000美元。

examples.english: If found guilty, he faces six months in jail and a heavy (= severe) fine.
examples.chinese: 如果被判有罪，等待他的將是六個月的監禁和巨額罰款。

items.englishDefinition: connected with (public) money

examples.english: fiscal policy
examples.chinese: 財政政策

items.meaning: 有彈性的；能配合調整的

examples.english: This job offers flexible hours for employees with children.
examples.chinese: 這份工作為有孩子的員工提供彈性的工時。

examples.english: Our flight was delayed because of strong winds.
examples.chinese: 我們的航班因強風而延誤。

examples.english: I will follow up with the client after the meeting.
examples.chinese: 會議結束後，我會再和客戶聯繫。

items.englishDefinition: after

examples.english: The weeks following the riots were extremely tense.
examples.chinese: 暴亂之後的幾周氣氛極其緊張。

examples.english: Following the dinner, there will be a dance.
examples.chinese: 晚餐之後將有一場舞會。

collocations: free shipping for a limited time

examples.english: Free shipping is available for a limited time.
examples.chinese: 免運優惠僅限特定期間提供。

items.meaning: 影響；活力；影響大的人（或事物）
items.englishDefinition: (a person or thing with a lot of) influence and energy

examples.english: He was a powerful force in politics.
examples.chinese: 他曾是政壇上舉足輕重的人物。

examples.english: Fishermen are always at the mercy of the forces of nature (= bad weather conditions).
examples.chinese: 漁夫們總是聽天由命。

items.meaning: （尤指對特定形勢或天氣的）預測，預報
items.englishDefinition: a statement of what is judged likely to happen in the future, especially in connection with a particular situation, or the expected weather conditions

examples.english: economic forecasts
examples.chinese: 經濟預測

examples.english: The weather forecast said it was going to rain later today.
examples.chinese: 天氣預報說今天晚些時候有雨。

items.englishDefinition: to know about something before it happens

examples.english: I don't foresee any difficulties so long as we keep within budget.
examples.chinese: 只要我們不超出預算，我看不出會有甚麽困難。

items.cue: A document with fields to complete

examples.english: Please write your phone number on the form.
examples.chinese: 請在表格上填寫你的電話號碼。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: a type of something
additionalSenses.notes: a form of identification：一種身分證明。

examples.english: Swimming is the best form of exercise.
examples.chinese: 游泳是最佳的鍛煉方式。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: to begin to exist or to make something begin to exist
additionalSenses.notes: a form of identification：一種身分證明。

examples.english: I formed the impression (= the way she behaved suggested to me) that she didn't really want to come.
examples.chinese: 我形成了一種印象：她其實並不想來。

items.englishDefinition: public or official

examples.english: a formal announcement
examples.chinese: 正式聲明

examples.english: formal procedures
examples.chinese: 正式的程序

additionalSenses.meaning: 形式上的；表面上的；名義上的
additionalSenses.englishDefinition: in appearance or by name only

examples.english: I am the formal leader of the project but the everyday management is in the hands of my assistant.
examples.chinese: 我是這個專案計劃名義上的領導人，但日常管理都由我的助理負責。

items.meaning: 較早的，早先的;以前的;舊時的
items.englishDefinition: of or in an earlier time; before the present time or in the past

examples.english: The luxury apartments are in a former factory.
examples.chinese: 這些豪華公寓的前身是工廠廠房。

examples.english: The painting was then restored to its former glory (= returned to its original good condition).
examples.chinese: 這幅畫後來經過修復，恢復了昔日的光彩（回到原本的良好狀態）。

items.englishDefinition: lucky

examples.english: You're very fortunate to have found such a nice house.
examples.chinese: 你能找到這麽一棟漂亮的房子真是非常幸運。

examples.english: He was fortunate in his choice of assistant.
examples.chinese: 他很幸運，選擇了一位好助手。

items.englishDefinition: a place on the internet where people can leave messages or discuss particular subjects with other people at the same time

examples.english: Discussion forums are a way of contacting people with similar interests from all over the world.
examples.chinese: 各種交流討論的論壇可以把世界各地興趣相同的人聯繫起來。

items.englishDefinition: towards the direction that is in front of you

examples.english: She leaned forward to whisper something in my ear.
examples.chinese: 她傾身向前，對我耳語了一番。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: to send a letter, etc., especially from someone's old address to their new address, or to send a letter, email, etc. that you have received to someone else

examples.english: I'll forward any mail to your new address.
examples.chinese: 我會把信件都轉寄至你的新地址。

examples.english: I'll forward his email to you if you're interested.
examples.chinese: 如果你感興趣，我可以把他的電子郵件轉發給你。

items.englishDefinition: to encourage the development or growth of ideas or feelings

examples.english: They were discussing the best way to foster democracy and prosperity in the former communist countries.
examples.chinese: 他們正在討論促進前共產主義國家民主和繁榮的最佳辦法。

examples.english: I'm trying to foster an interest in classical music in my children.
examples.chinese: 我正努力培養我的孩子們對古典音樂的興趣。

items.englishDefinition: an occasion when an organization, state, etc. is established

examples.english: the foundation of a new state
examples.chinese: 一個新國家的建立

examples.english: Mark the box as fragile because it contains glass.
examples.chinese: 請在箱子上標示「易碎品」，因為裡面裝有玻璃製品。

additionalSenses.meaning: 易損壞的；易碎的；脆弱的
additionalSenses.englishDefinition: A fragile object is easily damaged or broken.

examples.english: Be careful with that vase - it's very fragile.
examples.chinese: 拿那個花瓶要小心——它很容易碎。

examples.english: Please handle the fragile items with care.
examples.chinese: 請小心搬運這些易碎物品。

examples.english: Sending the parts by air freight will cost more.
examples.chinese: 以空運寄送這些零件的費用會比較高。

items.englishDefinition: the quality of being in a new, natural condition and not old or preserved by processes such as freezing

examples.english: We pride ourselves on the freshness of our produce.
examples.chinese: 我們對我們的產品的新鮮度感到自豪。

examples.english: The freshness of an egg is very important in cooking.
examples.chinese: 雞蛋的新鮮度在烹飪中是非常重要的。

items.englishDefinition: a substance that is used to provide heat or power, usually by being burned

examples.english: Wood, coal, oil, petrol, and gas are all different kinds of fuel.
examples.chinese: 木材、煤炭、石油、汽油和煤氣是不同種類的燃料。

examples.english: The new exhaust system, it is claimed, will lower fuel consumption.
examples.chinese: 據稱新的排氣裝置會降低燃料的消耗。

items.englishDefinition: to satisfy someone or to make someone feel happy

examples.english: I don't feel that my present way of life really fulfils me.
examples.chinese: 我覺得現在的生活無法真正地令我滿意。

examples.english: I've finally found a job in which I can fulfil myself (= completely develop my abilities and interests).
examples.chinese: 我終於找到了一份能發揮自己才能的工作。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: to do something that is expected, hoped for, or promised, or to cause it to happen

examples.english: So did the course fulfil all your expectations?
examples.chinese: 那麽這門課程符合你各方面的期望嗎？

examples.english: Zoos fulfil an important function in the protection of rare species.
examples.chinese: 動物園起著保護珍稀動物的重要功能。

items.englishDefinition: An official ceremony or formal social gathering.

examples.english: As a mayor, he has a lot of official functions to attend.
examples.chinese: 作爲市長，他要參加很多官方活動。

examples.english: I see her two or three times a year, usually at social functions.
examples.chinese: 我一年能見她兩三次，通常都是在社交聚會上。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: the way in which something works or operates

examples.english: It's a disease that affects the function of the nervous system.
examples.chinese: 這是一種影響神經系統功能的疾病。

items.englishDefinition: an amount of money saved, collected, or provided for a particular purpose

examples.english: The hospital has set up a special fund to buy new equipment.
examples.chinese: 醫院設立了一筆專款來購買新設備。

examples.english: Following the repairs to the roof, church funds are now seriously depleted.
examples.chinese: 在對屋頂進行修繕之後，教堂的資金現在嚴重吃緊。

items.englishDefinition: things such as chairs, tables, beds, cupboards, etc. that are put into a house or other building to make it suitable and comfortable for living or working in

examples.english: They have a lot of antique furniture.
examples.chinese: 他們有很多古董家具。

examples.english: We've just bought some new outdoor furniture.
examples.chinese: 我們剛剛買了些花園裡用的新傢俱。

items.meaning: （藝術作品）陳列館;美術館;畫廊
items.englishDefinition: a room or building that is used for showing works of art, sometimes so that they can be sold

examples.english: the National Portrait Gallery
examples.chinese: 國家肖像畫廊

items.englishDefinition: a difference between two things

examples.english: The gap between rich and poor is still widening (= becoming greater).
examples.chinese: 貧富差距仍在繼續拉大。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: an empty space or opening in the middle of something or between two things

examples.english: The children squeezed through a gap in the wall.
examples.chinese: 孩子們從牆的一個缺口處硬擠了過去。

examples.english: She has a small gap between her front teeth.
examples.chinese: 她的門牙之間有條細縫。

items.englishDefinition: to collect several things, often from different places or people

examples.english: I went to several libraries to gather information about the plans.
examples.chinese: 我去了數家圖書館去搜集有關這一計劃的資料。

examples.english: She gathered up the newspapers that were scattered around the floor.
examples.chinese: 她把散落在地板上的報紙收拾起來。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: to put your arms around someone and hold or carry them in a careful or loving way

examples.english: He gathered her in his arms and kissed her.
examples.chinese: 他把她擁入懷中親吻。

examples.english: She gathered the children up and hurried into the house.
examples.chinese: 她抱起孩子趕快跑進了屋裡。

items.englishDefinition: in a way that shows a willingness to give money, help, kindness, etc., especially more than is usual or expected

examples.english: Please give generously to charity.
examples.chinese: 請為慈善事業慷慨解囊。

examples.english: She behaved very generously towards us, and wouldn't allow us to pay for anything.
examples.chinese: 她對我們特別大方，不讓我們支付任何費用。

items.englishDefinition: If two or more people get along, they like each other and are friendly to each other.

examples.english: I don't really get along with my sister's husband.
examples.chinese: 我跟姊夫／妹夫相處得不太好。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: To make progress or manage in a particular situation.

examples.english: I wonder how Michael is getting along in his new job?
examples.chinese: 我想知道麥可在新工作中進展如何。

items.englishDefinition: to respond to someone after obtaining information or having time
items.cue: 會議與溝通情境：get back to a customer
collocations: get back to someone with an answer
items.notes: 不可分：get back to you。後面接回覆對象，可用 with 加回覆內容。

examples.english: I will get back to you after I confirm the delivery date.
examples.chinese: 確認配送日期後，我會再回覆你。

examples.english: The account manager got back to the client with a revised quotation.
examples.chinese: 客戶經理以修訂後的報價回覆客戶。

collocations: get in touch with a client

examples.english: I will get in touch with the supplier this afternoon.
examples.chinese: 我今天下午會和供應商聯繫。

collocations: get off at the next stop

examples.english: Get off at the next stop and walk two blocks to the office.
examples.chinese: 在下一站下車，再走兩個街區就到辦公室。

items.meaning: 登上公車、火車等交通工具

examples.english: Please let passengers get off before you get on the train.
examples.chinese: 上火車前，請先讓乘客下車。

items.englishDefinition: to provide something to a group of people
items.cue: 行銷與客服情境：give out samples
items.notes: 可分：give them out。此處學分發，不是燃料耗盡或設備失靈的詞義。

examples.english: The sales team will give out free samples at the exhibition.
examples.chinese: 業務團隊將在展覽會發放免費樣品。

examples.english: We have fifty discount coupons and plan to give them out this afternoon.
examples.chinese: 我們有五十張折價券，計畫今天下午發放。

items.englishDefinition: to review something carefully
items.cue: 會議與溝通情境：go over a report
items.notes: 不可分：go over it。常用於會議前核對資料或逐項確認細節。

examples.english: Let's go over the presentation once more before the client arrives.
examples.chinese: 客戶抵達前，我們再仔細檢查一次簡報吧。

examples.english: I have read the contract, but I want to go over it with our adviser.
examples.chinese: 我已看過合約，但想和顧問再核對一次。

items.englishDefinition: to examine the contents of something in detail
items.cue: 職場與人事情境：go through applications
items.notes: 不可分：go through them。此處學逐一檢查，與經歷困難等其他詞義分開。

examples.english: The hiring team will go through all applications this week.
examples.chinese: 招聘團隊本週將逐一查看所有申請。

examples.english: These records are incomplete, so please go through them with the accountant.
examples.chinese: 這些紀錄不完整，請和會計逐一檢查。

items.englishDefinition: to give or allow someone something, usually in an official way

examples.english: They granted her an entry visa.
examples.chinese: 他們發給她入境簽證。

examples.english: She granted their request/wish.
examples.chinese: 她答應了他們的請求／滿足了他們的願望。

additionalSenses.meaning: （尤指政府為特殊目的給予個人或組織的）撥款，補助金
additionalSenses.englishDefinition: an amount of money given especially by the government to a person or organization for a special purpose

examples.english: They gave/awarded her a grant to study abroad for one year.
examples.chinese: 他們給／授予她一筆獎學金供她出國留學一年。

items.meaning: （尤指對其他人）感激的，表示感謝的
items.englishDefinition: showing or expressing thanks, especially to another person

examples.english: If you could get that report finished by Thursday, I'd be very grateful.
examples.chinese: 如果你能在星期四之前完成那份報告，我將感激不盡。

examples.english: After the earthquake we felt grateful to be alive.
examples.chinese: 地震後，我們大難不死，真是應該感謝上蒼。

items.englishDefinition: the feeling or quality of being grateful

examples.english: She sent them a present to show/express her gratitude.
examples.chinese: 她送了他們一件禮物，以表達她的感激之情。

examples.english: Take this as a token of my gratitude for all your help.
examples.chinese: 你幫了我那麼多忙，這個就當是我的一點心意吧。

examples.english: A gratuity is included in the bill for groups of eight or more.
examples.chinese: 八人以上團體的帳單中已包含小費。

items.meaning: 食品雜貨；日常採買的食品（groceries）
items.englishDefinition: Food and household supplies bought from a store.

examples.english: I was carrying three heavy bags of groceries.
examples.chinese: 我提著三袋沉重的食品雜貨。

items.englishDefinition: a grocer's

examples.english: There is a small grocery store next to the hotel.
examples.chinese: 飯店旁有一家小型雜貨店。

items.meaning: 保證;（尤指公司保證對產品保修或包退的）保修單，包換單
items.englishDefinition: a promise that something will be done or will happen, especially a written promise by a company to repair or change a product that develops a fault within a particular period of time

examples.english: The TV comes with/has a two-year guarantee.
examples.chinese: 這台電視機保修期為兩年。

examples.english: There is no guarantee (that) the discussions will lead to a deal.
examples.chinese: 商談不一定能達成任何協議。

examples.english: Hotel guests can use the gym at no extra charge.
examples.chinese: 飯店住客可以免費使用健身房。

items.englishDefinition: something that you do often and regularly, sometimes without knowing that you are doing it
items.notes:
habit 個人習慣
convention 表示團體、社會上一般的習慣 。慣例、習俗

examples.english: I always buy the same brand of toothpaste out of (= because of) habit.
examples.chinese: 我出於習慣總是買同一個牌子的牙膏。

examples.english: I'm trying not to get into (= start) the habit of always having biscuits with my coffee.
examples.chinese: 我盡量避免養成喝咖啡時總是吃餅乾的習慣。

examples.english: I used to swim twice a week, but I seem to have got out of (= ended) the habit recently.
examples.chinese: 我過去每週遊兩次泳，但最近似乎打破了這個習慣。

items.englishDefinition: to give a document to the person responsible for collecting it
items.cue: 職場與人事情境：hand in a report
items.notes: 可分：hand the report in；代名詞用 hand it in。常接 by 加截止時間。

examples.english: Please hand in your travel expense form by Tuesday.
examples.chinese: 請在星期二以前繳交差旅費表格。

examples.english: Your supervisor needs the report today, so hand it in before lunch.
examples.chinese: 主管今天需要這份報告，請在午餐前繳交。

items.englishDefinition: to give items to several people
items.cue: 會議與溝通情境：hand out materials
items.notes: 可分：hand the materials out；代名詞用 hand them out。

examples.english: The trainer will hand out the exercise sheets after the introduction.
examples.chinese: 講師將在介紹結束後分發練習單。

examples.english: The name tags are ready; please hand them out at the entrance.
examples.chinese: 名牌已準備好，請在入口處分發。

items.englishDefinition: only just; almost not

examples.english: I could hardly hear her at the back.
examples.chinese: 我在後面幾乎聽不見她說甚麽。

examples.english: Hardly had a moment passed before the door creaked open.
examples.chinese: 沒過一會兒，門就吱扭一聲打開了。

examples.english: All major decisions are made at the company's headquarters.
examples.chinese: 所有重大決策都在公司總部制定。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: the main offices of an organization such as the army, the police, or a business company

examples.english: The company's headquarters is/are in Amsterdam.
examples.chinese: 公司的總部在阿姆斯特丹。

examples.english: Please help yourself to coffee while you wait.
examples.chinese: 等候時，請自行取用咖啡。

examples.english: The store will hire extra staff for the holiday season.
examples.chinese: 這家商店將為假期旺季增聘員工。

items.englishDefinition: to prevent someone or something from proceeding on time
items.cue: 產品與物流情境：hold up a delivery
items.notes: 可分：hold the delivery up；代名詞用 hold it up。hold 的過去式為 held。

examples.english: A customs inspection held up the shipment for two days.
examples.chinese: 海關檢查使貨件延誤了兩天。

examples.english: One missing signature could hold up the entire approval process.
examples.chinese: 少了一個簽名可能耽擱整個核准流程。

items.englishDefinition: a quality that combines respect, being proud, and honesty

examples.english: We fought for the honour of our country.
examples.chinese: 我們為我們國家的榮譽而戰。

items.englishDefinition: the act of being friendly and welcoming to guests and visitors

examples.english: The local people showed me great hospitality.
examples.chinese: 當地人對我非常地熱情友好。

examples.english: Our hotel is a ten-minute walk from the station.
examples.chinese: 我們住的飯店距離車站步行十分鐘。

items.englishDefinition: perfect, or the best possible

examples.english: She's the ideal person (= exactly the right type of person) for the job.
examples.chinese: 她是這項工作的理想人選。

examples.english: It's the ideal opportunity to meet people.
examples.chinese: 這是結識朋友的絕好機會。

items.englishDefinition: the act of recognizing and naming someone or something

examples.english: Most of the bodies were badly burned, making identification almost impossible.
examples.chinese: 大部分屍體都嚴重燒焦，幾乎無法辨認。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: an official document that shows or proves who you are

examples.english: We were asked to show some identification before the security guards would let us in.
examples.chinese: 保安人員要我們出示身份證明文件才讓我們進去。

items.englishDefinition: to recognize someone or something and say or prove who or what that person or thing is

examples.english: Even the smallest baby can identify its mother by her voice.
examples.chinese: 即使是最小的嬰兒，也能從聲音辨認出自己的母親。

examples.english: The gunman in Wednesday's attack has been identified as Lee Giggs, an unemployed truck driver.
examples.chinese: 週三襲擊事件中的槍手已被確認為李‧吉格斯，一個失業的卡車司機。

items.englishDefinition: to show the meaning or truth of something more clearly, especially by giving examples

examples.english: The lecturer illustrated his point with a diagram on the blackboard.
examples.chinese: 講師在黑板上用圖表來說明自己的觀點。

examples.english: The exhibition will illustrate how life evolved from water.
examples.chinese: 這次展覽將展示生命是如何從水中演化而來的。

items.englishDefinition: now or without waiting or thinking
items.notes:
immediately after 在...之後馬上
immediately upon arrival 到達後馬上

examples.english: We really ought to leave immediately.
examples.chinese: 我們真的應該馬上就走。

examples.english: The purpose of the meeting wasn't immediately obvious.
examples.chinese: 會議的目的並不十分明確。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: close to something or someone in distance or time

examples.english: Milton Street is on the left, immediately after the bank.
examples.chinese: 密爾頓大街在左邊，一過銀行就是。

examples.english: They moved in immediately before Christmas.
examples.chinese: 他們在聖誕節前不久才搬進來。

items.englishDefinition: to make it more difficult for something to happen or more difficult for someone to do something

examples.english: Although he's shy, it certainly hasn't impeded his career in any way.
examples.chinese: 儘管他很害羞，但這顯然一點也沒有妨礙他的事業。

items.meaning: 極重要的；緊急的；迫切的
items.englishDefinition: extremely important or urgent

examples.english: The president said it was imperative that the release of all hostages be secured.
examples.chinese: 總統說當務之急是確保所有人質都獲釋。

examples.english: It's imperative to act now before the problem gets really serious.
examples.chinese: 必須現在就採取行動，而不是等到問題變得難以收拾。

items.englishDefinition: to start using a plan or system

examples.english: The changes to the national health system will be implemented next year.
examples.chinese: 國民醫療保健制度的改革將於明年實行。

items.englishDefinition: an occasion when you seem to suggest something without saying it directly

examples.english: From what she said, the implication was that they were splitting up.
examples.chinese: 她的話暗示他們將要分手。

examples.english: She accused the party and, by implication, its leader too.
examples.chinese: 她指責了該政黨，也含蓄地指責了該黨的領袖。

items.englishDefinition: to communicate an idea or feeling without saying it directly

examples.english: Are you implying (that) I'm fat?
examples.chinese: 你是在暗示我長得胖嗎？

examples.english: I'm not implying anything about your cooking, but could we eat out tonight?
examples.chinese: 我並不是暗示你做的飯不好吃，只是想提議我們今晚去外面吃，好嗎？

items.englishDefinition: to officially force a rule, tax, punishment, etc. to be obeyed or received
items.notes: im 進入，pose 放 ---> 把你放在一個被強迫的狀態 ---> 強製實行

examples.english: Very high taxes have recently been imposed on cigarettes.
examples.chinese: 最近對香煙開徵很高的稅。

examples.english: Judges are imposing increasingly heavy fines for minor driving offences.
examples.chinese: 法官對輕微的違規駕駛開始處以越來越重的罰款。

items.meaning: 感到印象深刻的；欽佩的
items.englishDefinition: Feeling admiration or respect because of what someone or something does.
items.notes:
impressed 感到印象深刻的 ( 說明情感 )
impressive 令人印象深刻的 ( 說明引起的人、事、物 )

examples.english: I remember when I was a child being very impressed with how many toys she had.
examples.chinese: 我記得小時候，她擁有那麼多玩具，讓我十分驚嘆。

examples.english: Your mother was clearly not impressed by our behaviour in the restaurant.
examples.chinese: 你母親顯然對我們在餐廳的行為不以為然。

items.meaning: （因特殊、重要或巨大而）給人留下深刻印象的
items.englishDefinition: If an object or achievement is impressive, you admire or respect it, usually because it is special, important, or very large.

examples.english: That was an impressive performance from such a young tennis player.
examples.chinese: 這麼年輕的網球選手居然打得那麼好。

examples.english: an impressive collection of modern paintings
examples.chinese: 令人讚歎的現代繪畫收藏品

items.meaning: 不大可能發生的;未必確實的
items.englishDefinition: not likely to happen or be true

examples.english: It's highly improbable that Norris will agree.
examples.chinese: 諾裡斯很可能不會同意。

examples.english: an improbable-sounding excuse
examples.chinese: 聽上去不大可信的藉口

items.englishDefinition: to (cause something to) get better

examples.english: He did a lot to improve conditions for factory workers.
examples.chinese: 他為改善工廠工人的工作條件做了許多工作。

examples.english: I thought the best way to improve my French was to live in France.
examples.chinese: 我認為提高我的法語水準的最好辦法是到法國生活。

items.meaning: （演員）即興表演;（音樂家）即興創作
items.englishDefinition: When actors or musicians improvise, they perform without prepared speech or music, making up the play, music, etc. as they perform it.

examples.english: During certain scenes of the play there isn't any script and the actors just improvise (the dialogue).
examples.chinese: 這齣戲有幾場沒有劇本，演員就即興表演（對白）。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: to invent or make something, such as a speech or a device, at the time when it is needed without already having planned it

examples.english: I hadn't prepared a speech so I suddenly had to improvise.
examples.chinese: 我沒有準備演講，所以突然之間我只好即興講幾句。

examples.english: We improvised a mattress from a pile of blankets.
examples.chinese: 為了能有地方睡覺，我們臨時用一堆毯子作床墊。

items.englishDefinition: before a particular time or event

examples.english: Guests must notify the front desk in advance to reserve an airport shuttle.
examples.chinese: 房客必須事先通知櫃檯，以預約機場接駁車。

items.meaning: 為了慶祝……；為了表示對……的敬意
items.englishDefinition: in order to celebrate or show great respect for someone or something

examples.english: a banquet in honour of the president
examples.chinese: 為總統舉行的宴會

examples.english: You must collect the document in person and show your ID.
examples.chinese: 你必須親自領取文件，並出示身分證件。

examples.english: The blue model is in stock and can be shipped today.
examples.chinese: 藍色款有現貨，今天就能出貨。

items.englishDefinition: very difficult or impossible to travel to or reach

examples.english: one of the most inaccessible places in the world
examples.chinese: 世界上最難到達的地方之一

examples.english: Some of the houses on the hillside are inaccessible to cars.
examples.chinese: 山坡上的一些房屋開車上不去。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: difficult to understand or admire

examples.english: Why is opera so inaccessible to so many people?
examples.chinese: 為甚麼歌劇有這麼多人無法欣賞？

examples.english: I found his lecture completely inaccessible.
examples.chinese: 我發覺他的講座完全聽不懂。

items.englishDefinition: not completely correct or exact, or not able to do something correctly or exactly

examples.english: Their estimate of the cost of the project was wildly (= extremely) inaccurate.
examples.chinese: 他們對專案費用的估計非常不準確。

examples.english: an inaccurate device/weapon
examples.chinese: 不精確的設備／武器

items.englishDefinition: something that encourages a person to do something

examples.english: There is little incentive for people to leave their cars at home when public transport remains so expensive.
examples.chinese: 公共交通的費用居高不下，無法激勵人們停開私家車。

examples.english: Bonus payments provide an incentive to work harder.
examples.chinese: 支付獎金能鼓勵人們更努力工作。

items.englishDefinition: less important than the thing something is connected with or part of
items.notes:
in- = into，
cad, cas, cid = 發生，下落
-ent 名詞、形容詞字尾
incident 發生了事件

examples.english: Try not to be distracted by incidental details.
examples.chinese: 盡量不要為一些次要的枝節問題分心。

examples.english: The points you make are true, but they're incidental to the main problem.
examples.chinese: 你的看法都正確，但它們對主要問題而言只是枝節性的。

items.englishDefinition: causing problems or difficulties

examples.english: an inconvenient time/place
examples.chinese: 不方便的時間／地點

examples.english: It will be very inconvenient for me to have no car.
examples.chinese: 沒有車對我來說會很不方便。

items.englishDefinition: impossible, or very difficult, to believe

examples.english: The latest missiles can be fired with incredible accuracy.
examples.chinese: 最新型導彈的準確度高得令人難以置信。

examples.english: It seems incredible that no one foresaw the crisis.
examples.chinese: 令人難以置信的是沒有人預見到危機會發生。

items.englishDefinition: to experience something, usually something unpleasant, as a result of actions you have taken

examples.english: The play has incurred the wrath/anger of both audiences and critics.
examples.chinese: 這部劇引起了觀眾和評論家的憤怒。

examples.english: Please detail any costs/expenses incurred by you in attending the interview.
examples.chinese: 請詳細列出你參加這次面試所產生的一切費用。

items.englishDefinition: used to express that something is correct

examples.english: "Is this your dog?" "It is indeed."/"Indeed it is."
examples.chinese: 「這是你的狗嗎？」「當然是。」

examples.english: Yes, I did indeed say that.
examples.chinese: 是的，我確實那樣說過。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: really or certainly, often used to emphasize something

examples.english: Evidence suggests that errors may indeed be occurring.
examples.chinese: 證據顯示可能確實出錯了。

examples.english: Indeed, it could be the worst environmental disaster in Europe this century.
examples.chinese: 的確，這可能是本世紀歐洲最嚴重的環境災難。

items.englishDefinition: not influenced or controlled in any way by other people, events, or things

examples.english: an independent enquiry/organization
examples.chinese: 獨立調查／機構

examples.english: They all made the same comment, quite independent of each other (= without deciding together to do so).
examples.chinese: 他們都不約而同作出了相同的評論。

items.englishDefinition: to show, point, or make clear in another way

examples.english: Please indicate which free gift you would like to receive.
examples.chinese: 請標出你想要哪種免費禮物。

examples.english: Exploratory investigations have indicated large amounts of oil below the sea bed.
examples.chinese: 勘測調查顯示海床下有大量的石油。

items.englishDefinition: a sign that something exists, is true, or is likely to happen

examples.english: There are few indications (that) the economy is on an upswing.
examples.chinese: 沒有甚麼跡象顯示經濟正在好轉。

examples.english: Helen's face gave no indication of what she was thinking.
examples.chinese: 從海倫的臉上看不出她在想甚麼。

items.englishDefinition: something that shows what a situation is like

examples.english: Commodity prices can be a useful indicator of inflation, he claimed.
examples.chinese: 他聲稱，商品價格可以作為一種有用的通貨膨脹指標。

examples.english: an economic indicator
examples.chinese: 經濟指標

items.englishDefinition: a single person or thing, especially when compared to the group or set to which they belong
items.notes:
In 不+divid 分割 +ual 與某事物相關的 某一個體=
不可再分割的單一個體

examples.english: Every individual has rights which must never be taken away.
examples.chinese: 每個人都有一些不可剝奪的權利。

examples.english: Like many creative individuals, she can be very bad-tempered.
examples.chinese: 像許多富有創造力的人一樣，她的脾氣有時會很不好。

items.englishDefinition: to cause something to happen

examples.english: Pills for seasickness often induce drowsiness.
examples.chinese: 暈船藥經常會令人昏昏欲睡。

items.englishDefinition: to allow yourself or another person to have something enjoyable, especially more than is good for you

examples.english: The soccer fans indulged their patriotism, waving flags and singing songs.
examples.chinese: 足球迷搖著旗唱著歌，縱情抒發他們的愛國熱情。

examples.english: I love champagne but I don't often indulge myself.
examples.chinese: 我愛喝香檳，但一般都有節制。

items.englishDefinition: the companies and activities involved in the process of producing goods for sale, especially in a factory or special area

examples.english: The city needs to attract more industry.
examples.chinese: 這個城市需要吸引更多的工業。

examples.english: The strike seriously reduced coal deliveries to industry.
examples.chinese: 罷工使得向工業輸送的煤炭量大幅下降。

items.englishDefinition: having little knowledge or experience

examples.english: They are young inexperienced parents and need support.
examples.chinese: 他們是缺乏經驗的年輕父母，需要得到幫助。

items.englishDefinition: a general, continuous increase in prices

examples.english: high/low inflation
examples.chinese: 高／低通貨膨脹

examples.english: A high inflation rate affects the company's net gains.
examples.chinese: 高通膨率會影響這家公司的淨利。

items.englishDefinition: to force someone to experience something very unpleasant

examples.english: These new bullets are capable of inflicting massive injuries.
examples.chinese: 這些新型子彈可以造成重創。

examples.english: The suffering inflicted on these children was unimaginable.
examples.chinese: 這些孩子遭受的痛苦無法想像。

items.englishDefinition: to affect or change how someone or something develops, behaves, or thinks

examples.english: She's very good at making friends and influencing people.
examples.chinese: 她很擅長交友並對他人施加影響。

examples.english: What influenced you to choose a career in nursing?
examples.chinese: 甚麼使你選擇了護士這個職業？

items.englishDefinition: to tell someone about particular facts
items.notes:
inform + 人 + of + 內容／that 子句：通知、告知。
explain (to 人) + that 子句：解釋、說明。

examples.english: The name of the dead man will not be released until his relatives have been informed.
examples.chinese: 在通知死者親屬之前，不會公佈死者的姓名。

examples.english: Why wasn't I informed about this earlier?
examples.chinese: 為甚麼不早點將這件事通知我？

examples.english: I informed my boss that I was going to be away next week.
examples.chinese: 我告訴老闆下周我不在。

items.meaning: 非正式的，非正規的;（服裝）日常使用的;（言行）隨意的
items.englishDefinition: (of situations) not formal or official, or (of clothing, behaviour, speech) suitable when you are with friends and family but not for official occasions

examples.english: The two groups agreed to hold an informal meeting.
examples.chinese: 兩個集團同意舉行一次非正式會議。

examples.english: "Hi" is an informal way of greeting people.
examples.chinese: 「喂」是一種隨意的問候方式。

examples.english: He's the ideal sort of teacher - direct, friendly, and informal.
examples.chinese: 他屬於那種理想的教師——坦率、友好且不拘禮節。

items.meaning: 提供資訊的；增長見聞的
items.englishDefinition: providing a lot of useful information

examples.english: This is an interesting and highly informative book.
examples.chinese: 這是一本有趣且資訊豐富的書。

items.meaning: 見多識廣的;了解情況的
items.englishDefinition: having a lot of knowledge or information about something

examples.english: The school promised to keep parents informed about the situation.
examples.chinese: 該學校保證讓家長了解有關情況。

examples.english: Elizabeth is remarkably well-informed.
examples.chinese: 伊莉莎白見多識廣。

items.englishDefinition: to make someone extremely angry

examples.english: His sexist attitude infuriates me.
examples.chinese: 他歧視女性的態度讓我很生氣。

examples.english: The restaurant uses fresh local ingredients in every dish.
examples.chinese: 這家餐廳每道菜都使用新鮮的在地食材。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: a food that is used with other foods in the preparation of a particular dish
additionalSenses.notes:
字根：grad- = grade等級
gred-, grad-母音通轉
in- = in
-ent 指人或物

examples.english: The list of ingredients included 250 g of almonds.
examples.chinese: 清單上列出的材料包括250克的杏仁。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: one of the parts of something successful

examples.english: Trust is a vital ingredient in a successful marriage.
examples.chinese: 信任是婚姻幸福的重要因素。

items.englishDefinition: to live in a place

examples.english: These remote islands are inhabited only by birds.
examples.chinese: 這些偏僻的島嶼上只有鳥類棲息。

items.meaning: 內在地;固有地，本質上地
items.englishDefinition: in a way that exists as a natural or basic part of something

examples.english: There's nothing inherently wrong with his ideas.
examples.chinese: 他的想法本質上沒有錯。

examples.english: She felt that the system was inherently unfair and unequal.
examples.chinese: 她覺得這個制度本身就是不公平和不平等的。

items.englishDefinition: at the beginning

examples.english: Initially, most people approved of the new plan.
examples.chinese: 起初，大部分人都同意這個新方案。

examples.english: The damage was far more serious than initially believed.
examples.chinese: 損失比開始認為的要嚴重得多。

items.englishDefinition: An innate quality or ability is one that you were born with, not one you have learned.

examples.english: Cyril's most impressive quality was his innate goodness.
examples.chinese: 西裡爾給人印象最深的品質是他天生的善良。

items.englishDefinition: using new methods or ideas

examples.english: innovative ideas/methods
examples.chinese: 創新的思想／方法

examples.english: She was an imaginative and innovative manager.
examples.chinese: 她是個具有想像力和創新精神的經理。

items.englishDefinition: to ask for information

examples.english: Shall I inquire about the price of tickets?
examples.chinese: 我可以問一下票價嗎？

examples.english: She called to inquire when her car would be ready.
examples.chinese: 她打電話詢問她的車何時能準備好。

items.cue: A question sent to a business

examples.english: We aim to respond to all inquiries within one business day.
examples.chinese: 我們的目標是在一個工作天內回覆所有詢問。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: (the process of asking) a question

examples.english: Inquiry into the matter is pointless - no one will tell you anything.
examples.chinese: 打聽這件事沒有用——沒有人會告訴你。

examples.english: I've been making inquiries about/into the cost of a round-the-world ticket.
examples.chinese: 我一直在打聽環遊世界的票價。

items.englishDefinition: (the ability to have) a clear, deep, and sometimes sudden understanding of a complicated problem or situation

examples.english: It was an interesting book, full of fascinating insights into human relationships.
examples.chinese: 這是一本有趣的書，充滿了對人際關係獨到的見解。

examples.english: Please inspect the goods for damage before signing the form.
examples.chinese: 簽署表格前，請檢查貨物是否受損。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: to look at something or someone carefully in order to discover information, especially about their quality or condition

examples.english: After the crash both drivers got out and inspected their cars for damage.
examples.chinese: 撞車後，兩輛車的司機都下來檢查各自的車有無損壞。

examples.english: She held the bank note up to the light and inspected it carefully.
examples.chinese: 她舉起鈔票，對著光仔細檢查。

items.englishDefinition: the act of looking at something carefully, or an official visit to a building or organization to check that everything is correct and legal

examples.english: Her passport seemed legitimate, but on closer inspection, it was found to have been altered.
examples.chinese: 她的護照看似合法，但仔細檢查，發現做過手腳。

examples.english: She arrived to carry out/make a health and safety inspection of the building.
examples.chinese: 她來對大樓進行安全衛生檢查。

items.englishDefinition: someone whose job is to officially inspect something

examples.english: a tax inspector
examples.chinese: 稅務稽查員

examples.english: a school inspector/an inspector of schools
examples.chinese: 督學

items.englishDefinition: someone or something that gives you ideas for doing something

examples.english: The golden autumn light provided the inspiration for the painting.
examples.chinese: 秋天金色的陽光給這幅畫的創作帶來了靈感。

examples.english: He went to church, perhaps seeking divine inspiration.
examples.chinese: 他去做禮拜，也許為的是尋找神的啟示。

additionalSenses.meaning: 靈感;突然想出的好主意
additionalSenses.englishDefinition: a sudden good idea

examples.english: He had an inspiration - why not apply for some government money?
examples.chinese: 他突然想到一個好主意——為甚麼不去申請一些政府資金呢？

examples.english: The technician will install the new air conditioner on Tuesday.
examples.chinese: 技術人員將於星期二安裝新的冷氣機。

examples.english: The final installment is due next month.
examples.chinese: 最後一期款項將於下個月到期。

additionalSenses.meaning: 分期付款；每期應付的款項
additionalSenses.englishDefinition: One of a series of regular payments made until an amount owed is fully paid.

examples.english: The shop allows buyers to pay for furniture in monthly installments.
examples.chinese: 這家店允許顧客按月分期付款購買家具。

items.englishDefinition: immediately

examples.english: Both drivers were killed instantly.
examples.chinese: 兩名司機當場喪生。

items.englishDefinition: to order or tell someone to do something, especially in a formal way

examples.english: The police have been instructed to patrol the building and surrounding area.
examples.chinese: 員警奉命在這幢大樓裡及周圍地區巡邏。

items.englishDefinition: something that someone tells you to do

examples.english: The police who broke into the house were only acting on/under instructions.
examples.chinese: 員警破門而入只是奉命行事。

examples.english: He gave me strict instructions to get there by eight o'clock.
examples.chinese: 他命令我必須在八點以前到達那裡。

items.meaning: 不夠的，不足的；不充分的
items.englishDefinition: not enough

examples.english: There was insufficient money to fund the project.
examples.chinese: 沒有足夠的資金來支持這個專案。

examples.english: insufficient information/time
examples.chinese: 不充足的資訊／時間

items.englishDefinition: an agreement in which you pay a company money and they pay your costs if you have an accident, injury, etc.

examples.english: I'll need to take out extra car insurance for another driver.
examples.chinese: 我需要為另一名駕駛者購買汽車保險。

examples.english: The insurance doesn't cover you for (= include) household items.
examples.chinese: 這份保險沒有包括你的家居物品。

examples.english: Employees can join the company's health insurance plan.
examples.chinese: 員工可以加入公司的健康保險方案。

items.englishDefinition: to have as a plan or purpose

examples.english: We intend to go to Australia next year.
examples.chinese: 我們打算明年去澳大利亞。

examples.english: Somehow I offended him, which wasn't what I'd intended.
examples.chinese: 我不知怎麼得罪了他，但這不是我的初衷。

examples.english: I don't think she intended me to hear the remark.
examples.chinese: 我覺得她並不想讓我聽見那句話。

items.englishDefinition: to become greater, more serious, or more extreme, or to make something do this
items.notes:
intensify / strengthen / reinforce：加強、強化。
steady：使穩定。

examples.english: Fighting around the capital has intensified in the last few hours.
examples.chinese: 首都周圍的戰鬥在過去的幾小時裡變得更加激烈。

examples.english: We could hear the wind howling outside as the storm intensified.
examples.chinese: 隨著暴風雨的加劇，我們可以聽到外面的風在呼嘯

items.meaning: 密集地，集中地;加強地;深入地
items.englishDefinition: in a way that involves a lot of effort or activity in a short period of time or small area

examples.english: She is studying intensively, working toward her degree.
examples.chinese: 她正在緊張地學習，為獲得學位而努力。

examples.english: Despite much intensively farmed land, this is one of the wildest regions of lowland England.
examples.chinese: 儘管有許多土地被密集耕作，這裡仍是英格蘭低地最具荒野風貌的地區之一。

items.englishDefinition: something that you want and plan to do

examples.english: It wasn't my intention to exclude her from the list - I just forgot her.
examples.chinese: 我並不是故意將她排除在名單之外——只是把她忘了而已。

examples.english: He's full of good intentions, but he never does anything about them!
examples.chinese: 他有很多好的打算，但從未有過實際行動！

items.meaning: 交流，交往;相互作用，互相影響
items.englishDefinition: to communicate with or react to

examples.english: Dominique's teacher says that she interacts well with the other children.
examples.chinese: 多明尼克的老師說她與別的孩子相處得很好。

examples.english: It's interesting at parties to see how people interact socially.
examples.chinese: 在聚會上看人們如何交流溝通是很有趣的。

examples.english: We are studying how these two chemicals interact.
examples.chinese: 我們在研究這兩種化學物質是如何相互作用的。

items.englishDefinition: to involve yourself in a situation when your involvement is not wanted or is not helpful

examples.english: It's their problem and I'm not going to interfere.
examples.chinese: 那是他們的問題，我不想干涉。

examples.english: Interfering in other people's relationships is always a mistake.
examples.chinese: 干涉他人談戀愛從來都是不對的。

items.englishDefinition: the place where two or more roads join or cross each other

examples.english: a busy intersection
examples.chinese: 繁忙的十字路口

examples.english: Turn right at the next intersection.
examples.chinese: 在下個十字路口向右轉。

examples.english: My job interview is scheduled for Monday morning.
examples.chinese: 我的求職面試安排在星期一早上。

items.englishDefinition: to tell someone another person's name the first time that they meet

examples.english: I'd like to introduce my son, Mark.
examples.chinese: 我想介紹一下我的兒子馬克。

examples.english: Have you two been introduced (to each other)?
examples.chinese: 介紹你們倆認識了嗎？

items.englishDefinition: something that has never been made before, or the process of creating something that has never been made before

examples.english: The world changed rapidly after the invention of the phone.
examples.chinese: 電話發明後世界的變化日新月異。

examples.english: a most amazing invention
examples.chinese: 非常了不起的發明

examples.english: We check our inventory every Friday afternoon.
examples.chinese: 我們每個星期五下午都會盤點庫存。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: a detailed list of all the things in a place

examples.english: A set of 24 gilded chairs appear on the inventory of the house for 1736.
examples.chinese: 這幢房子1736年的物品清單上列有一套雕花鍍金椅子，共24把。

items.englishDefinition: to put money, effort, time, etc. into something to make a profit or get an advantage

examples.english: He's not certain whether to invest in the property market.
examples.chinese: 他拿不定主意該不該投資房地產市場。

examples.english: You have all invested significant amounts of time and energy in making this project the success that it is.
examples.chinese: 你們都為這個專案的成功投入了大量的時間和精力。

items.meaning: （對罪案、問題、陳述等的）調查，偵查（尤指為了發現真相）
items.englishDefinition: the act or process of examining a crime, problem, statement, etc. carefully, especially to discover the truth

examples.english: a full/thorough investigation of the incident
examples.chinese: 對該事件全面的調查

examples.english: Currently, the individuals who might have caused the accident are subject to/under investigation.
examples.chinese: 目前，所有可能引發這次意外的人士都在接受調查。

items.meaning: 投資（付諸金錢、努力、時間等以求得到利潤或取得成就某事的有利條件）;投資物，投資額
items.englishDefinition: the act of putting money, effort, time, etc. into something to make a profit or get an advantage, or the money, effort, time, etc. used to do this

examples.english: The government wanted an inflow of foreign investment.
examples.chinese: 政府希望看到外資湧入。

examples.english: Stocks are regarded as good long-term investments.
examples.chinese: 證券被認為是很好的長期投資產品。

examples.english: Please include the invoice number when making your payment.
examples.chinese: 付款時，請註明發票號碼。

additionalSenses.meaning: 開立帳單或發票；向……請款
additionalSenses.englishDefinition: to supply an invoice

examples.english: We'll invoice you for parts and labour.
examples.chinese: 我們將給你一份零件和人工的費用清單。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: a list of things provided or work done together with their cost, for payment at a later time

examples.english: Invoices must be submitted by the 24th of every month.
examples.chinese: 費用清單必須在每月的24日之前交上來。

items.englishDefinition: If an activity, situation, etc. involves something, that thing is a part of the activity, etc.

examples.english: Research involving the use of biological warfare agents will be used for defensive purposes.
examples.chinese: 與使用生物戰手段有關的研究將用來防禦。

examples.english: The operation involves putting a small tube into your heart.
examples.chinese: 這項手術需要在你的心臟裡放一根小管。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: to include someone in something, or to make them take part in or feel part of it

examples.english: I prefer teaching methods that actively involve students in learning.
examples.chinese: 我較喜歡能讓學生主動參與學習的教學法。

examples.english: She's been involved with animal rights for many years.
examples.chinese: 她多年來一直參與保護動物權益的活動。

items.englishDefinition: being in a close relationship with someone

examples.english: Try not to become too emotionally involved with the children in your care.
examples.chinese: 盡量不要對你所照顧的孩子過於牽腸掛肚。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: not simple and therefore difficult to understand

examples.english: The plot of the film was too involved - I couldn't understand it.
examples.chinese: 這部影片的情節過分複雜——我看不懂。

items.englishDefinition: not related to what is being discussed or considered and therefore not important

examples.english: These documents are largely irrelevant to the present investigation.
examples.chinese: 這些文件與目前的調查幾乎毫不相干。

examples.english: Making a large profit is irrelevant to us - the important thing is to make the book available to the largest possible audience.
examples.chinese: 賺取巨額利潤對我們來說並不重要，重要的是要讓儘可能多的讀者讀到這本書。

examples.english: The travel agency will issue your ticket after payment.
examples.chinese: 旅行社會在付款後開立你的機票。

examples.english: We are working to resolve the issue with online payments.
examples.chinese: 我們正在設法解決線上付款的問題。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: a subject or problem that people are thinking and talking about

examples.english: As employers we need to be seen to be addressing (= dealing with) these issues sympathetically.
examples.chinese: 作為僱主，我們需要讓大家知道我們在處理這些問題時富有同情心。

examples.english: Don't worry about who will do it - that's just a side issue (= not the main problem).
examples.chinese: 不要擔心這件事由誰來做——那只是次要問題。

items.cue: A single thing in an order

examples.english: One item is missing from the package.
examples.chinese: 包裹裡少了一件物品。

examples.english: I will email you the itinerary for next week's business trip.
examples.chinese: 我會寄電子郵件給你，附上下週出差的行程表。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: a detailed plan or route of a journey

examples.english: The tour operator will arrange transport and plan your itinerary.
examples.chinese: 旅行社工作人員將負責安排交通和行程計劃。

items.englishDefinition: to stay at the same pace as work or changing information
items.cue: 職場與人事情境：keep up with demand
items.notes: 不可分：keep up with them。與 catch up on（補做落下的工作）區別。

examples.english: The warehouse hired more staff to keep up with rising demand.
examples.chinese: 倉庫增聘人手，以跟上不斷增加的需求。

examples.english: Regular training helps employees keep up with changes in the software.
examples.chinese: 定期訓練能幫助員工跟上軟體的變化。

items.englishDefinition: to continue to exist

examples.english: The meeting lasted two hours.
examples.chinese: 會議持續了兩個小時。

examples.english: The drought lasted for several months.
examples.chinese: 乾旱持續了好幾個月。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: (the person or thing) after everyone or everything else

examples.english: I hate being the last one to arrive at a meeting.
examples.chinese: 我不願意開會時最後一個到。

examples.english: Our house is the last one on the left before the traffic lights.
examples.chinese: 我們家是交通信號燈前左側的最後一家。

examples.english: The company will launch a new delivery service in June.
examples.chinese: 這家公司將在六月推出新的配送服務。

items.meaning: （尤指房屋附近或公園的）草地，草坪
items.englishDefinition: an area of grass, especially near to a house or in a park, that is cut regularly to keep it short

examples.english: Will you mow the lawn at the weekend?
examples.chinese: 週末你修剪一下草坪好嗎？

items.englishDefinition: without much care, attention, or control

examples.english: The subcommittee contends that the authorities were lax in investigating most of the cases.
examples.chinese: 小組委員會認為有關部門對多宗案件疏於調查。

examples.english: He took a gun through baggage control to highlight the lax security.
examples.chinese: 他攜帶一把槍通過了行李檢查，以此引起大家對安全管理鬆懈這一問題的重視。

items.englishDefinition: to end workers' employment because the business has less work
items.cue: 職場與人事情境：lay off workers
items.notes: 可分：lay the workers off；代名詞用 lay them off。過去式 laid off，與員工自行 resign 不同。

examples.english: The factory had to lay off some workers after losing a major contract.
examples.chinese: 工廠失去一份重要合約後，不得不裁減部分員工。

examples.english: The company hopes to avoid laying off staff by reducing other expenses.
examples.chinese: 公司希望透過減少其他支出來避免裁員。

items.englishDefinition: to control a group of people, a country, or a situation

examples.english: I've asked Gemma to lead the discussion.
examples.chinese: 我已請傑瑪帶領大家討論。

examples.english: Who will be leading the inquiry into the accident?
examples.chinese: 誰來領導事故的調查工作？

examples.english: The plumber found a leak under the kitchen sink.
examples.chinese: 水管工在廚房水槽下方發現了一處漏水。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: to allow secret information to become generally known

examples.english: He leaked the names to the press.
examples.chinese: 他向新聞界透露了名單。

examples.english: News of the pay cuts had somehow leaked out.
examples.chinese: 降薪的消息不知怎的被洩漏了出去。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: (of a liquid or gas) to escape from a hole or crack in a pipe or container; (of a container) to allow liquid or gas to escape

examples.english: Water was leaking from the pipe.
examples.chinese: 水正從管子裡漏出來。

examples.english: Oil leaked out of the car.
examples.chinese: 油從車裡漏了出來。

items.englishDefinition: to make a legal agreement by which money is paid in order to use land, a building, a vehicle, or a piece of equipment for an agreed period of time

examples.english: The building's 60 units are currently leased to students of the university.
examples.chinese: 這棟樓裡的60個單元目前租給了這間大學的學生。

examples.english: It was agreed they would lease the apartment to him/lease him the apartment.
examples.chinese: 按照約定他們要把公寓租給他。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: a legal agreement in which you pay money in order to use a building, piece of land, vehicle, etc. for a period

examples.english: He has the house on a long lease.
examples.chinese: 他以長期租約租下這棟房子。

examples.english: We signed a three-year lease when we moved into the house.
examples.chinese: 我們搬進那所房子時簽了一份三年的租約。

examples.english: Please apply for annual leave at least one week in advance.
examples.chinese: 請至少提前一週申請年假。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: time allowed away from work for a holiday or illness

examples.english: I've asked if I can take a week's unpaid leave.
examples.chinese: 我已經問過能不能請一周無薪假期。

examples.english: She's (gone) on leave (= holiday).
examples.chinese: 她去休假了。

items.englishDefinition: a formal talk on a serious subject given to a group of people, especially students

examples.english: We went to a lecture on Italian art.
examples.chinese: 我們去參加了一個關於義大利藝術的講座。

examples.english: Who's giving the lecture this afternoon?
examples.chinese: 今天下午的課由誰來講？

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: an angry or serious talk given to someone in order to criticize their behaviour

examples.english: My dad gave me a lecture on the evils of alcohol last night.
examples.chinese: 昨天晚上爸爸教訓了我一頓，給我講了酒的危害。

items.englishDefinition: a law or set of laws suggested by a government and made official by a parliament

examples.english: The government has promised to introduce legislation to limit fuel emissions from cars.
examples.chinese: 政府承諾將透過立法來限制汽車廢氣排放。

items.englishDefinition: the time when you are not working or doing other duties

examples.english: Most people only have a limited amount of leisure time.
examples.chinese: 大多數人只有有限的空閒時間。

examples.english: The town lacks leisure facilities such as a swimming pool or squash courts.
examples.chinese: 這個城鎮缺少游泳池、壁球場等休閒設施。

examples.english: leisure activities
examples.chinese: 休閒活動

items.englishDefinition: to give something to someone for a short period of time, expecting it to be given back

examples.english: She doesn't like lending her books.
examples.chinese: 她不喜歡把書借給別人。

examples.english: If you need a coat I can lend you one/lend one to you.
examples.chinese: 你如果需要外衣，我可以借給你一件。

items.meaning: 承擔責任的;負有（法律）責任的
items.englishDefinition: having (legal) responsibility for something or someone

examples.english: The law holds parents liable if a child does not attend school.
examples.chinese: 法律規定孩子不上學父母要負責任。

examples.english: If we lose the case we may be liable for (= have to pay) the costs of the whole trial.
examples.chinese: 如果我們輸掉了這場官司，就可能要承擔官司的全部費用。

examples.english: Please meet the tour guide in the lobby at eight.
examples.chinese: 請在八點到大廳與導遊會合。

items.englishDefinition: to enter a computer system using account details
items.cue: 設施與環境情境：log in to a system
items.notes: 常用 log in to 加系統名稱，或 log in with 加登入方式。log in 是動詞，login 常作名詞或形容詞。

examples.english: Please log in to the staff portal to view your schedule.
examples.chinese: 請登入員工入口網站查看你的班表。

examples.english: You can log in with your employee number and temporary password.
examples.chinese: 你可以用員工編號和臨時密碼登入。

items.englishDefinition: to end an account session on a computer system
items.cue: 設施與環境情境：log out of a system
items.notes: 常用 log out of 加系統名稱；與 log in 相反。

examples.english: Remember to log out of the shared computer after checking your email.
examples.chinese: 查看郵件後，記得登出共用電腦。

examples.english: The system will log you out automatically after twenty minutes of inactivity.
examples.chinese: 系統會在你閒置二十分鐘後自動將你登出。

items.englishDefinition: to take care of a person or thing
items.cue: 旅遊與生活情境：look after guests
items.notes: 不可分：look after them。與 look for（尋找）及 look into（調查）區別。

examples.english: The tour guide will look after the guests during the excursion.
examples.chinese: 導遊將在短途旅行期間照料旅客。

examples.english: Could you look after my bag while I speak to the receptionist?
examples.chinese: 我和接待人員說話時，你能幫我看管行李嗎？

examples.english: We look forward to meeting you at the conference.
examples.chinese: 我們期待在研討會上與你見面。

items.englishDefinition: to examine an issue to learn more about it
items.cue: 行銷與客服情境：look into a complaint
items.notes: 不可分：look into it，不用 look it into。常用於客服回覆與問題調查。

examples.english: Our support team will look into the missing shipment today.
examples.chinese: 我們的客服團隊今天將調查遺失的貨件。

examples.english: Thank you for reporting the error; we are looking into it.
examples.chinese: 謝謝你回報錯誤，我們正在調查。

items.englishDefinition: to search a reference source for information
items.cue: 職場與人事情境：look up a number
items.notes: 可分：look the number up；代名詞用 look it up。與 look for（尋找人或物）不同。

examples.english: You can look up the product code in the online catalog.
examples.chinese: 你可以在網路型錄查找產品代碼。

examples.english: I do not know the extension number, but I can look it up.
examples.chinese: 我不知道分機號碼，但可以查一下。

examples.english: The restaurant made a loss during its first three months.
examples.chinese: 這家餐廳在最初三個月出現了虧損。

examples.english: The bakery has many loyal customers in the neighborhood.
examples.chinese: 這家麵包店在附近有許多忠實顧客。

items.meaning: （尤指生意、職位或活動）賺錢的，盈利的
items.englishDefinition: (especially of a business, job, or activity) producing a lot of money

examples.english: The merger proved to be very lucrative for both companies.
examples.chinese: 事實證明，這次兼併使兩間公司都獲利豐厚。

items.englishDefinition: either of the two organs in the chest with which people and some animals breathe

examples.english: lung cancer
examples.chinese: 肺癌

examples.english: Please turn off the machine when you finish.
examples.chinese: 使用完畢後，請關閉機器。

examples.english: The elevator is closed for maintenance this morning.
examples.chinese: 電梯今天早上因維護而暫停使用。

items.meaning: 較重要的；主要的；重大的
items.englishDefinition: more important, bigger, or more serious than others of the same type

examples.english: All of her major plays have been translated into English.
examples.chinese: 她的主要劇本都被譯成了英文。

examples.english: Sugar is a major cause of tooth decay.
examples.chinese: 糖是造成蛀牙的主要原因。

examples.english: The United States is a major influence in the United Nations.
examples.chinese: 美國是聯合國中具重大影響力的國家。

items.englishDefinition: the larger number or part of something

examples.english: The majority of the employees have university degrees.
examples.chinese: 大部分員工都有大學文憑。

examples.english: A large majority of people approve of the death sentence.
examples.chinese: 大多數人贊成死刑。

examples.english: I would like to make a reservation for four people at seven.
examples.chinese: 我想預訂七點的四人座位。

items.englishDefinition: to provide something that compensates for a loss or problem
items.cue: 行銷與客服情境：make up for a delay
items.notes: 不可分：make up for it。與 make up（編造、和好等）分開學。

examples.english: The hotel offered a free breakfast to make up for the check-in delay.
examples.chinese: 飯店提供免費早餐，以彌補入住報到的延誤。

examples.english: The team worked faster to make up for the time lost during the outage.
examples.chinese: 團隊加快工作速度，以補回停電期間損失的時間。

examples.english: A malfunction in the heating system forced the office to close.
examples.chinese: 暖氣系統故障，迫使辦公室暫時關閉。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: a failure to work or operate correctly
additionalSenses.notes: 沒有 function

examples.english: Shortly before the crash the pilot had reported a malfunction of the aircraft's navigation system.
examples.chinese: 就在飛機墜毀前不久，飛行員曾報告說導航系統失靈。

examples.english: The manager approved our request for new chairs.
examples.chinese: 主管核准了我們購買新椅子的申請。

items.meaning: 經理的；管理的；經營上的
items.englishDefinition: relating to a manager or management

examples.english: managerial responsibilities/decisions/skills
examples.chinese: 管理職責／管理決策／管理技能

examples.english: managerial staff/experience
examples.chinese: 管理人員／管理經驗

items.englishDefinition: the authority given to an elected group of people, such as a government, to perform an action or govern a country
items.notes:
mandate 作名詞：授權、命令；作動詞：正式要求或授權。
delegate 作動詞：把任務／權責委派給他人；作名詞：代表。

examples.english: The president secured the Congressional mandate to go to war by three votes.
examples.chinese: 總統以三票的優勢獲得了國會對開戰的授權。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: To officially require a person to do something.
additionalSenses.notes:
mandate 作名詞：授權、命令；作動詞：正式要求或授權。
delegate 作動詞：把任務／權責委派給他人；作名詞：代表。

examples.english: Our delegates have been mandated to vote against the proposal at the conference.
examples.chinese: 我們的代表受命在會議上對提案投反對票。

items.meaning: 強制的;必須履行的;法定的
items.englishDefinition: Something that is mandatory must be done, or is demanded by law.

examples.english: Athletes must undergo a mandatory drugs test before competing in the championship.
examples.chinese: 運動員在參加錦標賽前必須接受強制性藥檢。

examples.english: In 1991, the British government made it mandatory to wear rear seat belts in cars.
examples.chinese: 1991年，英國政府強制要求汽車後座乘客佩帶安全帶。

items.englishDefinition: the way in which something is done

examples.english: He was elected in the normal manner.
examples.chinese: 他依正常程序當選。

examples.english: It was the manner of her death that stuck in the public's mind.
examples.chinese: 她的死亡方式使公眾很受觸動。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: the usual way in which you behave towards other people, or the way you behave on a particular occasion

examples.english: She has a somewhat cold, unfriendly manner.
examples.chinese: 她的態度相當冷淡、不友善。

examples.english: As soon as he realized that we weren't going to buy anything, his whole manner changed.
examples.chinese: 他一發覺到我們不會買任何東西，態度就徹底改變了。

items.englishDefinition: to turn and direct an object

examples.english: Loaded supermarket trolleys are often difficult to manoeuvre.
examples.chinese: 滿載的超市購物車往往很難控制方向。

examples.english: This car manoeuvres well at high speed.
examples.chinese: 這輛汽車高速行駛時操作性能很好。

items.englishDefinition: a book that gives you practical instructions on how to do something or how to use something, such as a machine

examples.english: a DIY manual
examples.chinese: 「自己動手做」指南

examples.english: The computer comes with a 600-page instruction manual.
examples.chinese: 電腦附有一本600頁的操作指南。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: done with the hands

examples.english: She tried to cure the pain in my knee by putting manual pressure on the joint.
examples.chinese: 她嘗試用手按壓我的膝關節來治療我的膝痛。

items.englishDefinition: the original copy of a book or article before it is printed

examples.english: He sent the 400-page manuscript to his publisher.
examples.chinese: 他將400頁的手稿寄給他的出版商了。

items.englishDefinition: very small in amount or effect

examples.english: The report suggests that there has only been a marginal improvement in women's pay over the past few years.
examples.chinese: 報告顯示，過去幾年間女性的工資只有輕微增長。

examples.english: articles about subjects of marginal interest
examples.chinese: 關於只有少數人感興趣的主題的文章

items.englishDefinition: in a very obvious or noticeable way

examples.english: Eye-witness accounts of the fighting differ markedly from police reports of what happened.
examples.chinese: 目擊者對毆鬥的描述與警方對事件的報道明顯不同。

examples.english: She has markedly changed her eating habits.
examples.chinese: 她的飲食習慣有了明顯的改變。

items.cue: People or places a business sells to

examples.english: The company plans to enter the European market next year.
examples.chinese: 這家公司計畫明年進入歐洲市場。

items.englishDefinition: to plan a difficult activity, often a crime, in detail and make certain that it happens successfully

examples.english: He's believed to have masterminded the attacks.
examples.chinese: 據信是他策劃了這些襲擊事件。

items.englishDefinition: a situation or subject that is being dealt with or considered

examples.english: Could I talk to you about a personal matter?
examples.chinese: 我能和你談件私事嗎？

examples.english: Please phone me back - it's a matter of some importance.
examples.chinese: 可否回電話給我——有比較重要的事。

examples.english: A hot meal will be served during the flight.
examples.chinese: 飛行期間將供應熱食餐點。

items.englishDefinition: a method or way of doing something

examples.english: They had no means of communication.
examples.chinese: 他們沒有通訊方法。

examples.english: We need to find some other means of transportation.
examples.chinese: 我們需要找其他交通工具了。

items.englishDefinition: a way of achieving something, or a method for dealing with a situation

examples.english: What further measures can we take to avoid terrorism?
examples.chinese: 我們該採取哪些進一步的措施來防範恐怖主義？

examples.english: These measures were designed to improve car safety.
examples.chinese: 這些措施旨在提高汽車的安全性。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: to discover the exact size or amount of something

examples.english: "Will the table fit in here?" "I don't know - let's measure it."
examples.chinese: 「這裡放得下這張桌子嗎？」「我不知道──我們來量一下吧。」

examples.english: This machine measures your heart rate.
examples.chinese: 這台機器可測量你的心率。

items.englishDefinition: to fulfil, satisfy, or achieve

examples.english: The workers' demands for higher pay were not met by the management.
examples.chinese: 管理層沒有滿足工人提高工資的要求。

examples.english: They will only agree to sign the contract if certain conditions are met.
examples.chinese: 只有某些條件得到滿足，他們才會同意簽署合同。

examples.english: The new model meets a key requirement: it can run on battery power.
examples.chinese: 新款機型符合一項關鍵要求：它能以電池供電。

examples.english: The team meeting will begin at nine o'clock.
examples.chinese: 團隊會議將於九點開始。

examples.english: Could we see the lunch menu, please?
examples.chinese: 可以請你讓我們看看午餐菜單嗎？

examples.english: Please leave a message if I do not answer the phone.
examples.chinese: 如果我沒有接電話，請留言。

items.meaning: 把...寫進議事錄，把...寫進會議紀錄
items.englishDefinition: to make a written record of what is said at a meeting

examples.english: The chairman is minuted as having said that profits had fallen to an all-time low.
examples.chinese: 根據會議紀錄，董事長說過利潤已降到歷史新低。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: one of the 60 parts that an hour is divided into, consisting of 60 seconds

examples.english: The presentation will begin in ten minutes.
examples.chinese: 簡報將在十分鐘後開始。

items.meaning: 隨意擱置；亂放（而一時找不到）
items.englishDefinition: to lose something temporarily by forgetting where you have put it

examples.english: She misplaced her keys so often that her secretary used to carry spare ones for her.
examples.chinese: 她經常記不起她的鎖匙放在哪裡，因此她的秘書常為她帶著備用鎖匙。

items.meaning: 監控;監測;監視，密切注視
items.englishDefinition: to watch and check a situation carefully for a period of time in order to discover something about it

examples.english: The CIA were monitoring (= secretly listening to) his phone calls.
examples.chinese: 中央情報局正在對他的電話進行監聽。

examples.english: The new findings suggest that women ought to monitor their cholesterol levels.
examples.chinese: 新發現顯示女性應當密切關注她們的膽固醇濃度。

items.englishDefinition: (an organization or group that has) complete control of something, especially an area of business, so that others have no share
