examples.english: The government is determined to protect its tobacco monopoly.
examples.chinese: 政府決意保護其煙草專賣權。

examples.english: He does not have a/the monopoly on (= he is not the only one who has) good looks.
examples.chinese: 長得好看的不止他一個。

items.englishDefinition: an agreement that allows you to borrow money from a bank or similar organization, especially in order to buy a house, or the amount of money itself

examples.english: They took out a £400,000 mortgage (= they borrowed £400,000) to buy the house.
examples.chinese: 他們借了四十萬英鎊的房屋抵押貸款來買這棟房子。

examples.english: a monthly mortgage payment
examples.chinese: 每月償付的按揭貸款

items.englishDefinition: gradually increasing

examples.english: mounting anxiety/excitement
examples.chinese: 不斷增長的焦慮／興奮

examples.english: mounting debts
examples.chinese: 日益累積的債務

items.englishDefinition: to start occupying a new home or workplace
items.cue: 設施與環境情境：move in next week
collocations: move in to a new office
items.notes: 本詞義常不接受直接受詞：move in next week。加地點可用 move into a new office。

examples.english: The renovation is complete, and the team can move in next week.
examples.chinese: 整修已完成，團隊下週可以搬入。

examples.english: New tenants may move in after signing the lease.
examples.chinese: 新租客簽完租約後即可搬入。

items.englishDefinition: to stop occupying a home or workplace and leave it
items.cue: 設施與環境情境：move out of an office
items.notes: 本詞義常不接受直接受詞；move out of 加搬出的地點。與 move in 相反。

examples.english: The company must move out of the old office before the lease expires.
examples.chinese: 公司必須在租約到期前搬出舊辦公室。

examples.english: The tenants agreed to move out by the end of the month.
examples.chinese: 租客同意在月底以前搬出。

items.englishDefinition: felt or done by two or more people or groups in the same way

examples.english: It will be a mutually beneficial project.
examples.chinese: 這將是一項互利的計劃。

examples.english: Being rich and being a Socialist are not mutually exclusive (= they can exist together at the same time).
examples.chinese: 身為富人和身為社會主義者並不相互排斥。

items.englishDefinition: A narrow result is one that could easily have been different because the amount by which someone failed or succeeded was very small.

examples.english: The election was won by the very narrow margin of only 185 votes.
examples.chinese: 僅以185票的微弱優勢贏取選舉。

examples.english: The opposition had a narrow defeat.
examples.chinese: 反對派以微弱劣勢落敗。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: to become less wide or to make something less wide

examples.english: The road narrows after the bridge.
examples.chinese: 過橋之後道路變窄了。

examples.english: He narrowed his eyes in suspicion.
examples.chinese: 他猜疑地瞇起眼睛。

items.englishDefinition: only by a small amount

examples.english: She narrowly missed winning the race.
examples.chinese: 她差一點就贏得了比賽。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: in a limited way

examples.english: a narrowly interpreted law
examples.chinese: 狹義詮釋的法律

items.meaning: （用於否定句）不可避免地，必然地
items.englishDefinition: used in negatives to mean "in every case" or "therefore"

examples.english: The fact that something is cheap doesn't necessarily mean it's of low quality.
examples.chinese: 價廉未必物不美。

examples.english: You can love someone without necessarily wanting to marry them.
examples.chinese: 你可能愛一個人，但未必願意和他／她結婚。

items.englishDefinition: a piece of jewellery worn around the neck, such as a chain or a string of decorative stones, beads, etc.

examples.english: a gold/silver/pearl necklace
examples.chinese: 金／銀／珍珠項鏈

items.englishDefinition: Having an unpleasant, unwanted, or harmful effect.

examples.english: The warm winter has had a very negative effect/impact on the ski industry.
examples.chinese: 溫暖的冬天對滑雪業有非常負面的影響。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: expressing "no"

examples.english: We received a negative answer to our request.
examples.chinese: 我們的請求遭到拒絕。

examples.english: The purchasing team will negotiate a lower price with the supplier.
examples.chinese: 採購團隊將與供應商協商更低的價格。

items.englishDefinition: the process of discussing something with someone in order to reach an agreement with them, or the discussions themselves

examples.english: The agreement was reached after a series of difficult negotiations.
examples.chinese: 該協議是經歷了一系列艱難的談判之後達成的。

examples.english: Negotiation for the pay increase is likely to take several weeks.
examples.chinese: 加薪談判可能要持續數周。

items.englishDefinition: a neutral position, especially in a war

examples.english: Sweden isn't likely ever to abandon its traditional neutrality.
examples.chinese: 瑞典永遠不可能放棄其傳統的中立立場。

examples.english: The Queen has maintained political neutrality throughout her reign.
examples.chinese: 女王在位期間，政治上一直保持中立。

items.englishDefinition: the act of officially suggesting someone or something for a job, position, or prize

examples.english: There have been two nominations for the new job.
examples.chinese: 這項新工作有兩位提名人選。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: the act of officially choosing someone for a job or position

examples.english: the nomination of Elena Kagan to the Supreme Court
examples.chinese: 艾琳娜·卡根作為最高法院法官的提名

items.englishDefinition: to notice something

examples.english: They noted the consumers' growing demand for quicker service.
examples.chinese: 他們留意到消費者對便捷服務與日俱增的需求。

examples.english: Please note (that) we will be closed on Saturday.
examples.chinese: 請注意我們週六不營業。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: to give your attention to something by discussing it or making a written record of it

examples.english: He said the weather was beyond our control, noting that last summer was one of the hottest on record.
examples.chinese: 他說天氣超出了我們的掌控範圍，並提到去年夏天是有史以來最炎熱的一個夏天。

examples.english: In the article, she notes several cases of medical incompetence.
examples.chinese: 她在文章中提到幾個醫療能力不足的案例。

items.cue: A written message for a group

examples.english: A notice on the door says the office is closed today.
examples.chinese: 門上的公告寫著辦公室今天不開放。

items.englishDefinition: the act of telling someone officially about something, or a document, etc. that does this

examples.english: You must give the bank (a) written notification if you wish to close your account.
examples.chinese: 如果你想撤銷帳戶，必須向銀行發一份書面通知。

examples.english: The car's owner would receive notification that the vehicle failed inspection.
examples.chinese: 車主將收到車輛未通過檢查的通知。

items.englishDefinition: to tell someone officially about something

examples.english: The school is required to notify parents if their children fail to come to school.
examples.chinese: 如果孩子沒來上學，學校必須通知其家長。

examples.english: We notified the police that the bicycle had been stolen.
examples.chinese: 我們報警說腳踏車被盜。

items.englishDefinition: the substances that you take into your body as food and the way that they influence your health

examples.english: Good nutrition is essential if patients are to make a quick recovery.
examples.chinese: 病人如果要迅速康復，必須補足營養。

examples.english: improvements in nutrition
examples.chinese: 改善營養

items.englishDefinition: to feel or express opposition to or dislike of something or someone

examples.english: Would anyone object if we started the meeting now?
examples.chinese: 如果我們現在開始開會，有人反對嗎？

examples.english: He objects to the label "magician".
examples.chinese: 他反對人們稱他為「魔術師」。

additionalSenses.meaning: （可看見或可觸摸到的）實物，物體
additionalSenses.englishDefinition: A thing that can be seen or touched.

examples.english: Several people reported seeing a strange object in the sky.
examples.chinese: 好幾個人報告說看見空中有一個奇怪的物體。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: a reason for doing something, or the result you wish to achieve by doing it

examples.english: The object of their expedition was to discover the source of the River Nile.
examples.chinese: 他們探險的目的是找到尼羅河的源頭。

items.englishDefinition: the act of expressing or feeling opposition to or dislike of something or someone

examples.english: Her objection to/against the plan is based on incorrect facts.
examples.chinese: 她對這項計劃的反對基於錯誤的數據。

examples.english: A couple of people raised/voiced objections to the proposal.
examples.chinese: 有幾個人反對這項提議。

items.englishDefinition: the fact that you are obliged to do something

examples.english: If you have not signed a contract, you are under no obligation to (= it is not necessary to) pay them any money.
examples.chinese: 如果你沒有簽合同，你就沒有義務付給他們錢。

examples.english: You have a legal obligation to (= the law says you must) ensure your child receives an education.
examples.chinese: 法律規定你有義務確保自己的孩子接受教育。

items.englishDefinition: to force someone to do something, or to make it necessary for someone to do something

examples.english: The law obliges companies to pay decent wages to their employees.
examples.chinese: 法律強制公司向其僱員支付適當的工資。

examples.english: The law does not obligate sellers to accept the highest offer.
examples.chinese: 法律沒有強制賣主必須接受最高的出價。

additionalSenses.meaning: （尤指按別人要求的去做以）討好，幫助，為...效勞
additionalSenses.englishDefinition: to help someone or do something that they have asked for

examples.english: We only went to the party to oblige some old friends who asked us to be there.
examples.chinese: 我們去參加這個聚會只是為了照顧一些老朋友的面子，他們特意要求我們到場。

examples.english: We needed a guide and he was only too happy to oblige.
examples.chinese: 我們需要一個嚮導，而他很樂意幫忙。

items.englishDefinition: to notice or see

examples.english: Jack observed a look of anxiety on his brother's face.
examples.chinese: 傑克注意到了他哥哥臉上焦急的神情。

examples.english: A teacher observed her climb over the gate.
examples.chinese: 有位老師看到她翻過大門。

items.meaning: 阻塞，堵塞，阻擋（道路、通道、入口等）
items.englishDefinition: to block a road, passage, entrance, etc. so that nothing can go along it, or to prevent something from happening correctly by putting difficulties in its way

examples.english: After the earthquake many roads were obstructed by collapsed buildings.
examples.chinese: 地震過後，許多道路都被倒塌的建築物堵住了。

examples.english: An accident is obstructing traffic on the M11.
examples.chinese: 一場事故堵塞了11號高速公路上的交通。

items.englishDefinition: sometimes but not often

examples.english: I see him occasionally in town.
examples.chinese: 我偶爾在城裡見到他。

examples.english: Occasionally I'll have a piece of chocolate, but it's very rare.
examples.chinese: 有時我會吃塊巧克力，不過這種時候極少。

items.englishDefinition: someone's use of a room or building for the purposes of living or working

examples.english: The family's occupancy of the apartment lasted only six months.
examples.chinese: 這家人只在這套公寓裡住了6個月。

examples.english: The price for a room is $158 per person per night, double/single occupancy (= two people/one person in each room).
examples.chinese: 房間的價格是每人每晚158美元，雙人或單人房。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: the number of things, such as rooms, that are being used, in relation to the total number available

examples.english: Average occupancy at Florida hospitals is now 49 percent.
examples.chinese: 佛羅里達州醫院病床的平均使用率是49%。

items.englishDefinition: a person's job
items.notes:
occupation 職業
occupant (住宅的)居住者、(土地的)佔有者

examples.english: In the space marked "occupation" she wrote "police officer".
examples.chinese: 她在標示「職業」的欄位填上「警察」。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: An activity that a person regularly spends time doing.
additionalSenses.notes:
occupation 職業
occupant (住宅的)居住者、(土地的)佔有者

examples.english: It seems to me his favourite occupation is eating.
examples.chinese: 在我看來，他最喜歡的消遣就是吃東西。

examples.english: Our office is on the fourth floor of the building.
examples.chinese: 我們的辦公室位於這棟大樓的四樓。

items.englishDefinition: formally and in a way agreed to or arranged by people in positions of authority

examples.english: The royal engagement was announced officially this morning.
examples.chinese: 今天上午官方正式宣佈了皇室訂婚一事。

additionalSenses.meaning: 名義上地；對公眾宣稱（而事實並非如此）地
additionalSenses.englishDefinition: as stated or accepted by people publicly but not privately or as things really are

examples.english: Well, officially I am on holiday this week, but I'm just catching up on some reports I have to finish.
examples.chinese: 這周名義上我是應該休假的，但事實上我還在趕寫幾份報告。

items.englishDefinition: to fail to include or do something

examples.english: She was omitted from the list of contributors to the report.
examples.chinese: 這篇報道的撰稿人中漏掉了她的名字。

examples.english: She omitted to mention that she would be away next week.
examples.chinese: 她沒提及自己下星期不在這裡的事。

collocations: be on sale for half price

examples.english: These chairs are on sale for half their usual price.
examples.chinese: 這些椅子正在以平常價格的一半特價出售。

examples.english: Your replacement printer is already on the way.
examples.chinese: 你的替換印表機已經在運送途中。

examples.english: The presentation started on time despite the heavy rain.
examples.chinese: 儘管下著大雨，簡報仍準時開始。

examples.english: Only trained employees may operate this machine.
examples.chinese: 只有受過訓練的員工可以操作這台機器。

items.englishDefinition: an occasion when a doctor cuts a body for medical reasons in order to repair, remove, or replace an unhealthy or damaged part

examples.english: He has to have an operation on his shoulder.
examples.chinese: 他的肩部必須做個手術。

examples.english: We will know in a couple of days if the operation to restore her sight was successful.
examples.chinese: 我們幾天後就能知道她恢復視力的手術是否成功。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: the fact of operating or being active

examples.english: There are several reactors of the type in operation (= working) at the moment.
examples.chinese: 目前有幾個這樣的反應堆在工作。

examples.english: We expect the new system for assessing claims to come into operation (= start working) early next year.
examples.chinese: 我們預計明年初施行核定索賠的新方案。

items.englishDefinition: the chance to get a job

examples.english: There are some great opportunities now for engineers trained in computer-aided design.
examples.chinese: 現在，受過電腦輔助設計訓練的工程師有一些很好的就業機會。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: A situation that makes it possible to do something.

examples.english: Everyone will have an opportunity to comment.
examples.chinese: 每個人都會有機會發表意見。

examples.english: Your order will be ready for collection on Friday.
examples.chinese: 你的訂單將於星期五備妥，可前來取貨。

items.englishDefinition: a part of the body of an animal or plant that performs a particular job

examples.english: an organ donor/transplant
examples.chinese: 器官捐贈者／器官移植

examples.english: This size is currently out of stock, but more will arrive next week.
examples.chinese: 這個尺寸目前缺貨，但下週會補貨。

examples.english: There is a power outlet beside each desk.
examples.chinese: 每張桌子旁邊都有一個電源插座。

items.englishDefinition: the likely future situation

examples.english: The outlook for the economy is bleak.
examples.chinese: 經濟前景暗淡。

examples.english: The outlook for today is cloudy and dry at first with showers later.
examples.chinese: 今天天氣先是多雲無雨，晚些時候有陣雨。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: a person's way of understanding and thinking about something

examples.english: He has a fairly positive outlook on life.
examples.chinese: 他的人生觀相當積極。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: what you can see from a particular place

examples.english: From the top of the tower, the outlook over the city was breathtaking.
examples.chinese: 從塔頂俯視，這座城市的景色令人嘆為觀止。

examples.english: Please pay the outstanding balance by the end of the week.
examples.chinese: 請在本週結束前支付尚未付清的款項。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: clearly very much better than what is usual

examples.english: It's an area of outstanding natural beauty.
examples.chinese: 這地區自然風景極為優美。

examples.english: an outstanding performance/writer/novel/year
examples.chinese: 傑出的表現／優秀的作家／出色的小說／不同凡響的一年

items.englishDefinition: Including all parts of a situation or group.

examples.english: The overall situation is good, despite a few minor problems.
examples.chinese: 儘管有些小問題，局勢總的來說是好的。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: Considering a situation as a whole.

examples.english: Overall, it has been a good year.
examples.chinese: 總的來說，這一年很不錯。

items.englishDefinition: to defeat or succeed in controlling or dealing with something
items.notes: income 收入

examples.english: Eventually she managed to overcome her shyness in class.
examples.chinese: 她終於克服了上課時的羞怯。

examples.english: to overcome difficulties/obstacles/problems/resistance
examples.chinese: 克服困難／障礙／難題／阻力

items.englishDefinition: not done or happening when expected or when needed; late

examples.english: My library books are a week overdue.
examples.chinese: 我借圖書館的書過期一個星期了。

examples.english: She feels she's overdue for promotion.
examples.chinese: 她覺得她早該被提升。

items.englishDefinition: to watch or organize a job or an activity to make certain that it is being done correctly

examples.english: As marketing manager, her job is to oversee all the company's advertising.
examples.chinese: 作為行銷經理，她的工作是負責公司所有的廣告業務。

examples.english: Employees must get approval before working overtime.
examples.chinese: 員工加班前必須先獲得核准。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: (time spent working) after the usual time needed or expected in a job

examples.english: They're doing/working overtime to get the job done on time.
examples.chinese: 他們加班以準時完成這項工作。

examples.english: Everyone is on overtime (= being paid extra for working after the usual time) this weekend.
examples.chinese: 這個週末大家都有加班費。

examples.english: There is a package for you at the front desk.
examples.chinese: 櫃檯有一個你的包裹。

examples.english: The parcel was too large to fit in the mailbox.
examples.chinese: 這個包裹太大，放不進信箱。

examples.english: New staff are encouraged to participate in the discussion.
examples.chinese: 公司鼓勵新進員工參與討論。

items.englishDefinition: special, or this and not any other

examples.english: He wouldn't take just any book - he had to have this particular one!
examples.chinese: 他不會隨便買書——他要買這本！

examples.english: "Why did you ask?" "Oh, no particular reason, just making conversation."
examples.chinese: 「你為甚麼問呢？」「哦，沒甚麼特別的原因，就是沒話找話。」

items.englishDefinition: a vertical structure like a thin wall that separates one part of a room or building from another

examples.english: The partitions between the toilets were very thin.
examples.chinese: 廁所間的隔板很薄。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: to divide one part of a room from another with a thin wall

examples.english: Why don't you partition that large room into a lounge and a dining-room?
examples.chinese: 你為甚麼不把那個大房間隔成客廳和飯廳呢？

examples.english: Passengers should keep their bags with them at all times.
examples.chinese: 乘客應隨時將行李帶在身邊。

examples.english: Please check that your passport is valid before booking.
examples.chinese: 預訂前，請確認你的護照仍在有效期限內。

items.englishDefinition: the official legal right to make or sell an invention for a particular number of years

examples.english: The company took out/filed a patent on a genetically engineered tomato.
examples.chinese: 該公司取得／申請了一項基因改造番茄的專利權。

additionalSenses.meaning: 為發明申請或取得專利
additionalSenses.englishDefinition: to obtain legal protection for an invention through a patent

examples.english: If you don't patent your invention, other people may make all the profit out of it.
examples.chinese: 如果你不為你的發明申請專利權，其他人就會從中圖利。

collocations: pay in advance for a course

examples.english: Participants must pay in advance to secure a place on the course.
examples.chinese: 參加者必須預先付款，才能保留課程名額。

items.englishDefinition: to repay all the money owed on a debt
items.cue: 財務與投資情境：pay off a loan
items.notes: 可分：pay the loan off；代名詞用 pay it off。此處學清償債務，不是努力獲得成果的詞義。

examples.english: The company plans to pay off its bank loan within three years.
examples.chinese: 公司計畫在三年內還清銀行貸款。

examples.english: The debt is small enough for us to pay it off this month.
examples.chinese: 這筆債務金額不大，我們本月就能還清。

examples.english: Payment must be received before the goods are shipped.
examples.chinese: 必須先收到款項，商品才會出貨。

items.meaning: （公司員工的）在職人員工資表，工資名單
items.englishDefinition: a list of the people employed by a company showing how much each one earns
items.notes: on the payroll 是某公司的員工

examples.english: The company is growing fast, adding another 100 employees to its payroll over the last year.
examples.chinese: 公司成長迅速，過去一年又增加了一百名受僱員工。

examples.english: a payroll tax
examples.chinese: 薪資稅

items.englishDefinition: to do an action or piece of work

examples.english: The operation will be performed next week.
examples.chinese: 手術將於下禮拜進行。

examples.english: Computers can perform a variety of tasks.
examples.chinese: 電腦能執行多項工作。

items.cue: How well someone does a job

examples.english: Managers discuss employee performance during the annual review.
examples.chinese: 主管會在年度考核時討論員工的工作表現。

items.englishDefinition: in a way that is repeated after a particular period of time

examples.english: The equipment should be tested periodically.
examples.chinese: 設備應該定期接受檢測。

items.englishDefinition: Perishable food decays quickly.

examples.english: It's important to store perishable food in a cool place.
examples.chinese: 一定要把易變壞的食物存放在陰涼的地方。

items.englishDefinition: lasting for a long time or for ever

examples.english: She is looking for a permanent place to stay.
examples.chinese: 她正在尋找一個固定的住所。

examples.english: Are you looking for a temporary or a permanent job?
examples.chinese: 你是想找一份臨時的還是固定的工作？

items.englishDefinition: always and for ever

examples.english: Smoking is likely to damage your health permanently.
examples.chinese: 吸煙可能會永久損害你的健康。

examples.english: Michael and his family have settled permanently in the States.
examples.chinese: 麥克和他的家人在美國永久定居下來。

examples.english: You need permission to use the company vehicle.
examples.chinese: 使用公司車輛需要先取得許可。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: If someone is given permission to do something, they are allowed to do it.

examples.english: You will need permission from your parents to go on the trip.
examples.chinese: 你要得到你父母的許可才能參加這趟旅行。

examples.english: Official permission has been granted for more building near the river.
examples.chinese: 在這條河附近建造更多房子的做法已獲得官方許可。

items.englishDefinition: to allow something

examples.english: The regulations do not permit much flexibility.
examples.chinese: 這些規章不允許有太大的彈性空間。

examples.english: As it was such a special occasion, she permitted herself a small glass of champagne.
examples.chinese: 鑒於場合特殊，她破例喝了一小杯香檳。

items.englishDefinition: If an unpleasant feeling or situation persists, it continues to exist.

examples.english: If the pain persists, consult a doctor.
examples.chinese: 如果疼痛持續就去看醫生。

examples.english: The cold weather is set to persist throughout the week.
examples.chinese: 寒冷天氣很可能將持續整個星期。

items.englishDefinition: the department of a company or organization that deals with its employees when they first join, when they need training, or when they have any problems

examples.english: Personnel will help you find somewhere to live.
examples.chinese: 人事部門會協助你找到住處。

examples.english: For more information about the job, please contact the personnel manager.
examples.chinese: 如欲了解這份工作的詳情，請聯絡人事部經理。

items.meaning: 有說服力的，令人信服的
items.englishDefinition: making you want to do or believe a particular thing

examples.english: a persuasive speaker/speech
examples.chinese: 有說服力的演講者／演說

examples.english: Your arguments are very persuasive.
examples.chinese: 你的論據非常有說服力。

examples.english: He can be very persuasive.
examples.chinese: 他有時也很有說服力。

items.englishDefinition: any stage in a series of events or in a process of development

examples.english: The project is only in its initial phase as yet, but it's looking quite promising.
examples.chinese: 該專案計劃目前才剛起步，但看起來大有可為。

examples.english: We're entering a new phase in international relations.
examples.chinese: 我們現正進入國際關係的新階段。

items.meaning: 逐步淘汰；逐步停止使用
items.englishDefinition: to stop using something in planned stages
items.cue: 產品與物流情境：phase out a product
items.notes: 可分：phase the product out；代名詞用 phase it out。強調逐步，不是立即停用。

examples.english: The manufacturer will phase out the older model over the next year.
examples.chinese: 製造商將在未來一年逐步淘汰舊款機型。

examples.english: We still use paper forms, but plan to phase them out gradually.
examples.chinese: 我們仍使用紙本表格，但計畫逐步停用。

items.englishDefinition: a medical doctor, especially one who has general skill and is not a surgeon

examples.english: Please consult a physician before returning to work if your symptoms continue.
examples.chinese: 如果症狀持續，請先諮詢醫師再返回工作崗位。

examples.english: You can pick up your order at the service counter.
examples.chinese: 你可以在服務櫃檯領取訂購的商品。

items.englishDefinition: to put something in a particular position

examples.english: She placed the letter in front of me.
examples.chinese: 她把信放在我面前。

examples.english: She placed her name on the list of volunteers.
examples.chinese: 她把自己的名字寫在義工名單上。

collocations: place an order with a supplier

examples.english: You can place an order online or by phone.
examples.chinese: 你可以在線上或透過電話下單。

examples.english: The train to Tainan leaves from platform three.
examples.chinese: 開往臺南的火車從第三月台發車。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: a long, flat raised structure at a railway station, where people get on and off trains

examples.english: The next train for Aberdeen will depart from platform 9.
examples.chinese: 下一趟去亞伯丁的火車將從9號月臺開出。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: the raised part of the floor in a large room, from which you make a speech or give a musical performance

examples.english: Speaker after speaker mounted/took the platform to denounce the policy.
examples.chinese: 演講者一個接一個走上講台譴責這項政策。

examples.english: This brilliant young violinist has appeared on concert platforms all round the world.
examples.chinese: 這名才華橫溢的年輕小提琴手曾在世界各地的音樂會舞臺上演出。

items.englishDefinition: happy or satisfied

examples.english: Are you pleased about John's promotion?
examples.chinese: 約翰升職了，你開心嗎？

examples.english: We're so pleased that you're able to come to the wedding.
examples.chinese: 你能來參加婚禮，我們太開心了。

items.englishDefinition: If something is plentiful, there is a lot of it available.

examples.english: Strawberries are plentiful in the summer.
examples.chinese: 夏天草莓很多。

examples.english: I took a plentiful supply of games to keep the children amused.
examples.chinese: 我準備了夠多的遊戲供孩子們玩。

items.englishDefinition: to direct someone's attention to a fact or detail
items.cue: 會議與溝通情境：point out an error
items.notes: 可分：point the error out；代名詞用 point it out。也可用 point out that 子句。

examples.english: The reviewer pointed out several errors in the price list.
examples.chinese: 審核人員指出價目表中的幾項錯誤。

examples.english: If you notice a missing item, please point it out before we submit the report.
examples.chinese: 如果你發現遺漏的項目，請在我們提交報告前指出。

examples.english: Our return policy allows exchanges within thirty days.
examples.chinese: 我們的退貨規定允許顧客在三十天內換貨。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: a set of ideas or a plan of what to do in particular situations that has been agreed to officially by a group of people, a business organization, a government, or a political party

examples.english: They believe that Europe needs a common foreign and security policy.
examples.chinese: 他們認為歐洲需要採取共同的外交和安全政策。

examples.english: What is your party's policy on immigration?
examples.chinese: 你們黨對於移民的政策是甚麼？

items.englishDefinition: in a polite way

examples.english: He told them politely to leave him in peace.
examples.chinese: 他禮貌地請他們讓他一個人靜靜地獨處。

examples.english: The audience clapped politely.
examples.chinese: 觀眾們禮貌性地鼓了鼓掌。

items.englishDefinition: a substance that pollutes

examples.english: Sulphur dioxide is one of several pollutants that are released into the atmosphere by coal-fired power stations.
examples.chinese: 二氧化硫是燃煤發電廠排放到大氣中的多種污染物之一。

examples.english: The smaller model is popular with customers who travel often.
examples.chinese: 較小的機型受到經常旅行的顧客歡迎。

items.englishDefinition: a collection of company shares and other investments that are owned by a particular person or organization

examples.english: The adviser recommended adding government bonds to our investment portfolio.
examples.chinese: 顧問建議在我們的投資組合中加入政府公債。

additionalSenses.meaning: （尤指藝術家的）代表作的選輯
additionalSenses.englishDefinition: a collection of drawings, documents, etc. that represent a person's, especially an artist's, work

examples.english: She's trying to build up a portfolio of work to show during job interviews.
examples.chinese: 她正想整理出自己的代表作以便找工作面試時展示一下。

examples.english: The portions are large enough to share.
examples.chinese: 餐點的份量大到可以分著吃。

examples.english: The company has an open position in the sales department.
examples.chinese: 這家公司的業務部門有一個職缺。

items.cue: Moving an event to a later time

examples.english: They decided to postpone the event until next month.
examples.chinese: 他們決定將活動延後到下個月。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: to delay an event and plan or decide that it should happen at a later date or time
additionalSenses.notes:
postpone：安排延期。
procrastinate：因不情願而拖延。

examples.english: They decided to postpone their holiday until next year.
examples.chinese: 他們決定將假期延後到來年。

examples.english: We've had to postpone going to France because the children are ill.
examples.chinese: 因為孩子們生病了，我們不得不延後去法國的行程。

items.englishDefinition: possible when the necessary conditions exist

examples.english: A number of potential buyers have expressed interest in the company.
examples.chinese: 一些潛在的買主表達了對該公司的興趣。

examples.english: Many potential customers are waiting for a fall in prices before buying.
examples.chinese: 很多潛在的顧客都在等著降價再購買。

items.meaning: 實際的;實做的;有實際經驗的
items.englishDefinition: relating to experience, real situations, or actions rather than ideas or imagination

examples.english: The service offers young people practical advice on finding a job.
examples.chinese: 這項服務為年輕人提供就業方面的實用建議。

examples.english: What's the use of theoretical knowledge that has no practical application?
examples.chinese: 理論知識如果沒有實際應用又有甚麼用呢？

items.englishDefinition: to express admiration or approval of the achievements or characteristics of a person or thing

examples.english: He should be praised for his honesty.
examples.chinese: 他應該因為誠實而獲得表揚。

examples.english: My parents always praised me when I did well at school.
examples.chinese: 我在學校裡表現好時父母總是誇獎我。

items.englishDefinition: an action that is done to prevent something unpleasant or dangerous happening

examples.english: Many people have been stockpiling food as a precaution against shortages.
examples.chinese: 為了預防食物短缺，很多人一直在大量儲備食品。

examples.english: They failed to take the necessary precautions to avoid infection.
examples.chinese: 他們未能採取必要的預防措施來避免感染。

items.meaning: 更合意的，更可取的，更好的
items.englishDefinition: liked or wanted more than anything else

examples.english: The earlier train would be my preferred option.
examples.chinese: 搭早一點的火車更合我意。

items.englishDefinition: best or most important

examples.english: He's one of the nation's premier scientists.
examples.chinese: 他是該國最重要的科學家之一。

items.englishDefinition: an amount of money paid to get insurance

examples.english: Car insurance premiums have increased this year.
examples.chinese: 今年汽車保險費漲了。

examples.english: The premiums for healthcare plans are high.
examples.chinese: 健保計劃的保險費很高。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: used to refer to something that is of higher than usual quality

examples.english: The building is on a premium site.
examples.chinese: 這棟大樓位於一處優越的地段。

items.englishDefinition: (of a doctor) to say what medical treatment someone should have

examples.english: The drug is often prescribed for ulcers.
examples.chinese: 這種藥通常是開來治療潰瘍的。

examples.english: I've been prescribed painkillers.
examples.chinese: 醫生給我開了些止痛藥。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: to tell someone what they must have or do, or to make a rule of something

examples.english: The law prescribes that all children must go to school.
examples.chinese: 法律規定所有孩子必須上學。

examples.english: Grammatical rules prescribe how words may be used together.
examples.chinese: 文法規則對單字如何搭配使用作出了規定。

items.englishDefinition: to give, provide, or make something known

examples.english: The letter presented the family with a problem that would be difficult to solve.
examples.chinese: 這封信給這家人提出了一個難題。

examples.english: He presented the report to his colleagues at the meeting.
examples.chinese: 他在會議上向同事們做出報告。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: in a particular place

examples.english: The whole family was present.
examples.chinese: 全家人都在場。

examples.english: There were no children present.
examples.chinese: 沒有孩子在場。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: happening or existing now

examples.english: I don't have her present address.
examples.chinese: 我不知道她現在的地址。

examples.english: Please state your present occupation and salary.
examples.chinese: 請說出你目前的職業和薪水。

additionalSenses.meaning: （尤指表示友誼或致謝的）禮物，贈品
additionalSenses.englishDefinition: something that you are given, without asking for it, on a special occasion, especially to show friendship, or to say thank you

examples.english: They gave me theatre tickets as a present.
examples.chinese: 他們送給我戲票作為禮物。

items.englishDefinition: a talk giving information about something

examples.english: The speaker gave an interesting presentation on urban transport.
examples.chinese: 演講者針對城市交通發表了有趣的談話。

items.englishDefinition: to be in charge of a formal meeting, ceremony, or trial

examples.english: Who would be the best person to preside at/over the public enquiry?
examples.chinese: 誰來主持大眾調查最合適呢？

examples.english: Judge Langdale is to preside over the official enquiry into the case.
examples.chinese: 蘭代爾法官將主持這個案子的正式調查。

items.englishDefinition: existing very commonly or happening often

examples.english: These diseases are more prevalent among young children.
examples.chinese: 這些疾病在幼兒中更普遍。

examples.english: Trees are dying in areas where acid rain is most prevalent.
examples.chinese: 在酸雨非常嚴重的地區，樹木正面臨枯死。

items.englishDefinition: the act of stopping something from happening or of stopping someone from doing something

examples.english: The organization is committed to AIDS prevention and education.
examples.chinese: 該組織致力於愛滋病的防治和教育。

examples.english: crime prevention
examples.chinese: 預防犯罪

examples.english: The price includes delivery to your office.
examples.chinese: 這個價格包含送貨到你辦公室的費用。

items.englishDefinition: to produce a printed copy of a document that has been written on a computer

examples.english: Could you print out a copy of that letter for me?
examples.chinese: 你能把那封信列印一份給我嗎？

items.englishDefinition: existing or happening before something else, or before a particular time

examples.english: The course required no prior knowledge of Spanish.
examples.chinese: 這門課不要求先前學過西班牙語。

examples.english: They had to refuse the dinner invitation because of a prior engagement (= something already planned for that time).
examples.chinese: 因為事先另有約會，他們只好拒絕了吃飯的邀請。

examples.english: Improving customer service is our top priority this year.
examples.chinese: 改善客戶服務是我們今年最優先的事項。

items.meaning: 很可能真實的;很可能發生的
items.englishDefinition: likely to be true or likely to happen

examples.english: The probable cause of death was heart failure.
examples.chinese: 死因很可能是心臟衰竭。

examples.english: An election in June seems increasingly probable.
examples.chinese: 六月舉行選舉的可能性似乎越來越大了。

examples.english: It is probable that share prices will fall even more.
examples.chinese: 股價很可能進一步下跌。

items.cue: The first months of a new job

examples.english: New employees are on probation for the first three months.
examples.chinese: 新進員工的前三個月為試用期。

items.cue: The approved way to do something

examples.english: New employees learn the procedure for reporting accidents.
examples.chinese: 新進員工會學習通報事故的程序。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: a set of actions that is the official or accepted way of doing something

examples.english: The company has new procedures for dealing with complaints.
examples.chinese: 公司採取了新的處理投訴事宜的程式。

examples.english: You must follow correct procedure at all times.
examples.chinese: 你必須隨時按照正確的步驟操作。

items.englishDefinition: to continue as planned

examples.english: His lawyers have decided not to proceed with the case.
examples.chinese: 他的律師已經決定不再繼續打那場官司了。

examples.english: Preparations for the festival are now proceeding smoothly.
examples.chinese: 藝術節的準備活動正在順利進行中。

items.meaning: （從事某種活動或變賣財物的）收入，收益
items.englishDefinition: the amount of money received from a particular event or activity or when something is sold
items.notes: process 過程

examples.english: The proceeds of today's festival will go to several local charities.
examples.chinese: 今天活動的收入將捐給當地的幾家慈善機構。

examples.english: It says on the back of the card "all proceeds to charity".
examples.chinese: 卡片背面寫著「所有收入捐給慈善機構」。

items.cue: How work moves from start to finish

examples.english: The online application process takes about ten minutes.
examples.chinese: 線上申請流程大約需要十分鐘。

items.englishDefinition: to keep delaying something that must be done, often because it is unpleasant or boring

examples.english: I know I've got to deal with the problem at some point - I'm just procrastinating.
examples.chinese: 我知道遲早得解決這個問題——我只是在拖延時間。

examples.english: You can find detailed product information on our website.
examples.chinese: 你可以在我們的網站找到詳細的產品資訊。

items.englishDefinition: the amount of something that is made or grown by a country or a company

examples.english: Swedish industrial production has fallen steadily this year.
examples.chinese: 瑞典的工業產量今年逐步下降。

examples.english: Wheat production has risen over the years.
examples.chinese: 小麥產量在這幾年內提高了。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: the process of making or growing goods to be sold

examples.english: We watched a video showing the various stages in the production of glass.
examples.chinese: 我們看了一部短片，片中展示玻璃製造過程中的不同階段。

examples.english: The company's new model will be going into production early next year.
examples.chinese: 這家公司的新型號將於明年初開始生產。

examples.english: We had a productive meeting and agreed on the next steps.
examples.chinese: 我們開了一場有成效的會議，並就後續步驟達成共識。

items.englishDefinition: the rate at which a company or country makes goods, usually judged in connection with the number of people and the amount of materials necessary to produce the goods

examples.english: Studies show that if a working environment is pleasant, productivity increases.
examples.chinese: 研究顯示如果工作環境舒適，生產效率會提高。

examples.english: Productivity in the steel industry improved by five percent last year.
examples.chinese: 鋼鐵工業的生產率去年提高了5%。

items.englishDefinition: the fact of having the skill and experience for doing something

examples.english: The job ad said they wanted proficiency in at least two languages.
examples.chinese: 徵才廣告表示，他們希望應徵者至少精通兩種語言。

examples.english: Photographs entered in the contest will be judged on originality and technical proficiency.
examples.chinese: 參加比賽的照片將根據原創性和技術水平進行評判。

items.englishDefinition: skilled and experienced

examples.english: It takes a couple of years of regular driving before you become proficient at it.
examples.chinese: 你得開上幾年車才能熟練自如。

examples.english: She's proficient in two languages.
examples.chinese: 她精通兩種語言。

examples.english: The store made a small profit in its first year.
examples.chinese: 這家商店在第一年獲得了小額利潤。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: money that is earned in trade or business after paying the costs of producing and selling goods and services

examples.english: She makes a big profit from selling waste material to textile companies.
examples.chinese: 她將廢棄材料賣給紡織公司，從中賺取大筆利潤。

examples.english: A year ago the Tokyo company had a pretax profit of 35 million yen.
examples.chinese: 一年前，東京公司的稅前利潤是3500萬日元。

items.englishDefinition: movement to an improved or more developed state, or to a forward position

examples.english: Technological progress has been so rapid over the last few years.
examples.chinese: 在最近幾年中，科技進步如此迅猛。

examples.english: I'm not making much progress with my Spanish.
examples.chinese: 我的西班牙語沒多大進步。

items.englishDefinition: to officially refuse to allow something
items.notes:
prohibit A from -ing 禁止 A 做...
forbid A +from -ing/to do 禁止 A 做...

examples.english: Motor vehicles are prohibited from driving in the town centre.
examples.chinese: 禁止機動車輛駛入市中心。

examples.english: The government introduced a law prohibiting tobacco advertisements on TV.
examples.chinese: 政府頒布了一項法律： 禁止在電視上播放煙草廣告。

items.englishDefinition: a calculation or guess about the future based on information that you have
items.notes: pro-(向前) + ject (投擲)

examples.english: The company has failed to achieve last year's sales projections by 30 percent.
examples.chinese: 這家公司未能達到去年的預期銷售目標，還差30%。

examples.english: Spending was well below projections.
examples.chinese: 支出遠低於預期。

items.englishDefinition: in a way that can easily be seen or noticed

examples.english: A photograph of her daughter was prominently displayed on her desk.
examples.chinese: 她女兒的照片被擺在她辦公桌上顯眼的位置。

examples.english: The newspaper featured the apology prominently on page 1.
examples.chinese: 報紙在頭版的顯要位置刊登了道歉聲明。

items.meaning: 有希望的；有出息的；有前途的
items.englishDefinition: Something that is promising shows signs that it is going to be successful or enjoyable.
items.notes: promise 承諾

examples.english: "How's your new venture going?" "It's looking quite promising."
examples.chinese: 「你的新事業進展得如何？」「看起來相當不錯。」

examples.english: It's a great restaurant but it doesn't look at all promising from the outside.
examples.chinese: 這間餐廳棒極了，不過從外面看可一點都看不出來。

examples.english: We will use social media to promote the new course.
examples.chinese: 我們將利用社群媒體宣傳新課程。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: to raise someone to a higher or more important position or rank

examples.english: If I'm not promoted within the next two years, I'm going to change jobs.
examples.chinese: 如果我在今後兩年內得不到升遷，我就換工作。

examples.english: She's just been promoted to senior sales rep.
examples.chinese: 她剛剛被升為高級業務代表。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: to encourage people to like, buy, use, do, or support something

examples.english: Advertising companies are always having to think up new ways to promote products.
examples.chinese: 廣告公司總是得想出新辦法來促銷。

examples.english: It has long been known that regular exercise promotes all-round good health.
examples.chinese: 經常運動能促進全面健康，這一點已久為人知。

items.cue: Moving to a higher job level

examples.english: She received a promotion after leading a successful project.
examples.chinese: 她在帶領專案成功後獲得了晉升。

examples.english: We will send promotional materials to interested customers.
examples.chinese: 我們會將宣傳資料寄給有興趣的顧客。

items.englishDefinition: (of an action) done quickly and without delay, or (of a person) acting quickly or arriving at the arranged time

examples.english: They've written back already - that was a very prompt reply.
examples.chinese: 他們已經回信了——答覆相當迅速。

examples.english: They're usually fairly prompt in dealing with enquiries.
examples.chinese: 他們回覆諮詢通常都比較快。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: to make something happen

examples.english: The bishop's speech has prompted an angry response from both political parties.
examples.chinese: 主教的發言激起了兩大政黨的憤怒回應。

examples.english: Recent worries over the president's health have prompted speculation over his political future.
examples.chinese: 最近對總統健康狀況的擔憂引發了對其政治前途的猜測。

additionalSenses.meaning: （電腦螢幕上的）提示符（顯示電腦已經準備好接受指令）
additionalSenses.englishDefinition: a message or symbol on a computer screen indicating that the system is ready for input
additionalSenses.notes: LLM 的指令

examples.english: Enter your account number when the prompt appears on the screen.
examples.chinese: 螢幕出現提示時，請輸入你的帳戶號碼。

items.meaning: 迅速地，立即地;依照預定時間地
items.englishDefinition: quickly, without delay, or at the arranged time

examples.english: We'll have to leave fairly promptly (= on time) if we want to catch that train.
examples.chinese: 如果我們要趕那班火車，就得準時出發。

examples.english: We try to answer readers' letters as promptly (= quickly) as we can.
examples.chinese: 我們努力儘快答覆讀者來信。

items.englishDefinition: correctly, or in a satisfactory way

examples.english: It's still not working properly.
examples.chinese: 它還是不能正常運轉。

examples.english: I'm not properly dressed for this kind of weather.
examples.chinese: 我的穿著不適合這樣的天氣。

items.englishDefinition: an object or objects that belong to someone

examples.english: Children need to be taught to have respect for other people's property.
examples.chinese: 孩子應該被教導要尊重他人的財產。

examples.english: The club does not accept responsibility for loss of or damage to club members' personal property.
examples.chinese: 該俱樂部不承擔會員個人財產遺失或損壞的責任。

items.englishDefinition: a suggestion, sometimes a written one

examples.english: There has been an angry reaction to the government's proposal to reduce unemployment benefit.
examples.chinese: 政府削減失業救濟金的計劃遭到了強烈的反對。

examples.english: Have you read Steve's proposals for the new project?
examples.chinese: 你看了史蒂夫對新專案的建議了嗎？

examples.english: I would like to propose a shorter lunch meeting.
examples.chinese: 我想提議縮短午餐會議的時間。

items.englishDefinition: the idea of something that will or might happen in the future

examples.english: The prospect of spending three whole days with her fills me with horror.
examples.chinese: 想到要和她在一起呆整整三天，我就毛骨悚然。

examples.english: I'm very excited at the prospect of seeing her again.
examples.chinese: 一想到又會見到她我就激動不已。

additionalSenses.meaning: （發生好事情的）可能，可能性，機會
additionalSenses.englishDefinition: the possibility that something good might happen in the future

examples.english: Is there any prospect of the weather improving?
examples.chinese: 天氣有可能好轉嗎？

examples.english: There's not much prospect that this war will be over soon.
examples.chinese: 爭端似乎不大可能平息。

items.meaning: 潛在的；預期的；未來可能成為某種身分的
items.englishDefinition: people who are expected to buy something, employ someone, become parents, etc.

examples.english: We've had three sets of prospective buyers looking at the house.
examples.chinese: 我們已經有三組潛在買家來看過這棟房子。

items.meaning: 成功;（尤指經濟上的）繁榮，昌盛
items.englishDefinition: the state of being successful and having a lot of money

examples.english: A country's future prosperity depends, to an extent, upon the quality of education of its people.
examples.chinese: 一個國家未來的繁榮昌盛在一定程度上取決於國民的教育品質。

examples.english: The war was followed by a long period of peace and prosperity.
examples.chinese: 戰爭過後是長時間的和平與繁榮。

items.englishDefinition: to give someone something that they need

examples.english: This booklet provides useful information about local services.
examples.chinese: 這本小冊子提供了有關當地服務機構的有用資訊。

examples.english: All meals are provided at no additional cost.
examples.chinese: 膳食均免費提供。

items.englishDefinition: someone who provides something

examples.english: The bank is now a major provider of financial services to industry.
examples.chinese: 銀行現在是工業的主要金融服務提供者。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: A person who earns money to support a family or other people.

examples.english: Until her illness, she was the main provider (= earned most of the money) in the family.
examples.chinese: 她生病前一直是家裡的經濟支柱。

items.englishDefinition: the state of being near in space or time

examples.english: The best thing about the location of the house is its proximity to the town centre.
examples.chinese: 這棟房子地理位置最好的就是鄰近市中心。

items.englishDefinition: to make information about something generally available

examples.english: The event was well publicized all over town.
examples.chinese: 這件事在全城傳得沸沸揚揚。

examples.english: The work of the charity has been widely publicized throughout the media.
examples.chinese: 慈善組織的工作獲得媒體的廣泛宣傳。

items.englishDefinition: to buy something

examples.english: Tickets must be purchased two weeks in advance.
examples.chinese: 門票必須提前兩週購買。

examples.english: She purchased her first house with the money.
examples.chinese: 她用這筆錢買了她的第一棟房子。

examples.english: We need to purchase new computers for the design team.
examples.chinese: 我們需要為設計團隊購買新電腦。

items.englishDefinition: to remove bad substances from something to make it pure

examples.english: Plants help to purify the air.
examples.chinese: 植物有助於淨化空氣。

examples.english: One of the functions of the kidneys is to purify the blood.
examples.chinese: 腎臟的功能之一是淨化血液。

items.englishDefinition: why you do something or why something exists

examples.english: The purpose of the research is to try to find out more about the causes of the disease.
examples.chinese: 研究的目的是試圖進一步探尋引起這種疾病的原因。

examples.english: His only purpose in life seems to be to enjoy himself.
examples.chinese: 他生活的唯一目的似乎就是享受。

items.meaning: 提出（供考慮的建議或提案）
items.englishDefinition: to offer an idea for others to consider
items.cue: 會議與溝通情境：put forward a proposal
items.notes: 可分：put the proposal forward；代名詞用 put it forward。比 bring up 更著重提出建議。

examples.english: The committee put forward a proposal to extend the opening hours.
examples.chinese: 委員會提出了延長營業時間的提案。

examples.english: Your suggestion is useful; please put it forward at the next meeting.
examples.chinese: 你的建議很有用，請在下次會議提出。

items.englishDefinition: to move an activity to a later time
items.cue: 會議與溝通情境：put off a meeting
items.notes: 可分：put the meeting off；代名詞用 put it off。後面也可接動名詞：put off making a decision。

examples.english: We need to put off the budget meeting until Friday.
examples.chinese: 我們需要把預算會議延至星期五。

examples.english: The payment is due today, so please do not put it off.
examples.chinese: 款項今天到期，請不要延後付款。

items.englishDefinition: to assemble parts or information into a complete item
items.cue: 會議與溝通情境：put together a presentation
items.notes: 可分：put the presentation together；代名詞用 put it together。可用於資料或實體零件。

examples.english: Could you put together a short presentation about our new services?
examples.chinese: 你能整理製作一份介紹新服務的簡短簡報嗎？

examples.english: The figures are ready; now we need to put them together in one report.
examples.chinese: 數據已準備好，現在需要把它們整理成一份報告。

examples.english: A teaching qualification is required for this position.
examples.chinese: 這個職位需要具備教師資格。

items.meaning: 有資格的；合格的，勝任的
items.englishDefinition: having finished a training course, or having particular skills, etc.
items.notes:
be qualified for 有...的資格
qualification for ...的資格

examples.english: What makes you think that you are qualified for this job?
examples.chinese: 你為什麼認為自己有資格勝任這份工作？

examples.english: Tim is now a qualified architect.
examples.chinese: 提姆現在是一位合格的建築師。

items.englishDefinition: to successfully finish a training course so that you are able to do a job; to have or achieve the necessary skills, etc.

examples.english: She hopes to qualify (as a lawyer) at the end of the year.
examples.chinese: 她希望在年底取得（律師）資格。

examples.english: This course qualifies you to teach in any secondary school.
examples.chinese: 這個課程可以讓你取得在任何中學任教的資格。

examples.english: We check the quality of every batch before shipping.
examples.chinese: 每批產品出貨前，我們都會檢查品質。

examples.english: Please check the quantity before placing your order.
examples.chinese: 請在下單前確認數量。

items.englishDefinition: one of four equal or almost equal parts of something; ¼

examples.english: He cut the orange into quarters.
examples.chinese: 他把柳橙切成了四塊。

examples.english: Under a quarter of people questioned said that they were happily married.
examples.chinese: 不到1/4的受訪者表示他們的婚姻很幸福。

examples.english: We requested a quote for replacing the office windows.
examples.chinese: 我們要求對方提供更換辦公室窗戶的報價。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: to give a price, especially one that will be charged for doing a piece of work

examples.english: The architect has quoted £90,000 to build a patio.
examples.chinese: 對露臺部分，建築師開價九萬英鎊。

items.englishDefinition: completely or extremely

examples.english: The accident radically changed the course of his life.
examples.chinese: 這次事故從根本上改變了他的生活軌跡。

examples.english: Our approach is radically different to that of our competitors.
examples.chinese: 我們的方法與競爭對手完全不同。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: in a way that supports or relates to the belief that there should be great or extreme social or political change

examples.english: Applegarth, a radically minded Liberal, was at the centre of all the political and industrial issues of the 1860s.
examples.chinese: 阿普耳加思是一位思想激進的自由主義者，在1860年代置身于所有政治和工業問題的中心。

examples.english: We need to think more radically to solve these problems.
examples.chinese: 我們需要更徹底地思考以解決這些問題。

items.englishDefinition: in a fast or sudden way

examples.english: Things are changing very rapidly.
examples.chinese: 事情變化非常迅速。

examples.english: The country's oil reserves are rapidly declining.
examples.chinese: 該國的石油儲備正在迅速減少。

items.englishDefinition: an amount or level of payment

examples.english: We agreed a rate with the painter before he started work.
examples.chinese: 開工前，我們和油漆工談好了薪酬。

examples.english: What's the going (= standard) rate for this type of work?
examples.chinese: 這種工作一般酬金是多少？

items.meaning: 主動聯繫；聯絡尋求或提供協助
items.englishDefinition: to contact a person or organization to begin communication
items.cue: 會議與溝通情境：reach out to a supplier
items.notes: 不可分：reach out to them。to 後接聯繫的對象。

examples.english: Please reach out to the supplier about the damaged boxes.
examples.chinese: 請主動聯繫供應商，討論箱子損壞的問題。

examples.english: Our support team will reach out to you if more information is needed.
examples.chinese: 如果需要更多資訊，我們的客服團隊會聯繫你。

items.englishDefinition: according to the facts and what is possible

examples.english: Realistically speaking, he hadn't a hope, but that didn't stop him trying.
examples.chinese: 實事求是地說，他毫無希望，但是這並沒有讓他放棄努力。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: in a way that seems as if it exists

examples.english: He was made up very realistically to look like an old woman.
examples.chinese: 他化了妝，看上去真的像個老太婆。

examples.english: Keep your receipt in case you need to return the item.
examples.chinese: 請保留收據，以備需要退貨時使用。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: something such as a piece of paper or message proving that money, goods, or information have been received

examples.english: Make sure you are given a receipt for everything you buy.
examples.chinese: 買任何東西，都要確認拿到收據。

examples.english: Please sign here to confirm that you received the goods.
examples.chinese: 請在此簽名，確認你已收到貨物。

items.cue: Where hotel guests ask for help

examples.english: You can leave your luggage at reception after checking out.
examples.chinese: 退房後，你可以將行李寄放在接待處。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: the act of welcoming someone or something

examples.english: The new hospital was ready for the reception of its first patients.
examples.chinese: 新醫院已經可以用了，準備收治第一批病人。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: a formal party at which important people are welcomed

examples.english: The president gave a reception for the visiting heads of state.
examples.chinese: 總統舉行招待會款待來訪的外國元首。

items.englishDefinition: a person who receives something

examples.english: Former Nobel Peace Prize recipients include Jimmy Carter and Barack Obama.
examples.chinese: 過去獲得過諾貝爾和平獎的包括吉米·卡特和巴拉克·歐巴馬。

examples.english: He was a recipient of the Civilian Service Award.
examples.chinese: 他被授予平民服務獎章。

items.englishDefinition: to know someone or something because you have seen or heard him or her or experienced it before

examples.english: Do you recognize this song?
examples.chinese: 「你聽出這首歌來了嗎？」

examples.english: I hadn't seen her for 20 years, but I recognized her immediately.
examples.chinese: 我20年沒見她了，但我還是一眼就認出了她。

items.englishDefinition: a suggestion that something is good or suitable for a particular purpose or job

examples.english: I bought this computer on John's recommendation (= because John told me that it was good).
examples.chinese: 我是聽了約翰的推薦才買這台電腦的（因為約翰告訴我它很好）。

examples.english: Keep a record of all payments made to suppliers.
examples.chinese: 請保留所有付給供應商的款項紀錄。

items.cue: Finding people to join a company

examples.english: We plan to recruit two engineers this summer.
examples.chinese: 我們計畫今年夏天招募兩名工程師。

additionalSenses.meaning: 招聘，吸收；（尤指軍隊）徵募新兵
additionalSenses.englishDefinition: to persuade someone to work for a company or become a new member of an organization, especially the army

examples.english: Having slimmed to around 1,400 staff, the company is now recruiting again.
examples.chinese: 在縮減到約1400名員工後，該公司現在又開始招聘。

examples.english: Even young boys are now being recruited into the army.
examples.chinese: 現在連年幼的男孩也被招募入伍。

items.meaning: 可贖回的;可兌現的;可償還的
items.englishDefinition: (of shares, bonds, etc.) able to be exchanged for cash at a particular time

examples.english: An increasing number of listed companies are issuing redeemable shares.
examples.chinese: 越來越多的上市公司現在發行可贖回股份。

examples.english: The 9% unsecured loan stock was redeemable at par on 31 May 2020.
examples.chinese: 這項利率為 9% 的無抵押公司債可於 2020 年 5 月 31 日按面值贖回。

items.cue: Looking at a source for information

examples.english: Refer to the manual if you need help setting up the printer.
examples.chinese: 如果你在設定印表機時需要協助，請參閱使用手冊。

items.englishDefinition: to show, express, or be a sign of something

examples.english: The statistics reflect a change in people's spending habits.
examples.chinese: 這些統計資料顯示出人們的消費習慣發生了變化。

items.englishDefinition: Thinking carefully and quietly.

examples.english: After hearing the news they sat in a quiet, reflective silence.
examples.chinese: 聽到這個消息後，他們都一聲不吭地坐著，陷入了沈思。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: A reflective surface sends back most of the light that shines on it and can therefore be seen easily.

examples.english: Workers must wear reflective jackets when working beside the road at night.
examples.chinese: 工人在夜間於路旁作業時，必須穿著反光外套。

items.englishDefinition: to avoid doing or stop yourself from doing something
items.notes: refrain from

examples.english: We refrained from talking until we knew that it was safe.
examples.chinese: 我們緘默不語，直到確定安全了才開始說話。

examples.english: The sign on the wall said "Please refrain from smoking."
examples.chinese: 牆上有個牌子，上寫「請勿吸煙」。

items.englishDefinition: (small amounts of) food and drink
items.notes: refresh v. ( 通過休息、食物或飲料) 消除.的疲勞，使恢複精神

examples.english: He stopped at a bar for a little refreshment.
examples.chinese: 他在一家小吃店前停下買些點心飲料。

examples.english: Light refreshments will be available at the back of the hall.
examples.chinese: 會堂後面將會供應簡單的茶點。

items.englishDefinition: a piece of kitchen equipment that uses electricity to preserve food at a cold temperature

examples.english: Store fruit juice in the refrigerator.
examples.chinese: 把水果汁儲存在冰箱裡。

examples.english: You will receive a full refund if the event is canceled.
examples.chinese: 如果活動取消，你將獲得全額退款。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: to give someone a refund

examples.english: When I went on business to Peru, the office refunded my expenses.
examples.chinese: 我到秘魯出差，費用由事務所報銷。

examples.english: The holiday was cancelled so the travel agency had to refund everybody the price of the tickets.
examples.chinese: 度假行程取消了，所以旅行社不得不把票款退還給所有人。

items.englishDefinition: to say that you will not do or accept something

examples.english: He asked me to give him another loan, but I refused.
examples.chinese: 他讓我再借給他一筆錢，我拒絕了。

examples.english: He's in trouble but he's refused all (my offers of) help.
examples.chinese: 他遇到了麻煩，但是卻對（我提出的）幫助一概拒絕。

items.meaning: 駁斥;反駁;否認...的正確性（或真實性）
items.englishDefinition: to say or prove that a person, statement, opinion, etc. is wrong or false

examples.english: to refute a person/theory/argument/claim
examples.chinese: 駁斥一個人／理論／論點／說法

items.englishDefinition: to consider or have an opinion about something or someone
items.notes: reward 獎賞

examples.english: Her parents always regarded her as the smartest of their children.
examples.chinese: 她父母一貫把她看作是所有子女中最聰明的。

examples.english: He is generally/widely regarded as the father of international law.
examples.chinese: 他被普遍／廣泛認為是國際法之父。

items.meaning: 使人悔恨的；令人遺憾的；不幸的；可悲的
items.englishDefinition: making you feel sad and sorry about something

examples.english: a most/deeply regrettable mistake
examples.chinese: 令人深感懊悔的錯誤

items.englishDefinition: with equal or similar amounts of space or time between one and the next

examples.english: We meet regularly to discuss progress on the project.
examples.chinese: 我們有規律地定期見面討論企劃案進展。

examples.english: The competitors set off at regularly spaced intervals.
examples.chinese: 競賽者每隔相同的時間出發。

items.meaning: 規則，條例，法規；控制，管理
items.englishDefinition: an official rule or the act of controlling something
items.notes: customs regulations 海關規定

examples.english: The correct procedure is laid down in the rules and regulations.
examples.chinese: 正確的程式在規章條例中有規定。

examples.english: safety/health/traffic/fire/security regulations
examples.chinese: 安全／衛生／交通／消防／保安條例

additionalSenses.meaning: 一般的，普通的；規定的；正規的
additionalSenses.englishDefinition: according to the rules or the usual way of doing things

examples.english: It's regulation to wear suits at the office.
examples.chinese: 按規定在辦公室要穿西裝。

examples.english: businessmen in their regulation pinstripe suits
examples.chinese: 身著細條紋正式西裝的商人

examples.english: The company will reimburse you for approved travel expenses.
examples.chinese: 公司會償還你經核准的差旅費用。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: to pay back money to someone who has spent it for you or lost it because of you
additionalSenses.notes: re 再，im 進入，burse 錢包 ---> 再進入錢包 ---> 償還

examples.english: The airline reimbursed me for the amount they had overcharged me.
examples.chinese: 航空公司把多收的錢退還給我了。

examples.english: She was reimbursed by the gas company for the damage to her house.
examples.chinese: 煤氣公司對她房屋遭受的損失進行了賠償。

items.englishDefinition: the act of paying back money to someone who has spent it for you or lost it because of you, or the amount that is paid back

examples.english: She has received reimbursement for some of her costs.
examples.chinese: 她的部分開銷已經報銷了。

examples.english: Employees can apply for reimbursement of travel expenses.
examples.chinese: 員工可申請報銷差旅費。

items.englishDefinition: said when you are judging one thing in comparison with other things

examples.english: Relatively speaking, it's a fairly poor country.
examples.chinese: 相對而言，這是個很貧窮的國家。

items.cue: A service you can depend on

examples.english: We need a reliable delivery service for urgent orders.
examples.chinese: 我們需要可靠的配送服務來處理急件訂單。

additionalSenses.meaning: 可信賴的;可靠的;真實可信的
additionalSenses.englishDefinition: Someone or something that is reliable can be trusted or believed because he, she, or it works or behaves well in the way you expect.

examples.english: Gideon is very reliable - if he says he'll do something, he'll do it.
examples.chinese: 吉迪恩爲人很可靠——他說到做到。

examples.english: Is your watch reliable?
examples.chinese: 你的錶準嗎？

items.englishDefinition: needing a particular thing or person in order to continue, to work correctly, or to succeed

examples.english: He's completely reliant on his wheelchair to get about.
examples.chinese: 他完全依靠輪椅出行。

examples.english: The project is heavily reliant on volunteers.
examples.chinese: 該專案幾乎完全依賴於志願者。

items.meaning: 緩解，減輕，解除（疼痛或擔憂）；使寬心，使寬慰
items.englishDefinition: to make an unpleasant feeling, such as pain or worry, less strong

examples.english: She was given a shot of morphine to relieve the pain.
examples.chinese: 醫生給她注射了一針嗎啡來止痛。

examples.english: She relieved her boredom at home by learning how to type.
examples.chinese: 她在家學打字來打發無聊的時光。

items.englishDefinition: in a way that shows that you are not willing to do something and are therefore slow to do it

examples.english: She reluctantly agreed to step down as managing director.
examples.chinese: 她勉強同意辭去總經理的職務。

examples.english: Reluctantly, he did what I asked.
examples.chinese: 他不情願地照我說的做了。

items.englishDefinition: to trust someone or something to provide what is needed
items.cue: 職場與人事情境：rely on a supplier
items.notes: 介系詞動詞，不可分：rely on them。可用 rely on someone to do something。

examples.english: Small stores often rely on local suppliers for fresh produce.
examples.chinese: 小型商店常仰賴當地供應商提供新鮮農產品。

examples.english: You can rely on our team to deliver the report on time.
examples.chinese: 你可以信賴我們的團隊準時交付報告。

items.englishDefinition: the part of something that is left after the other parts have gone, been used, or been taken away
items.notes: remaining 剩餘的 形容詞

examples.english: I ate most of it and gave the remainder to the dog.
examples.chinese: 我吃了一大半，剩下的餵狗了。

examples.english: It rained the first day but the remainder of the trip was fine.
examples.chinese: 旅行中第一天下了雨，不過其餘的日子天氣都很好。

items.meaning: 非凡的；奇異的；引人注目的
items.englishDefinition: unusual or special and therefore surprising and worth mentioning
items.notes: re 再，mark 記號，able ---> 再做記號 ---> 值得注意的

examples.english: The 20th century was remarkable for its inventions.
examples.chinese: 20世紀重大發明不斷，令人驚歎。

examples.english: Meeting you here in Rome is a remarkable coincidence.
examples.chinese: 能在羅馬這地方遇到你可真是驚人的巧合。

items.englishDefinition: the act of making an official document, agreement, or rule continue for more time

examples.english: Do you deal with season-ticket renewals here?
examples.chinese: 在你這裡可以續買季票嗎？

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: the act of starting again or starting to do something again

examples.english: They fear the renewal of hostilities if an agreement is not reached soon.
examples.chinese: 如果不能很快達成協議，他們擔心會再次爆發敵對行動。

items.meaning: 修復，翻新，整修（尤指建築物）
items.englishDefinition: to repair and improve something, especially a building

examples.english: He renovates old houses and sells them at a profit.
examples.chinese: 他靠翻修老房子再出售賺錢。

collocations: rent a car for a week
rent a car at the airport

examples.english: We plan to rent a car at the airport for the business trip.
examples.chinese: 我們計畫在機場租車，供出差使用。

examples.english: A technician will repair the printer tomorrow.
examples.chinese: 技術人員明天會來修理印表機。

examples.english: We need to replace the battery in the alarm.
examples.chinese: 我們需要更換警報器的電池。

items.englishDefinition: the process of replacing something with something else

examples.english: the replacement of existing computer equipment
examples.chinese: 更換現有的電腦設備

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: someone who does a job instead of someone else, or something that you use instead of something else

examples.english: The agency sent a replacement for the secretary who resigned.
examples.chinese: 代理行派來了一個人接替辭職的秘書。

examples.english: Please reply to this email by Thursday.
examples.chinese: 請在星期四以前回覆這封電子郵件。

examples.english: The report explains why delivery costs increased.
examples.chinese: 這份報告說明了配送成本增加的原因。

items.meaning: 代表（國家，學校等參加比賽）
items.englishDefinition: to be the person from a country, school, etc. that is in a competition

examples.english: She was chosen to represent France at the Olympics.
examples.chinese: 她獲選代表法國參加奧運會。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: to be a sign or symbol of something

examples.english: To many people the White House represents the identity of the United States.
examples.chinese: 在許多人看來，白宮是美國的象徵。

examples.english: A customer service representative will call you this afternoon.
examples.chinese: 一位客服人員今天下午會打電話給你。

examples.english: Your request for additional supplies has been approved.
examples.chinese: 你申請額外用品的要求已獲核准。

items.englishDefinition: to need something or make something necessary

examples.english: Please call this number if you require any further information.
examples.chinese: 如需更多資訊請撥此電話號碼垂詢。

examples.english: Bringing up children often requires you to put their needs first.
examples.chinese: 撫養孩子常要把他們的需要放在首位。

examples.english: You are required by law to stop your car after an accident.
examples.chinese: 法律規定，發生事故後必須停車。

examples.english: This material meets our safety requirements.
examples.chinese: 這種材料符合我們的安全要求。

examples.english: We need to reschedule the meeting because the manager is away.
examples.chinese: 因為主管不在，我們需要重新安排會議時間。

items.englishDefinition: an arrangement in which something such as a seat on an aircraft or a table at a restaurant is kept for you

examples.english: I'd like to make a table reservation for two people for nine o'clock.
examples.chinese: 我要預訂九點兩人用餐的桌位。

examples.english: Please confirm your reservation in writing by Friday.
examples.chinese: 請在星期五前對您的預訂予以書面確認。

examples.english: Please confirm your reservation before traveling.
examples.chinese: 出發前，請確認你的預訂。

items.englishDefinition: If you reserve something such as a seat on an aircraft or a table at a restaurant, you arrange for it to be kept for your use.

examples.english: I reserved a double room at the Lamb Hotel.
examples.chinese: 我在蘭姆飯店預訂了一間雙人房。

examples.english: If you get there early, reserve me a seat/reserve a seat for me.
examples.chinese: 如果你先到那裡，給我預訂個座位。

additionalSenses.meaning: 把...專門留給;把...留作;保留
additionalSenses.englishDefinition: to keep something for a particular purpose or time

examples.english: I reserve Mondays for tidying my desk and answering letters.
examples.chinese: 我把週一的時間留出來專門清理辦公桌和回覆信件。

examples.english: These seats are reserved for the elderly and women with babies.
examples.chinese: 這些座位是專留給老人和抱小孩的婦女的。

items.englishDefinition: a home

examples.english: the Governor's official residence
examples.chinese: 總督官邸

examples.english: He decided to resign from his position and return to school.
examples.chinese: 他決定辭去職位，重返校園。

items.meaning: 辭職;辭去（職務）;放棄（工作）
items.englishDefinition: the act of telling your employer that you are leaving your job
items.notes: resign 辭職，辭去

examples.english: There have been calls for his resignation.
examples.chinese: 一直有呼聲要求他辭職。

examples.english: I handed in/gave in/sent in my resignation this morning.
examples.chinese: 我今天上午提交了辭職信。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: a sad feeling of accepting something that you do not like because you cannot easily change it

examples.english: They received the news with resignation.
examples.chinese: 消息傳來，他們聽天由命接受了一切。

examples.english: We hope to resolve your complaint before the end of the day.
examples.chinese: 我們希望在今天結束前解決你的客訴。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: to solve or end a problem or difficulty

examples.english: Have you resolved the problem of transport yet?
examples.chinese: 你們解決交通問題了嗎？

examples.english: The couple resolved their differences and made an effort to get along.
examples.chinese: 這對夫妻消除了他們之間的分歧，盡力融洽相處。

items.englishDefinition: a place where many people go for rest, sport, or another stated purpose

examples.english: a tourist resort
examples.chinese: 旅遊勝地

examples.english: a holiday resort
examples.chinese: 度假勝地

examples.english: a ski resort
examples.chinese: 滑雪勝地

items.englishDefinition: in a way that relates or belongs to each of the separate people or things you have just mentioned

examples.english: In the 200 metres, Lizzy and Sarah came first and third respectively (= Lizzy won the race and Sarah was third).
examples.chinese: 在 200 米比賽中，莉茜 和 薩拉 分別獲得第一和第三名（莉茜贏得比賽，薩拉獲得第三名）。

examples.english: Steven and James are aged 10 and 13 respectively.
examples.chinese: 史蒂文和詹姆斯的年齡分別為 10 歲和 13 歲。

items.englishDefinition: a person who answers a request for information

examples.english: In a recent opinion poll, a majority of respondents were against nuclear weapons.
examples.chinese: 在最近的一次民意調查中，大多數受訪者表示反對發展核子武器。

examples.english: Her main responsibility is to organize staff training.
examples.chinese: 她的主要職責是安排員工訓練。

items.meaning: 修復；使恢復原狀；使復職
items.englishDefinition: to return something or someone to an earlier good condition or position

examples.english: After a week in bed, she was fully restored to health (= she felt healthy again).
examples.chinese: 臥床一週後，她完全恢復了健康。

examples.english: The badly neglected paintings have all been carefully restored.
examples.chinese: 那些長期缺乏妥善照料的畫作，都已獲得仔細修復。

items.englishDefinition: to limit the movements or actions of someone, or to limit something and reduce its size or prevent it from increasing
items.notes:
restrict A to B：將 A 限定於 B。
lift/remove a restriction：解除限制。
restrict 是動詞，restriction 是名詞。
限制數量或範圍時，可用 limit。

examples.english: The government has restricted freedom of movement into and out of the country.
examples.chinese: 政府已經限制出入境自由了。

examples.english: measures to restrict the sale of alcohol
examples.chinese: 限制酒類銷售的措施

items.cue: A document for a job application

examples.english: Please attach your resume to the application email.
examples.chinese: 請將你的履歷附在求職電子郵件中。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: a short written description of your education, qualifications, previous jobs, and sometimes also your personal interests, that you send to an employer when you are trying to get a job

examples.english: She sent her résumé to 50 companies, but didn't even get an interview.
examples.chinese: 她把履歷寄給了五十家公司，卻連一次面試機會都沒有。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: If an activity resumes, or if you resume it, it starts again after a pause.

examples.english: Normal services will be resumed in the spring.
examples.chinese: 春天將恢復正常服務。

examples.english: He stopped to take a sip of water and then resumed speaking.
examples.chinese: 他停下來呷了一口水，然後繼續發言。

examples.english: The talks are due to resume today.
examples.chinese: 會談預定今天繼續進行。

items.englishDefinition: the activity of selling goods to the public, usually in shops

examples.english: The job is open to applicants with over two years' experience in retail.
examples.chinese: 這份工作面向有兩年以上零售經驗的應徵者。

examples.english: The clothing company has six retail outlets (= shops) in Perth.
examples.chinese: 這間服裝公司在珀斯開設了六家零售店。

items.englishDefinition: to keep or continue to have something

examples.english: She has lost her battle to retain control of the company.
examples.chinese: 她被打敗了，失去了繼續掌管公司的權力。

examples.english: She succeeded in retaining her lead in the second half of the race.
examples.chinese: 在比賽的後半程中，她成功地保住了領先地位。

examples.english: I have a good memory and am able to retain (= remember) facts easily.
examples.chinese: 我記憶力很好，記東西不費勁。

items.cue: Leaving work at the end of a career

examples.english: Our department manager plans to retire next year.
examples.chinese: 我們的部門經理計畫明年退休。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: to leave your job or stop working because of old age or ill health

examples.english: Since retiring from the company, she has done voluntary work for a charity.
examples.chinese: 從公司退休後，她就一直在為一間慈善機構做志願工作。

examples.english: He is due to retire as chief executive next year.
examples.chinese: 明年他就該從總裁職位上退下來了。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: to leave a room or group of people and go somewhere quiet or private

examples.english: After dinner our host said, "Shall we retire to the drawing room?"
examples.chinese: 晚餐過後主人說道，「我們到休息室去好不好？」

examples.english: You may return the item within fourteen days with your receipt.
examples.chinese: 你可以在十四天內憑收據退回這件商品。

items.englishDefinition: to make known or show something that is surprising or that was previously secret

examples.english: He was jailed for revealing secrets to the Russians.
examples.chinese: 他因為向俄國人洩密而被監禁。

examples.english: Her biography revealed that she was not as rich as everyone thought.
examples.chinese: 她的自傳透露她並非像大家所想像的那樣富有。

examples.english: Online sales account for half of the company's revenue.
examples.chinese: 線上銷售占公司營收的一半。

additionalSenses.meaning: （政府的）稅收，歲入;（公司的）收益
additionalSenses.englishDefinition: the income that a government or company receives regularly

examples.english: Taxes provide most of the government's revenue.
examples.chinese: 政府收入的大部分來自稅收。

examples.english: Government revenues fell dramatically.
examples.chinese: 政府財政收入大幅下降。

examples.english: We need to revise the proposal before sending it to the client.
examples.chinese: 我們需要先修訂提案，再寄給客戶。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: to look at or consider again an idea, piece of writing, etc. in order to correct or improve it

examples.english: His helpfulness today has made me revise my original opinion/impression of him.
examples.chinese: 他今天所表現出的樂於助人的品質使我改變了對他的最初看法／印象。

examples.english: His publishers made him revise his manuscript three times.
examples.chinese: 出版公司讓他把手稿修改了三次。

items.englishDefinition: a change that is made to something, or the process of doing this

examples.english: He was forced to make several revisions to his speech.
examples.chinese: 他被迫對發言稿作了幾處修改。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: Studying material again to prepare for an examination.

examples.english: She did no revision, but she still got a very high mark.
examples.chinese: 她沒有複習，但是仍然考了很高的分數。

items.englishDefinition: relating to or participating in a revolution

examples.english: a revolutionary leader/movement
examples.chinese: 革命領導人／運動

additionalSenses.meaning: 革命性的；帶來重大變革的
additionalSenses.englishDefinition: introducing something new that causes major change

examples.english: The 20th century brought about revolutionary changes in our lifestyles.
examples.chinese: 二十世紀带來人們生活上的巨大轉變。

examples.english: I would like to book a room for two nights.
examples.chinese: 我想預訂一間房，住兩晚。

items.cue: A ticket for going and returning

examples.english: A round-trip ticket costs less than two one-way tickets.
examples.chinese: 一張來回票比兩張單程票便宜。

items.cue: The path used for a journey

examples.english: The driver chose a different route to avoid traffic.
examples.chinese: 司機選擇了另一條路線，以避開車潮。

items.englishDefinition: a usual or fixed way of doing things

examples.english: There's no set/fixed routine at work - every day is different.
examples.chinese: 工作內容不固定——每天都不同。

examples.english: Most companies insure property and equipment against damage or theft as a matter of routine.
examples.chinese: 作為常規，大多數公司都為其財產和設備購買損壞或盜竊保險。

items.englishDefinition: to decide that a possibility should no longer be considered
items.cue: 商務與法規情境：rule out a possibility
items.notes: 可分：rule the option out；代名詞用 rule it out。常見 cannot rule out 表示尚不能排除。

examples.english: The technician ruled out a power failure as the cause of the problem.
examples.chinese: 技術人員排除了停電是問題原因的可能性。

examples.english: The proposal may be expensive, but we should not rule it out yet.
examples.chinese: 這個提案可能很昂貴，但我們還不應排除它。

items.englishDefinition: to encounter an unexpected problem
items.cue: 產品與物流情境：run into difficulties
items.notes: 不可分：run into a problem。run 的過去式為 ran；此處學遇到問題，另有偶遇他人的詞義。

examples.english: We ran into a problem while testing the new payment system.
examples.chinese: 測試新的付款系統時，我們遇到了問題。

examples.english: The project may run into difficulties if the parts arrive late.
examples.chinese: 如果零件晚到，專案可能會遇到困難。

examples.english: We have run out of packing tape and need to order more.
examples.chinese: 我們的包裝膠帶已經用完，需要再訂購。

items.meaning: 鄉村的，農村的;似鄉村的
items.englishDefinition: in, of, or like the countryside

examples.english: The area is still very rural and undeveloped.
examples.chinese: 這個地區仍是一片鄉村景象，沒有被開發。

items.meaning: （上下班）交通高峰時間，交通擁擠時間
items.englishDefinition: the busy part of the day when towns and cities are crowded, either in the morning when people are travelling to work, or in the evening when people are travelling home

examples.english: rush hour traffic
examples.chinese: 交通高峰時段的車流

examples.english: All employees must follow the factory's safety rules.
examples.chinese: 所有員工都必須遵守工廠的安全規則。

examples.english: The starting salary is listed in the job advertisement.
examples.chinese: 求職廣告上列出了起薪。

examples.english: Sales of the new model increased last month.
examples.chinese: 新款機型的銷售量上個月增加了。

items.cue: How customers feel about a service

examples.english: The hotel sends a satisfaction survey after each stay.
examples.chinese: 飯店會在每次住宿結束後寄送滿意度調查。

examples.english: Please check the work schedule before requesting a day off.
examples.chinese: 請先查看工作時間表，再申請休假一天。

items.englishDefinition: to cut or damage a surface or your skin slightly with or on something sharp or rough

examples.english: We scratched the wall trying to get the bed into Martha's room.
examples.chinese: 我們把床搬進瑪莎的房間裡時，把牆面給劃壞了。

examples.english: Be careful not to scratch yourself on the roses.
examples.chinese: 當心不要被玫瑰刺紮傷。

items.englishDefinition: relating to or happening during a particular period in the year

examples.english: seasonal vegetables
examples.chinese: 時令蔬菜

examples.english: seasonal farm work
examples.chinese: 季節性農田工作

items.englishDefinition: someone who works in an office, writing letters, making phone calls, and arranging meetings for a person or for an organization

examples.english: My secretary will phone you to arrange a meeting.
examples.chinese: 我的秘書會打電話給你安排會議。

items.englishDefinition: positioned or fastened firmly and correctly and therefore not likely to move, fall, or break

examples.english: Please ensure that your seat belts are fastened securely.
examples.chinese: 請確保繫緊你們的安全帶。

examples.english: He has given up political power, but he remains securely in control of the army.
examples.chinese: 他放棄了政治權力，但仍然牢牢掌握著軍隊的控制大權。
