items.englishDefinition: to sell all available items or tickets
items.cue: 行銷與客服情境：sell out quickly
items.notes: 商品或票券作主詞：the tickets sold out；商店可用 sell out of 加商品。sold 是 sell 的過去式。

examples.english: Tickets for the training conference sold out in two days.
examples.chinese: 訓練研討會的票券在兩天內售罄。

examples.english: We have sold out of the blue jackets, but the gray ones are still available.
examples.chinese: 藍色外套已售罄，但灰色款仍有貨。

items.englishDefinition: not together

examples.english: Detectives interviewed the men separately over several days.
examples.chinese: 幾天內，偵探們分別盤問了那些人。

examples.english: I tend to wear the jacket and skirt separately rather than as a suit.
examples.chinese: 我想把上衣和裙子分開穿，而不想當套裝穿。

examples.english: This restaurant serves lunch until three in the afternoon.
examples.chinese: 這家餐廳供應午餐到下午三點。

examples.english: The store offers a free delivery service for large items.
examples.chinese: 這家商店提供大型商品的免費配送服務。

examples.english: We need to set up the projector before the presentation.
examples.chinese: 我們需要在簡報前架好投影機。

items.meaning: 確定;決定;解決，結束（爭端等）
items.englishDefinition: to reach a decision or an agreement about something, or to end a disagreement

examples.english: They haven't yet settled when the wedding is going to be.
examples.chinese: 他們還沒有確訂婚禮在甚麽時候舉行。

examples.english: Good, that's all settled - you send out the invitations for the party, and I'll organize the food.
examples.chinese: 好，那就這麽決定了——你發送派對的請帖，我來準備吃的。

items.englishDefinition: very seriously

examples.english: Their daughter was severely injured in a car accident.
examples.chinese: 他們的女兒在一次車禍中受了重傷。

examples.english: I was severely reprimanded by my boss.
examples.chinese: 我被老闆狠狠地斥責了一頓。

items.englishDefinition: a person who owns shares in a company and therefore gets part of the company's profits and the right to vote on how the company is controlled

examples.english: Shareholders will be voting on the proposed merger of the companies next week.
examples.chinese: 股東們下星期將投票表決擬議中的公司合併問題。

items.meaning: （通常指固定在牆上或櫥櫃中的）架子
items.englishDefinition: a long, flat board fixed horizontally, usually against a wall or inside a cupboard so that objects can be stored on it

examples.english: One wall had shelves from floor to ceiling, crammed with books.
examples.chinese: 一面牆是高及天花板的書架，上面塞滿了書。

examples.english: We ship replacement parts to customers around the world.
examples.chinese: 我們將替換零件運送給世界各地的客戶。

examples.english: The shipment of office chairs arrived this morning.
examples.chinese: 這批辦公椅今天早上送達了。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: a large amount of goods sent together to a place, or the act of sending them

examples.english: A shipment of urgent medical supplies is expected to arrive very soon.
examples.chinese: 一批急需的藥品預計很快就到。

items.englishDefinition: an opportunity for the public to see something

examples.english: This is the film's first showing on television.
examples.chinese: 這是該電影首次在電視上播放。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: the quality of someone's performance in a competition

examples.english: She managed a good/strong showing in the world championship.
examples.chinese: 她在世界錦標賽上表現非常出色。

examples.english: She had a dismal showing in the opinion polls.
examples.chinese: 她在民意調查中表現不佳。

items.meaning: 關閉；停止運作（系統或設備）
items.englishDefinition: to stop a machine or system from operating
items.cue: 設施與環境情境：shut down a computer
items.notes: 可分：shut it down；系統自行停止可用 the system shut down。shut 的過去式仍為 shut。

examples.english: The technician will shut down the server for maintenance tonight.
examples.chinese: 技術人員今晚將關閉伺服器進行維護。

examples.english: The machine is making an unusual noise; shut it down immediately.
examples.chinese: 機器發出異常聲音，請立即關閉。

items.englishDefinition: to record that you have arrived
items.cue: 職場與人事情境：sign in at reception
items.notes: 本詞義可不接受詞：sign in at reception。此處學到場簽到；電腦登入另見 log in。

examples.english: All visitors must sign in at the reception desk.
examples.chinese: 所有訪客都必須在接待櫃檯簽到。

examples.english: Please sign in before entering the training room.
examples.chinese: 進入訓練教室前，請先簽到。

items.englishDefinition: to register to take part in an activity or service
items.cue: 職場與人事情境：sign up for a workshop
items.notes: sign up for 加活動名稱；sign up 本身可單獨使用。不要把名詞 signup 當作動詞。

examples.english: Employees can sign up for the safety workshop on the company website.
examples.chinese: 員工可以在公司網站報名參加安全講習。

examples.english: I signed up for an evening course to improve my presentation skills.
examples.chinese: 我報名了晚間課程，以提升簡報能力。

examples.english: A signature is required at the bottom of the form.
examples.chinese: 表格底部需要簽名。

items.englishDefinition: important or noticeable

examples.english: There has been a significant increase in the number of women students in recent years.
examples.chinese: 近年來，女學生的人數有了顯著增加。

examples.english: There was no significant change in blood pressure.
examples.chinese: 血壓沒有顯著變化。

items.englishDefinition: in a way that is easy to see or by a large amount

examples.english: My piano playing has improved significantly since I started with a new teacher.
examples.chinese: 自從換了一位新老師，我的鋼琴水準有了明顯提升。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: in a way that suggests a special meaning

examples.english: He said that he would be bringing a friend with him but, significantly, didn't say who it was.
examples.chinese: 他說會帶一個朋友來，但耐人尋味的是，他沒說出那人是誰。

items.englishDefinition: in a way that is simultaneous (= happening or being done at exactly the same time)

examples.english: Two children answered the teacher's question simultaneously.
examples.chinese: 兩個孩子同時回答了老師的問題。

examples.english: The network was broadcasting four games simultaneously across the country.
examples.chinese: 這家電視臺在全國同時播放四場比賽。

items.englishDefinition: to drink, taking only a very small amount at a time

examples.english: This tea is very hot, so sip it carefully.
examples.chinese: 這茶很燙，喝的時候小心點。

examples.english: She slowly sipped (at) her wine.
examples.chinese: 她慢慢地啜飲葡萄酒。

examples.english: Good communication skills are important for this role.
examples.chinese: 良好的溝通技能對這個職位很重要。

items.englishDefinition: a little

examples.english: She's slightly taller than her sister.
examples.chinese: 她比她姐姐稍高一點。

examples.english: I'm slightly upset she forgot my birthday.
examples.chinese: 她忘了我的生日，我有點不高興。

items.englishDefinition: to rise very quickly to a high level

examples.english: Temperatures will soar over the weekend, say the weather forecasters.
examples.chinese: 天氣預報員說，氣溫會在週末驟升。

examples.english: House prices soared a further 20 percent.
examples.chinese: 房價又竄升了20％。

items.englishDefinition: only and not involving anyone or anything else

examples.english: I bought it solely for that purpose.
examples.chinese: 我僅僅是爲那個目的才買的。

examples.english: It seems he's not solely to blame for the accident.
examples.chinese: 發生這起事故似乎不能只責怪他。

examples.english: The support team found a simple solution to the problem.
examples.chinese: 支援團隊找到了這個問題的簡單解決方法。

items.englishDefinition: intelligent or made in a complicated way and therefore able to do complicated tasks

examples.english: I think a more sophisticated approach is needed to solve this problem.
examples.chinese: 我認為要解決這個問題需要更為高明的方法。

examples.english: These are among the most sophisticated weapons in the world.
examples.chinese: 這些屬於世界上最尖端的武器。

additionalSenses.meaning: 精於世故的，老練的;見多識廣的;很有品味的
additionalSenses.englishDefinition: having a good understanding of the way people behave and/or a good knowledge of culture and fashion

examples.english: I don't think I have any books that would suit your sophisticated tastes.
examples.chinese: 我認為我沒有什麽書能滿足你那高雅的品味。

examples.english: He was older than me and from London and I thought him very sophisticated.
examples.chinese: 他比我大，而且來自倫敦，我覺得他為人很老練。

items.englishDefinition: to deal successfully with a problem or confusing situation
items.cue: 行銷與客服情境：sort out a problem
items.notes: 可分：sort the problem out；代名詞用 sort it out。

examples.english: The service desk helped us sort out the billing problem.
examples.chinese: 服務櫃檯協助我們解決帳單問題。

examples.english: There is a mistake in your order, but we will sort it out today.
examples.chinese: 你的訂單有誤，但我們今天會處理妥當。

items.englishDefinition: large and with a lot of space

examples.english: a spacious house/living room
examples.chinese: 寬敞的房子／起居室

examples.english: spacious accommodation
examples.chinese: 寬敞的住宿條件

items.englishDefinition: If something is spare, it is available to use because it is extra.

examples.english: Could I have a word with you when you have a spare moment/minute?
examples.chinese: 如果你有時間，我能否和你談兩句？

examples.english: We have a spare room if you want to stay overnight with us.
examples.chinese: 要是你想在我們這裡過夜的話，我們有一個空房間。

items.meaning: 專門研究，專攻；專門從事
items.englishDefinition: to spend most of your time studying one particular subject or doing one type of business

examples.english: She hired a lawyer who specializes in divorce cases.
examples.chinese: 她聘請了一位專辦離婚案件的律師。

examples.english: I enjoy working in general medicine, but I hope to be able to specialize in the future.
examples.chinese: 我喜歡從事一般醫療工作，但希望將來能專攻某個領域。

items.englishDefinition: clearly, exactly, or in detail

examples.english: I specifically asked you not to be late.
examples.chinese: 我明確地告訴過你不要遲到。

examples.english: It specifically said/stated on the label that the jacket should be dry-cleaned only.
examples.chinese: 標籤上明確標明這件夾克衫只能乾洗。

examples.english: Check the specifications to make sure the printer fits your needs.
examples.chinese: 請查看規格，確認這台印表機符合你的需求。

additionalSenses.meaning: 規格；規範；標準；明細單；詳細說明
additionalSenses.englishDefinition: a detailed description of how something should be done, made, etc.

examples.english: All products are made exactly to the customer's specifications.
examples.chinese: 所有産品完全按照客戶的具體要求製造。

examples.english: A specification has been drawn up for the new military aircraft.
examples.chinese: 新型軍用飛機的規格已經草擬出來了。

items.englishDefinition: to explain or describe something clearly and exactly

examples.english: He said we should meet but didn't specify a time.
examples.chinese: 他說我們應該見個面，但沒說具體時間。

examples.english: The newspaper report did not specify how the men were killed.
examples.chinese: 該報的報道並未說明被害人是如何被殺害的。

items.englishDefinition: the activity of guessing possible answers to a question without having enough information to be certain

examples.english: Speculation about his future plans is rife.
examples.chinese: 對他未來的計劃臆測很多，眾說紛紜。

examples.english: Rumours that they are about to marry have been dismissed as pure speculation.
examples.chinese: 關於他們即將結婚的傳聞，已被斥為純粹的猜測。

items.englishDefinition: (of a business or other organization) to pay for someone to do something or for something to happen

examples.english: The participants' employers sponsor them for the six-month training program.
examples.chinese: 參與者的僱主贊助他們參加為期六個月的培訓計劃。

examples.english: His organization sponsored the study.
examples.chinese: 他的組織贊助了這項研究。

examples.english: The hotel staff helped us find a nearby restaurant.
examples.chinese: 飯店工作人員協助我們找到附近的餐廳。

items.englishDefinition: not growing or developing
items.notes: 助記：stagn（停滯）。

examples.english: a stagnant economy
examples.chinese: 停滯的經濟

items.englishDefinition: a level of quality

examples.english: We have very high safety standards in this laboratory.
examples.chinese: 我們這個實驗室有很高的安全標準。

examples.english: Her technique became a standard against which all future methods were compared.
examples.chinese: 她的技術成了後來所有方法的比照標準。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: a moral rule that should be obeyed

examples.english: Most people agree that there are standards (of behaviour) that need to be upheld.
examples.chinese: 大多數人認同人們需要遵守一定的（行為）準則。

items.englishDefinition: a record of the amounts of money paid into and taken out of your bank account during a particular period of time

examples.english: Check your statement and see if the money has been taken from your bank account.
examples.chinese: 查看你的對帳單，確認這筆錢是否已從銀行帳戶扣除。

examples.english: He keeps all his bank statements and files them away.
examples.chinese: 他保留所有銀行對帳單，並將它們歸檔。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: something that someone says or writes officially, or an action done to express an opinion

examples.english: The government is expected to issue a statement about the investigation to the press.
examples.chinese: 預計政府會就該調查向媒體作出說明。

examples.english: We were not surprised by their statement that jobs would be cut.
examples.chinese: 我們對他們宣佈將進行裁員的消息並不感到吃驚。

items.englishDefinition: gradually

examples.english: Prices have risen steadily.
examples.chinese: 物價持續上漲。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: calmly and in a controlled way

examples.english: She returned his gaze steadily.
examples.chinese: 她鎮定地跟他對視。

items.englishDefinition: to leave a position of authority voluntarily
items.cue: 職場與人事情境：step down as chair
items.notes: 不接受直接受詞；step down as 加職位，step down from 加所辭的職位。

examples.english: The board chair will step down at the end of the year.
examples.chinese: 董事長將在年底卸任。

examples.english: After ten years in the role, she decided to step down as director.
examples.chinese: 擔任該職務十年後，她決定辭去主管一職。

items.englishDefinition: a rule that must be followed or something that must be done

examples.english: Is there any stipulation concerning the number of people attending the conference?
examples.chinese: 參加會議的人數方面有什麼明確的要求嗎？

examples.english: The only stipulation is that candidates must be over the age of 35.
examples.chinese: 唯一的規定是候選人必須年滿35歲。

items.englishDefinition: to mix a liquid or other substance by moving an object such as a spoon in a circular pattern

examples.english: Stir the sauce gently until it begins to boil.
examples.chinese: 慢慢攪動醬汁直至煮沸。

examples.english: Stir the egg yolks into the mixture.
examples.chinese: 將蛋黃攪拌至混合料中。

items.englishDefinition: a supply of something for use or sale

examples.english: It is now halfway through winter and food stocks are already low.
examples.chinese: 現在冬天剛剛過半，但食物的儲備已經不足。

examples.english: The local shop has a good stock of postcards and guidebooks.
examples.chinese: 本地商店備有大量明信片和旅遊指南。

items.englishDefinition: to make a brief visit to a place
items.cue: 旅遊與生活情境：stop by the office
items.notes: 常直接接地點：stop by the office；也可單獨用 stop by。stop by to 加拜訪目的。

examples.english: Please stop by the office to collect your visitor badge.
examples.chinese: 請順道到辦公室領取訪客證。

examples.english: I will stop by the store after work to pick up the order.
examples.chinese: 我下班後會順道到商店取貨。

items.meaning: 戰略；策略；計謀；行動計劃；策劃，部署
items.englishDefinition: a detailed plan for achieving success in situations such as war, politics, business, industry, or sport, or the skill of planning for such situations

examples.english: We're working on new strategies to improve our share of the market.
examples.chinese: 我們正在制訂新策略來增加我們的市場佔有率。

examples.english: Their marketing strategy for the product involves obtaining as much free publicity as possible.
examples.chinese: 他們對這個產品採取的市場策略包括盡可能去爭取免費的宣傳機會。

items.englishDefinition: to make something stronger or more effective, or to become stronger or more effective
items.notes: strength 力量

examples.english: They have been strengthening their border defences in preparation for war.
examples.chinese: 他們一直在為備戰而強化邊防。

examples.english: His battle against cancer has strengthened his belief in God.
examples.chinese: 他跟癌症的鬥爭堅定了他對上帝的信仰。

examples.english: The rise in US interest rates caused the dollar to strengthen (= increase in value) against all the Asian currencies.
examples.chinese: 美國加息導致美元對所有亞洲貨幣升值。

items.englishDefinition: strongly limiting someone's freedom to behave as they wish, or likely to severely punish someone if they do not obey

examples.english: My parents were very strict with me when I was young.
examples.chinese: 小時候父母對我要求非常嚴格。

examples.english: Stricter controls on air pollution would help to reduce acid rain.
examples.chinese: 加強控制空氣污染將會有助於減少酸雨。

items.englishDefinition: to have or experience a particular thing, especially something unpleasant

examples.english: Cars are subject to a high domestic tax.
examples.chinese: 買汽車要繳很高的國內稅。

examples.english: In recent years, she has been subject to attacks of depression.
examples.chinese: 近年來，她一直飽受憂鬱症的折磨。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: only able to happen if something else happens

examples.english: We plan to go on Wednesday, subject to your approval.
examples.chinese: 如果你同意，我們打算週三走。

examples.english: Moving all the books should not take long, subject to there being (= if there are) enough helpers.
examples.chinese: 如果有足夠人手，把所有書都搬走花不了多少時間。

examples.english: Please submit your application before the deadline.
examples.chinese: 請在截止期限前提交申請。

items.meaning: 訂閱，訂購（產品）;（為某項服務）定期付費;定期捐助
items.englishDefinition: to pay money to an organization in order to receive a product, use a service regularly, or support the organization

examples.english: She subscribes to several women's magazines.
examples.chinese: 她訂閱了幾本女性雜誌。

examples.english: 2.3 million people subscribe to this online music service.
examples.chinese: 有230萬人訂購了這個線上音樂服務。

items.englishDefinition: an amount of money that you pay regularly to receive a product or service

examples.english: I decided to take out (= pay for) a subscription to a gardening magazine.
examples.chinese: 我決定訂一本園藝雜誌。

examples.english: Your business can be listed on the website for a low monthly subscription.
examples.chinese: 只需每月支付一筆低廉的費用，貴公司就會被列在網站上。

items.englishDefinition: happening after something else

examples.english: The book discusses his illness and subsequent resignation from politics.
examples.chinese: 書中講述了他患病及隨後隱退政壇的事。

examples.english: Those explosions must have been subsequent to our departure, because we didn't hear anything.
examples.chinese: 那些爆炸一定是在我們離開後發生的，因為我們甚麼也沒聽到。

items.meaning: 大的；可觀的；價值巨大的；重大的
items.englishDefinition: large in size, value, or importance

examples.english: The findings show a substantial difference between the opinions of men and women.
examples.chinese: 這些發現顯示男性和女性之間存在重大的意見分歧。

examples.english: She inherited a substantial fortune from her grandmother.
examples.chinese: 她從祖母那裡繼承了一筆數目可觀的遺產。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: relating to the main or most important things being considered
additionalSenses.notes: substance 物質

examples.english: The committee was in substantial agreement (= agreed about most of the things discussed).
examples.chinese: 委員會基本上達成一致意見。

items.englishDefinition: to a large degree

examples.english: The new rules will substantially change how we do things.
examples.chinese: 新規則會很大程度地改變我們的行事方式。

items.englishDefinition: to perform the same job as another thing or person or to take their place

examples.english: Gas-fired power stations will substitute for less efficient coal-fired equipment.
examples.chinese: 以煤氣為燃料的發電站將會代替效率較低的燃煤裝置。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: A person or thing used in place of another.

examples.english: You can read about other countries, but there's no substitute for visiting them yourself.
examples.chinese: 你可以閱讀有關其他國家的資訊，但是什麼也代替不了親自到訪體驗。

items.englishDefinition: the achieving of the results wanted or hoped for

examples.english: The success of almost any project depends largely on its manager.
examples.chinese: 幾乎所有專案計劃的成功都很大程度地取決於管理者的能力。

examples.english: I've been trying to persuade her to take on more people, but so far without success.
examples.chinese: 我一直在勸她再僱些人，不過到目前為止都沒成功。

examples.english: I'm not having much success in communicating with him at the moment.
examples.chinese: 我目前和他溝通得不太順利。

items.englishDefinition: an idea, plan, or action that is suggested or the act of suggesting it

examples.english: I don't know what to wear tonight - do you have any suggestions?
examples.chinese: 我不知道今晚該穿甚麼——你有甚麼建議嗎？

examples.english: She made some very helpful suggestions but her boss rejected them all.
examples.chinese: 她提了些很有幫助的建議，但被她的老闆全部否定了。

items.englishDefinition: a large, rectangular container with a handle, for carrying clothes and possessions while travelling

examples.english: Have you packed/unpacked your suitcase yet?
examples.chinese: 你把衣物都放進手提箱了嗎／從手提箱裡拿出來了嗎?

items.englishDefinition: of excellent quality; very great

examples.english: He is a superb dancer.
examples.chinese: 他是一個傑出的舞蹈家。

examples.english: Taylor scored a superb goal at the end of the first half.
examples.chinese: 泰勒在上半場要結束的時候攻入了一個極為精彩的進球。

items.meaning: 好於平均的，好過其他的，優越的
items.englishDefinition: better than average or better than other people or things of the same type

examples.english: This is clearly the work of a superior artist.
examples.chinese: 這顯然是一位優秀藝術家的作品。

examples.english: She was chosen for the job because she was the superior candidate.
examples.chinese: 因為她比其他應徵者更出色，所以她被選中做這份工作。

items.englishDefinition: the act of watching a person or activity and making certain that everything is done correctly, safely, etc.

examples.english: Students are not allowed to handle these chemicals unless they are under the supervision of a teacher.
examples.chinese: 學生們只有在老師的指導下才能動這些化學物品。

examples.english: Our supplier delivers fresh fruit every morning.
examples.chinese: 我們的供應商每天早上配送新鮮水果。

examples.english: Technical support is available from nine to six on weekdays.
examples.chinese: 技術支援的服務時間為平日九點至六點。

items.englishDefinition: the treatment of injuries or diseases in people or animals by cutting open the body and removing or repairing the damaged part

examples.english: The patient had/underwent surgery on his heart.
examples.chinese: 這位病人接受了心臟外科手術。

examples.english: He made a good recovery after surgery to remove a brain tumour.
examples.chinese: 做了腦部腫瘤切除手術以後，他恢復得很好。

items.englishDefinition: to do or be better than
items.notes: sur 超過 pass 通過

examples.english: The book's success has surpassed everyone's expectations.
examples.chinese: 這本書獲得出乎所有人意料的成功。

examples.english: The director has really surpassed himself (= done better than he has done before) with this new film.
examples.chinese: 這位導演憑藉這部新電影實現了真正的自我超越。

items.englishDefinition: an examination of opinions, behaviour, etc., made by asking people questions

examples.english: A recent survey found/revealed/showed that 58 percent of people did not know where their heart is.
examples.chinese: 最近的一項調查顯示，有58%的人不知道自己的心臟在甚麼位置。

examples.english: to conduct/carry out/do a survey
examples.chinese: 進行調查

items.meaning: 易受影響的，易受傷害的
items.englishDefinition: easily influenced or harmed by something

examples.english: Among particularly susceptible children, the disease can develop very fast.
examples.chinese: 在特別易受感染的兒童中，這種疾病會擴展得非常迅速。

examples.english: These plants are particularly susceptible to frost.
examples.chinese: 這些植物很容易受霜凍影響。

items.englishDefinition: any feeling of illness or physical or mental change that is caused by a particular disease

examples.english: He's complaining of all the usual flu symptoms - a high temperature, headache, and so on.
examples.chinese: 他抱怨自己出現了所有常見的流感症狀——高燒、頭痛等等。

examples.english: He's been HIV-positive for six years, but just recently he's started to develop the symptoms of AIDS.
examples.chinese: 他 HIV 病毒檢測呈陽性反應已有六年了，但直到最近才開始出現愛滋病的徵狀。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: any single problem that is caused by and shows a more serious and general problem

examples.english: It's her feeling that the recent outbreaks of violence are a symptom of the dissatisfaction that is currently affecting our society.
examples.chinese: 她覺得最近爆發的暴力事件顯示了目前不滿的情緒正在影響我們的社會。

items.englishDefinition: made or changed especially to be suitable for a particular situation or purpose

examples.english: The project clearly requires a tailored computer system.
examples.chinese: 這個專案計劃顯然需要一個特製的電腦系統。

examples.english: Take advantage of the early booking discount before Friday.
examples.chinese: 請在星期五以前把握提前預訂的折扣。

examples.english: Our assistant will take care of the travel arrangements.
examples.chinese: 我們的助理會處理旅行安排。

examples.english: Please take notes so we can share the main points later.
examples.chinese: 請做筆記，方便我們之後分享重點。

items.englishDefinition: to leave the ground and begin flying
items.cue: 旅遊與生活情境：take off on time
items.notes: 本詞義不接受直接受詞：the plane takes off。與脫下衣物、事業快速成功等其他詞義分開。

examples.english: Our flight is expected to take off at eight thirty.
examples.chinese: 我們的班機預計八點半起飛。

examples.english: The plane took off late because of strong winds.
examples.chinese: 飛機因強風而延後起飛。

items.englishDefinition: to agree to handle a task or responsibility
items.cue: 職場與人事情境：take on a project
items.notes: 可分：take the project on；代名詞用 take it on。此處學承擔工作，另有雇用的詞義。

examples.english: Our team cannot take on another project this month.
examples.chinese: 我們團隊本月無法再承接另一個專案。

examples.english: Before you take it on, make sure you have enough time to finish.
examples.chinese: 承接這項工作前，請確認有足夠時間完成。

items.englishDefinition: to become responsible for work previously handled by someone else
items.cue: 職場與人事情境：take over a project
items.notes: 可分：take the project over；也可接 from 表示從誰手中接手。take over as 後接職位。

examples.english: Leo will take over the project when the current manager retires.
examples.chinese: 現任經理退休後，Leo 將接手這個專案。

examples.english: The new team is ready to take it over from the contractors.
examples.chinese: 新團隊已準備好從承包商手中接手這項工作。

items.englishDefinition: to go to live somewhere:

examples.english: She took up residence in Canada.
examples.chinese: 她在加拿大定居。

items.cue: A result a team aims to reach

examples.english: Our sales target for this month is higher than last month's.
examples.chinese: 我們這個月的銷售目標比上個月高。

examples.english: Checking the mail is my first task each morning.
examples.chinese: 每天早上我的第一項工作是查看郵件。

examples.english: Our team finished the project two days early.
examples.chinese: 我們的團隊提前兩天完成了專案。

items.englishDefinition: in a way that does not last for long or for ever

examples.english: This office is closed temporarily for redecoration.
examples.chinese: 這間辦公室因重新裝修而暫時關閉。

items.englishDefinition: not lasting or needed for very long

examples.english: The ceasefire will only provide a temporary solution to the crisis.
examples.chinese: 停火只能暫時解決危機。

examples.english: temporary staff
examples.chinese: 臨時工作人員

items.englishDefinition: to be likely to behave in a particular way or have a particular characteristic

examples.english: We tend to get cold winters and warm, dry summers in this part of the country.
examples.chinese: 在我國這個地區，往往冬季寒冷而夏季溫暖乾燥。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: to care for something or someone

examples.english: He carefully tended his sunflower plants.
examples.chinese: 他精心照料他的向日葵。

examples.english: The nurse gently tended the patient's cuts and bruises.
examples.chinese: 護士細心護理病人的傷口和瘀腫。

items.meaning: （計劃、想法、建議、行動等）試驗（性）的，試探（性）的，暫時的
items.englishDefinition: (of a plan or idea) not certain or agreed, or (of a suggestion or action) said or done in a careful but uncertain way because you do not know if you are right

examples.english: I have tentative plans to take a trip to Seattle in July.
examples.chinese: 我暫定七月去西雅圖旅行。

items.englishDefinition: in a way that may be changed later

examples.english: The project, tentatively called Viva, is in the early design stages.
examples.chinese: 該項目暫定名為Viva，目前還處於早期設計階段。

examples.english: The meeting has been tentatively scheduled for next week.
examples.chinese: 會議暫定於下週舉行。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: in a way that shows you are not certain or confident

examples.english: "I have come to see Mrs Edgerton," she said tentatively.
examples.chinese: “我是來看艾傑頓夫人的，”她試探地說。

items.englishDefinition: the fixed period of time that something lasts for

examples.english: He served a short term for drunk driving.
examples.chinese: 他因酒後開車而短期入獄。

examples.english: He was sentenced to a 150-year prison term for cheating thousands of ordinary people out of their savings.
examples.chinese: 他因詐騙幾千人的積蓄而被判入獄150年。

examples.english: A free shuttle bus connects the two terminals.
examples.chinese: 兩座航廈之間有免費接駁巴士往返。

items.englishDefinition: to (cause something to) end or stop

examples.english: They terminated my contract in October.
examples.chinese: 他們在十月終止了我的合約。

examples.english: This train will terminate at the next stop - passengers who wish to continue should change trains.
examples.chinese: 下一站就是本次列車的終點，繼續行程的乘客請換車。

items.englishDefinition: (the act of) dishonestly taking something that belongs to someone else and keeping it

examples.english: Unfortunately, we have had several thefts in the building recently.
examples.chinese: 很不幸，我們大廈最近發生了幾宗盜竊案。

examples.english: Shoplifting is theft.
examples.chinese: 偷拿商店的商品是偷竊。

items.englishDefinition: completely, very much

examples.english: I thoroughly enjoyed the performance.
examples.chinese: 我非常喜歡這個演出。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: in a detailed and careful way

examples.english: We went through the report thoroughly but couldn't find the information anywhere.
examples.chinese: 我們仔細查看了該報告，但沒有找到我們需要的資訊。

items.englishDefinition: to grow, develop, or be successful

examples.english: His business thrived in the years before the war.
examples.chinese: 戰前那些年，他的生意很興隆。

examples.english: She seems to thrive on stress.
examples.chinese: 她似乎很擅長在壓力下工作。

examples.english: You can buy a train ticket from the machine near the entrance.
examples.chinese: 你可以在入口附近的機器購買火車票。

items.meaning: 整齊的;整潔的，有條理的
items.englishDefinition: having everything ordered and arranged in the right place, or liking to keep things like this

examples.english: The house was clean and tidy.
examples.chinese: 房子乾淨整潔。

examples.english: My flatmate isn't very tidy.
examples.chinese: 我的室友不怎麼愛整潔。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: to make a place or a collection of things tidy

examples.english: Tidy (up) these papers before you leave, please.
examples.chinese: 請把這些文件整理好再走。

examples.english: I'm tired of asking you to tidy your room (up).
examples.chinese: 老是叫你收拾房間，我都厭煩了。

items.englishDefinition: happening at the best possible moment

examples.english: a timely reminder
examples.chinese: 及時的提醒

examples.english: The change in the exchange rate provided a timely boost to the company's falling profits.
examples.chinese: 匯率的變動及時緩解了公司利潤下滑的局面。

items.cue: Something used to do a job

examples.english: Put the tools back in the cabinet after use.
examples.chinese: 使用完畢後，請將工具放回櫃子裡。

items.englishDefinition: to pull a car, boat, etc. along, fastened behind another vehicle or boat

examples.english: The damaged boat was towed to safety.
examples.chinese: 受損船隻被拖至安全區。

examples.english: The road was closed while the vehicles that had been involved in the accident were towed away/off.
examples.chinese: 在發生交通事故的車輛被拖走時，這條道路封閉。

examples.english: Online tracking shows that your package is at the local depot.
examples.chinese: 線上追蹤資訊顯示，你的包裹已到當地配送站。

items.englishDefinition: the activity of buying and selling goods and/or services

examples.english: She doesn't approve of Sunday trading (= shops being open on Sunday).
examples.chinese: 她不贊成星期天商店開門營業。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: the buying and selling of shares and money

examples.english: The stock market moved ahead slightly in active trading today.
examples.chinese: 今天，股市在活躍的交易中略有增長。

examples.english: All new employees receive two days of training.
examples.chinese: 所有新進員工都會接受兩天的訓練。

items.englishDefinition: an occasion when someone buys or sells something, or when money is exchanged or the activity of buying or selling something

examples.english: We need to monitor the transaction of smaller deals.
examples.chinese: 我們需要監控規模較小的交易。

examples.english: a business transaction
examples.chinese: 生意

examples.english: Each transaction at the foreign exchange counter seems to take forever.
examples.chinese: 外幣兌換櫃枱的每筆交易似乎都要花很長時間。

examples.english: The bank sends me a message after each transaction.
examples.chinese: 每筆交易完成後，銀行都會傳訊息給我。

examples.english: We will transfer the money to your account tomorrow.
examples.chinese: 我們明天會將款項轉入你的帳戶。

items.englishDefinition: to change completely the appearance or character of something or someone, especially so that that thing or person is improved

examples.english: The reorganization will transform the entertainment industry.
examples.chinese: 這次重組將使娛樂業大為改觀。

examples.english: Whenever a camera was pointed at her, Marilyn would instantly transform herself into a radiant star.
examples.chinese: 每當攝像機對準她的時候，瑪麗蓮會立刻將自己變成一個耀眼的明星。

items.englishDefinition: the movement of goods or people from one place to another

examples.english: The question is whether road transit is cheaper than rail.
examples.chinese: 問題在於公路運輸是否比鐵路運輸便宜。

examples.english: It is possible to make an insurance claim for any goods lost or damaged in transit.
examples.chinese: 為在運輸中丟失或受損的貨物索取保險賠償是有可能的。

items.englishDefinition: Moving people or goods from one place to another; historically, sending convicts to another country.

examples.english: In the past, British convicts could be sentenced to transportation (to Australia).
examples.chinese: 過去，英國的犯人可被判處流放（至澳大利亞）。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: a vehicle or system of vehicles, such as buses, trains, etc. for getting from one place to another

examples.english: Bicycles are a cheap and efficient form/means of transportation.
examples.chinese: 腳踏車是一種便宜而高效的交通工具。

items.englishDefinition: to make something tidier or more level by cutting a small amount off it

examples.english: My hair needs trimming.
examples.chinese: 我的頭髮需要剪一剪。

examples.english: Trim off the leafy ends of the vegetable before cooking.
examples.chinese: 烹飪之前，去掉菜多葉的一端。

items.englishDefinition: to decide not to accept an offer or request
items.cue: 商務與法規情境：turn down an offer
items.notes: 可分；代名詞用 turn it down。此詞義是拒絕，與調低音量的詞義分開學習。

examples.english: The supplier turned down our request for a longer payment period.
examples.chinese: 供應商拒絕了我們延長付款期限的要求。

examples.english: The position requires weekend work, so Mina decided to turn it down.
examples.chinese: 這個職位需要週末上班，所以 Mina 決定婉拒。

items.englishDefinition: to submit a document or return an item to the appropriate person
items.cue: 職場與人事情境：turn in a report
items.notes: 可分：turn it in。此處學繳交或交還，不是 turn in 的就寢詞義。

examples.english: Employees must turn in their access cards before leaving the company.
examples.chinese: 員工離職前必須交還門禁卡。

examples.english: Once you finish the questionnaire, turn it in at the reception desk.
examples.chinese: 填完問卷後，請交到接待櫃檯。

examples.english: Please turn off the lights before leaving the room.
examples.chinese: 離開房間前，請關燈。

items.englishDefinition: to make equipment start working by using a switch
items.cue: 設施與環境情境：turn on the lights
items.notes: 可分：turn the projector on；代名詞用 turn it on。與 turn off 相反。

examples.english: Please turn on the projector before the guests arrive.
examples.chinese: 請在來賓抵達前開啟投影機。

examples.english: The desk lamp is off; could you turn it on for me?
examples.chinese: 桌燈關著，你能幫我打開嗎？

items.meaning: （一定時期內的）營業額，成交量
items.englishDefinition: the amount of business that a company does in a period of time

examples.english: Large supermarkets have high turnovers (= their goods sell very quickly).
examples.chinese: 大型超市的貨品銷售量很大。

examples.english: The business has an annual turnover of £50,000.
examples.chinese: 這家公司的年營業額達5萬英鎊。

additionalSenses.meaning: 員工更替率;人員調整率
additionalSenses.englishDefinition: the rate at which employees leave a company and are replaced by new people

examples.english: The large number of temporary contracts resulted in a high turnover of staff.
examples.chinese: 臨時合約多，人員變更率就很高。

examples.english: They've had a lot of turnover at the factory recently.
examples.chinese: 最近他們工廠人員變動很大。

items.englishDefinition: showing all the characteristics that you would usually expect from a particular group of things

examples.english: I must look like the typical tourist with my shorts and my camera.
examples.chinese: 穿著短褲，帶著相機，我看上去一定像個典型遊客。

examples.english: This kind of hot and spicy food is very typical of the food in the south of the country.
examples.chinese: 這種辛辣食品是該國南部具代表性的食物。

items.englishDefinition: in a way that shows all the characteristics that you would expect from the stated person, thing, or group

examples.english: She has that reserve and slight coldness of manner which is typically English.
examples.chinese: 她像典型的英國人那樣態度矜持，略顯冷淡。

examples.english: Paul, in his typically blunt manner, told him he wasn't interested.
examples.chinese: 保羅以慣有的生硬口氣說他不感興趣。

items.meaning: （團體）意見一致的;（決定或裁決）一致通過的，獲得全體支援的
items.englishDefinition: If a group of people are unanimous, they all agree about one particular matter or vote the same way, and if a decision or judgment is unanimous, it is formed or supported by everyone in a group.

examples.english: The new format has unanimous support.
examples.chinese: 新的形式獲得了一致支持。

examples.english: After a lengthy discussion we reached a unanimous decision on the proposal.
examples.chinese: 經過長時間討論，我們對這一提案作出了一致決定。

items.meaning: 意見一致地;獲全體支持地
items.englishDefinition: in a way that is agreed or supported by everyone in a group

examples.english: All four proposals to the committee were unanimously approved.
examples.chinese: 提交給委員會的四項提案均獲得全體通過。

examples.english: The Board voted unanimously to terminate his three-year contract.
examples.chinese: 董事會全票通過決定終止他為期三年的合同。

items.cue: Work on a building is unfinished

examples.english: The new parking garage is still under construction.
examples.chinese: 新的停車大樓仍在施工中。

items.meaning: 經歷，經受（令人不快的事或變化）
items.englishDefinition: to experience something that is unpleasant or something that involves a change

examples.english: She underwent an operation on a tumour in her left lung last year.
examples.chinese: 她去年接受了左肺腫瘤手術。

examples.english: Playing board games is undergoing a revival in popularity.
examples.chinese: 玩桌遊正再度流行起來。

items.englishDefinition: An underground activity is secret and usually illegal.

examples.english: an underground newspaper/movement
examples.chinese: 地下報紙／運動

examples.english: The Communist Party was forced (to go) underground, and its leaders went into hiding.
examples.chinese: 共產黨被迫轉爲地下活動，其領導人也隱藏了起來。

items.meaning: （開始）做，承擔，從事（尤指耗時或困難之事）
items.englishDefinition: to do or begin to do something, especially something that will take a long time or be difficult

examples.english: Students are required to undertake simple experiments.
examples.chinese: 要求學生們做些簡單的實驗。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: to promise that you will do something

examples.english: She undertook not to publish the names of the people involved.
examples.chinese: 她答應不公佈有關人員的名字。

examples.english: The government undertook that the buildings would not be redeveloped.
examples.chinese: 政府承諾不會改造這些大樓。

items.englishDefinition: a trade union UK

examples.english: the electricians' union
examples.chinese: 電工工會

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: the act or the state of being joined together

examples.english: Meanwhile the debate on European political and monetary union continues.
examples.chinese: 同時，有關歐洲政治和貨幣聯盟的爭論還在繼續。

examples.english: She believes that the union (= marriage) of man and woman in holy matrimony is for ever.
examples.chinese: 她相信男女之間的神聖結合是永遠的。

items.meaning: 空著的;閒置的;無人佔用的
items.englishDefinition: without anyone in it, or not busy

examples.english: Are there any unoccupied seats in that row?
examples.chinese: 那一排還有空座位嗎？

items.meaning: 史無前例的，空前的;絕無僅有的
items.englishDefinition: never having happened or existed in the past

examples.english: This century has witnessed environmental destruction on an unprecedented scale.
examples.chinese: 環境在本世紀遭到了空前的破壞。

items.englishDefinition: happening soon

examples.english: Tickets are selling well for the group's upcoming concert tour.
examples.chinese: 該樂隊即將舉行的巡演門票銷售情況良好。

examples.english: Please update your contact details if your phone number changes.
examples.chinese: 如果電話號碼變更，請更新你的聯絡資料。

items.englishDefinition: of or in a city or town

examples.english: urban development
examples.chinese: 城市發展

examples.english: urban decay
examples.chinese: 城市衰落

items.meaning: 公用事業；（電、煤氣、鐵路等）公共設施
items.englishDefinition: a service that is used by the public, such as an electricity or gas supply

examples.english: The biggest financial worries are mortgages followed by utility bills.
examples.chinese: 最大的財務擔憂是抵押貸款，其次是水電費。

examples.english: We each pay £500 in rent plus utilities.
examples.chinese: 我們每人支付 500 英鎊租金，另外還要支付水電等公用事業費。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: the usefulness of something, especially in a practical way

examples.english: The utility of this substance has been proven in a series of tests.
examples.chinese: 這種物質的效用在一系列測試中得到了證明。

examples.english: Under such conditions, a common medium of exchange would have no utility at all.
examples.chinese: 在這種情況下，共同的交換媒介根本沒有效用。

items.englishDefinition: to use something in an effective way

examples.english: The vitamins come in a form that is easily utilized by the body.
examples.chinese: 把維生素製成易被人體吸收的産品。

examples.english: The technicians utilized computer technology to improve processes
examples.chinese: 技術人員利用電腦技術改善流程

items.englishDefinition: used to emphasize how important or serious something is
items.notes: do one's utmost

examples.english: The situation needs to be handled with the utmost care.
examples.chinese: 這種局勢需要極其小心地處理。

examples.english: The hospital has a vacancy for an office assistant.
examples.chinese: 這家醫院有一個辦公室助理的職缺。

items.meaning: 確鑿的；合理的；有根據的；讓人信服的
items.englishDefinition: based on truth or reason; able to be accepted

examples.english: a valid argument/criticism/reason
examples.chinese: 令人信服的論據／批評／理由

examples.english: My way of thinking might be different from yours, but it's equally valid.
examples.chinese: 我的想法也許和你的不同，但同樣站得住腳。

items.englishDefinition: the characteristic of often changing and being different

examples.english: When planning meals, you need to think about variety and taste as well as nutritional value.
examples.chinese: 做飯時，你既需要考慮飯菜的營養價值，又需要考慮飯菜的花樣和味道。

examples.english: Work on the production line is monotonous and lacks variety.
examples.chinese: 在生產線上工作很單調，缺乏變化。

items.englishDefinition: to change or cause something to change in amount or level, especially from one occasion to another

examples.english: My taste in classical music varies greatly/widely, but I usually prefer Mozart or Brahms.
examples.chinese: 我對各種古典音樂的喜好程度很不相同，但我通常比較喜歡莫札特或布拉姆斯的音樂。

examples.english: Some people give a regular monthly donation while others vary the amount they give.
examples.chinese: 有些人每月捐贈固定數目的善款，而有些人每月捐贈的數額多少不一。

examples.english: Please let us know if you need a vegetarian meal.
examples.chinese: 如果你需要素食餐點，請告訴我們。

examples.english: Only company vehicles may park in this area.
examples.chinese: 只有公司車輛可以停在這個區域。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: a machine, usually with wheels and an engine, used for transporting people or goods, especially on land

examples.english: Road vehicles include cars, buses, and trucks.
examples.chinese: 道路交通工具包括汽車、公車和卡車。

examples.english: A truck driver died last night when his vehicle overturned.
examples.chinese: 昨晚一輛卡車翻了車，司機死亡。

items.cue: Choosing a business to buy from

examples.english: Please choose a vendor from the approved list.
examples.chinese: 請從核准的名單中選擇一家銷售商。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: someone who is selling something

examples.english: For the past few months she's been working as a street vendor, selling fruit and vegetables.
examples.chinese: 幾個月以來，她一直在街頭賣水果和蔬菜。

examples.english: The vendor of the house wants to exchange contracts this week.
examples.chinese: 這棟房子的賣主想在本週辦理房產過戶手續。

items.meaning: （公共事件的）發生場所，舉行地點；會場
items.englishDefinition: the place where a public event or meeting happens

examples.english: The hotel is an ideal venue for conferences and business meetings.
examples.chinese: 這家飯店是舉行會議和商務會談的理想場所。

examples.english: The stadium has been specifically designed as a venue for World Cup matches.
examples.chinese: 這個體育場是特別為世界杯的比賽設計的。

items.cue: One edition of a file or product

examples.english: Please use the latest version of the price list.
examples.chinese: 請使用最新版本的價目表。

examples.english: You may need a visa for your business trip.
examples.chinese: 你這趟出差可能需要簽證。

items.meaning: 必不可少的；極其重要的
items.englishDefinition: necessary for the success or continued existence of something; extremely important

examples.english: A strong opposition is vital to a healthy democracy.
examples.chinese: 有一個強大的反對黨對於健康的民主制度來說非常重要。

examples.english: She had found out some information of vital importance.
examples.chinese: 她已經查出了一些極為重要的資訊。

items.englishDefinition: in a voluntary way (= done, made, or given willingly)

examples.english: If you don't leave voluntarily then we will send you away.
examples.chinese: 如果你不自願離開，那麼我們會將你送走。

examples.english: We decided to voluntarily withdraw the drug from the market.
examples.chinese: 我們決定自願將這種藥物撤出市場。

items.englishDefinition: to not demand something you have a right to, or not cause a rule to be obeyed

examples.english: The bank manager waived the charge (= said we didn't have to pay), as we were old and valued customers.
examples.chinese: 那位銀行經理沒有收取我們的費用，因為我們是尊貴的老顧客。

examples.english: If they waive (= remove) the time limit, many more applications will come in.
examples.chinese: 假如取消時間限制，那麼就會收到多得多的申請。

examples.english: He persuaded the delegates to waive (= give up) their objections.
examples.chinese: 他說服代表們不再反對。

items.englishDefinition: to become weaker in strength or influence

examples.english: By the late 70s the band's popularity was beginning to wane.
examples.chinese: 上世紀70年代末，這個樂團的人氣開始下滑。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: becoming less strong, powerful, popular, etc.

examples.english: There are signs that support for the group is on the wane.
examples.chinese: 有跡象表明該組織的支持率正日益下降。

examples.english: The goods are stored in a warehouse near the airport.
examples.chinese: 這些貨物存放在機場附近的倉庫。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: a large building where goods are stored before being used, sold, or distributed
additionalSenses.notes:
Ware
n. 陶器，器皿；製品；器具；貨物; vt. 留心；小心

examples.english: The goods have been sitting in a warehouse for months because a strike has prevented distribution.
examples.chinese: 因為罷工無法發貨，貨物已經堆在倉庫裡好幾個月了。

items.cue: A promise to repair certain faults

examples.english: The printer is still under warranty.
examples.chinese: 這台印表機仍在保固期內。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: a written promise from a company to repair or replace a product that develops a fault within a particular period of time, or to do a piece of work again if it is not satisfactory

examples.english: The warranty covers the car mechanically for a year, with unlimited mileage.
examples.chinese: 保用單承諾對汽車的機械部件保修一年，不限里程。

items.cue: Buying or selling in large quantities

examples.english: The store buys notebooks wholesale to keep costs down.
examples.chinese: 這家商店以批發方式購買筆記本，以降低成本。

items.englishDefinition: including a lot of different places, people, subjects, etc.

examples.english: This theory is no longer widely accepted.
examples.chinese: 這一理論不再被人們廣泛接受。

examples.english: His plays are still widely performed in the USA.
examples.chinese: 他的戲劇仍在美國各地上演。

items.englishDefinition: when you take money out of a bank account

examples.english: The bank became suspicious after several large withdrawals were made from his account in a single week.
examples.chinese: 他的帳戶僅在一週之內就有數筆大額提款，這讓銀行產生了懷疑。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: the act or process of taking something away so that it is no longer available, or of someone stopping being involved in an activity

examples.english: Her sudden withdrawal from the championship caused a lot of press speculation about her health.
examples.chinese: 她突然退出錦標賽，引發媒體關於她健康狀況的各種猜測。

items.englishDefinition: a person who sees an event happening, especially a crime or an accident

examples.english: Police are appealing for witnesses to the accident to come forward.
examples.chinese: 警方呼籲那場事故的目擊者站出來。

examples.english: According to (eye) witnesses, the robbery was carried out by two teenage boys.
examples.chinese: 據目擊者說，搶劫案是兩個十幾歲的少年做的。

examples.english: Most new customers hear about our shop through word of mouth.
examples.chinese: 大多數新顧客都是透過口耳相傳得知我們的店。

examples.english: I am working on the sales report this afternoon.
examples.chinese: 今天下午我正在處理銷售報告。

items.englishDefinition: to develop a practical solution or workable arrangement
items.cue: 職場與人事情境：work out a solution
items.notes: 可分：work it out。此處學想出辦法，不是運動或計算的詞義。

examples.english: The logistics team will work out a cheaper delivery plan.
examples.chinese: 物流團隊將想出較便宜的配送方案。

examples.english: The two departments have a scheduling problem, but they can work it out together.
examples.chinese: 兩個部門的排程有問題，但可以共同解決。

examples.english: We hired an assistant to reduce the team's workload.
examples.chinese: 我們聘請了一名助理，以減輕團隊的工作量。

items.englishDefinition: to cover or surround something with paper, cloth, or other material

examples.english: She wrapped the present and tied it with ribbon.
examples.chinese: 她把禮物包起來並用絲帶綁好。

examples.english: Wrap the chicken in foil and cook it for two hours.
examples.chinese: 用錫紙將雞肉包起來，烹飪兩個小時。

items.englishDefinition: to record information in writing
items.cue: 會議與溝通情境：write down a number
items.notes: 可分：write the number down；代名詞用 write it down。過去式 wrote down。

examples.english: Please write down the reference number before closing the page.
examples.chinese: 關閉頁面前，請寫下查詢編號。

examples.english: The speaker gave us several tips, and I wrote them down.
examples.chinese: 講者提供了幾項建議，我把它們記了下來。

items.englishDefinition: to supply or produce something positive such as a profit, an amount of food or information

examples.english: The investigation yielded some unexpected results.
examples.chinese: 調查得出了一些出乎意料的結果。

examples.english: Favourable weather yielded a good crop.
examples.chinese: 好天氣帶來了好收成。

examples.english: an attempt to yield increased profits
examples.chinese: 提高利潤的努力

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: an amount of something positive, such as food or profit, that is produced or supplied

examples.english: The new production method increased the yield of usable material.
examples.chinese: 新的生產方法提高了可用材料的產量。
